text: Then the disciples divined that he had been speaking to them about John, the Baptist.

title: Matthew 17:14
text: As they reached the crowd, a man came up to Jesus, and fell on his knees before him, saying:

title: Matthew 17:15
text: "Master, take pity on my son, for he is an epileptic and sore distressed. Often he falls into the fire and often into the water.

title: Matthew 17:16
text: "And I brought him to your disciples, but they could not cure him."

title: Matthew 17:17
text: In reply Jesus said: "O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I endure you? Bring him here to me!"

title: Matthew 17:18
text: Then Jesus rebuked the evil spirit, and it came out of him; and the boy was cured from that very hour.

title: Matthew 17:19
text: Thereupon Jesus' disciples came to him and asked him privately, "Why were we not able to cast it out?"

title: Matthew 17:20
text: "Because of your little faith," he answered. "In solemn truth I tell you that if you have faith the size of a mustard-seed, you can say to this mountain, 'Move from this place to that!' and it will move; and nothing will be impossible to you.

title: Matthew 17:21
text: "But this kind is driven out by prayer alone."

title: Matthew 17:22
text: As they continued going from place to place in Galilee, Jesus said to them: "The Son of man is about to be betrayed into the hands of men;

title: Matthew 17:23
text: "and they will kill him, but on the third day he will rise again." And they were greatly grieved.

title: Matthew 17:24
text: As they came into Capernaum the collectors of the temple tax came to Peter and asked, "Does not your Teacher pay the temple tax?"

title: Matthew 17:25
text: "Indeed he does," answered Peter. But on Peter's entering the house, Jesus forestalled him, saying: "How does it seem to you, Simon? From whom do earthly kings collect customs or taxes-from their own people, or from aliens?"

title: Matthew 17:26
text: And when he replied, "From aliens," Jesus said: "Then their people go free.

title: Matthew 17:27
text: "Nevertheless, that we may not give offense, go to the seaside, throw in your hook; take the first fish that rises, and when you have opened its mouth, you will find a shekel in it. Take it and give it to them for us both."

title: Matthew 18:1
text: At that hour his disciples came to Jesus and asked him, "Who is really greatest in the kingdom of heaven?"

title: Matthew 18:2
text: When he had called a little child to him, Jesus set him among them, and answered:

title: Matthew 18:3
text: "In solemn truth I tell you that unless you turn and become like little children, you will not even enter the kingdom of heaven.

title: Matthew 18:4
text: "Whoever therefore will humble himself like this little child, is greatest in the kingdom of heaven;

title: Matthew 18:5
text: "and whoever receives one such little child for my sake, receives me.

title: Matthew 18:6
text: "But whoever shall cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if a great millstone were hung about his neck, and he were drowned in the depths of the sea.

title: Matthew 18:7
text: "Woe unto the world because of such stumbling-blocks! They will surely come, but woe unto each man by whom they come!

title: Matthew 18:8
text: "If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, than to keep both hands or both feet and be cast into the everlasting burning.

title: Matthew 18:9
text: "If your eye keeps causing you to stumble, pluck it out and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with only one eye, than to keep both eyes and be cast into the Gehenna of fire.

title: Matthew 18:10
text: "See to it that you never despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father in heaven.

title: Matthew 18:11
text: "For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

title: Matthew 18:12
text: "How does it seem to you, when a man has a hundred sheep and loses one of them? Will he not leave the ninety and nine on the hills, to go and search for the one that has strayed?

title: Matthew 18:13
text: "And if he succeeds in finding it, I tell you solemnly that he rejoices over it more than over the ninety and nine that never strayed away.

title: Matthew 18:14
text: "Just so, it is not the will of my Father in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.

title: Matthew 18:15
text: "If your brother sins against you, go and show him, between yourself and him alone. If he listens, you have won your brother.

title: Matthew 18:16
text: "But if he will not listen to you, take one or two others along, so that by the testimony of two or three witnesses every word may be established. If he will not listen to them, tell the church;

title: Matthew 18:17
text: "but if he will not heed the church, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax-gatherer.

title: Matthew 18:18
text: "I tell you all in solemn truth that whatever you forbid upon earth will be forbidden in heaven, and whatever you permit on earth will be permitted in heaven.

title: Matthew 18:19
text: "And again I tell you that if two of you on earth symphonize your praying concerning anything for which you have asked, it shall be done for you by my Father in heaven.

title: Matthew 18:20
text: "For wherever there are two or three gathered together in my name, there am I among them."

title: Matthew 18:21
text: Just then Peter came to him, and asked him, "Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?"

title: Matthew 18:22
text: "I do not tell you 'till seven times,'" answered Jesus, "but till seventy times seven.

title: Matthew 18:23
text: "Thus the kingdom of heaven may be compared to a king who wished to settle accounts with his slaves.

title: Matthew 18:24
text: "But when he began to settle, one of them was brought before him who owed him fifteen million dollars.

title: Matthew 18:25
text: "And since he was unable to pay, his master ordered him to be sold, and his wife and children and all that he had, toward the payment of the debt.

title: Matthew 18:26
text: "Thereupon his slave threw himself on his knees before him, crying, "'Have patience with me, and I will pay you all!'

title: Matthew 18:27
text: "So then the master pitied his slave, and let him go, and forgave him his debt.

title: Matthew 18:28
text: "But on his way out, that slave met a fellow slave who owed him fifty dollars. Seizing him by the throat, and nearly choking him, he exclaimed, "'Pay me what you owe me!'

title: Matthew 18:29
text: "Then his fellow slave fell at his feet, and besought him, saying, "'Be patient with me, and I will pay you.'

title: Matthew 18:30
text: "But he would not; on the contrary he went and threw him into prison until he should pay the debt.

title: Matthew 18:31
text: "When therefore his fellow slaves saw what had happened, they were very angry; and they went and explained to their master all that had happened.

title: Matthew 18:32
text: "Immediately his master summoned him and said: "'You wicked slave! I forgave you all that debt because you implored me.

title: Matthew 18:33
text: "'Ought not you also to have had pity on your fellow slave, just as I had pity on you?'

title: Matthew 18:34
text: "Then in hot anger his master handed him over to the torturers, until he should pay him all his debt.

title: Matthew 18:35
text: "So will my heavenly Father do to you also, unless from your heart each one of you forgive his brother."

title: Matthew 19:1
text: It came about after Jesus had finished these teachings, that he removed from Galilee, and went to that part of Judea which lay across the Jordan.

title: Matthew 19:2
text: A great multitude followed him, and he healed them there.

title: Matthew 19:3
text: Presently some of the Pharisees came up to him, and made test of him by asking, "Is it right for a man to divorce his wife for every cause?"

title: Matthew 19:4
text: "Have you not read." he answered, "that He who created them from the beginning made them male and female, and said,

title: Matthew 19:5
text: "For this cause shall a man leave his father and his mother and shall cleave to his wife; and the two shall be one flesh?

title: Matthew 19:6
text: "Thus they are no longer two, but one. Therefore what God has joined together, let not man separate."

title: Matthew 19:7
text: They answered, "Why then did Moses command the husband to give her 'a written bill of divorce,' and so to put her away?"

title: Matthew 19:8
text: "Moses," said Jesus, "permitted you to divorce your wives on account of the hardness of your hearts, but from the beginning it was not so.

title: Matthew 19:9
text: "And I tell you that any man who divorces his wife for any cause except her unfaithfulness, and marries another woman, commits adultery."

title: Matthew 19:10
text: "If that is the position of a man in relation to his wife," answered the disciples, "it is better not to marry."

title: Matthew 19:11
text: He answered them: "Not all are accepting this teaching, but only those to whom it has been granted.

title: Matthew 19:12
text: "For there are eunuchs who have been such from birth; others who have been made such by men; and others who have made themselves eunuchs for the sake of the kingdom of God. He who is able to receive this, let him receive it."

title: Matthew 19:13
text: Then young children were brought to him, that he might lay his hands on them and pray. His disciples interfered, but Jesus said to them:

title: Matthew 19:14
text: "Let the little children come to me, and forbid them not; for it is to the childlike that the kingdom of heaven belongs."

title: Matthew 19:15
text: So he laid his hands upon them, and departed from that place.

title: Matthew 19:16
text: But look! a certain man came up to him and asked, "Teacher, what good thing shall I do to inherit eternal life?"

title: Matthew 19:17
text: "Why do you ask me about what is good?" asked Jesus. "There is but One who is good. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments."

title: Matthew 19:18
text: "Which commandments?" asked the man. Jesus replied: "You shalt not kill; You shalt not commit adultery; You shalt not steal; You shalt not bear false witness;

title: Matthew 19:19
text: "Honor your father and your mother; and, You shalt love your neighbor as thyself."

title: Matthew 19:20
text: The young man answered: "I have carefully kept them all. What yet do I lack?"

title: Matthew 19:21
text: "If you want to be perfect," said Jesus, "go, sell your property, give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me."

title: Matthew 19:22
text: But when the young man heard this teaching, he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had much property.

title: Matthew 19:23
text: So Jesus said to his disciples: "In solemn truth I tell you that a rich man will find it difficult to enter the kingdom of heaven.

title: Matthew 19:24
text: "I tell you again, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of heaven."

title: Matthew 19:25
text: When they heard this the disciples were utterly astounded. "Who then can be saved?" they exclaimed. Jesus looked at them:

title: Matthew 19:26
text: "With men this is impossible," he said, "but with God all things are possible."

title: Matthew 19:27
text: Whereupon Peter said to Jesus: "Look, Master, we have forsaken everything and followed you. Now what shall be our reward?"

title: Matthew 19:28
text: "In solemn truth I tell you," Jesus answered, "that in the New Creation, when the Son of man shall sit on the throne of his glory, you also who have followed me shall sit on twelve thrones, to govern the twelve tribes of Israel.

title: Matthew 19:29
text: "And every one who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or children, or lands, for my sake, shall many times as much, and fall heir to eternal life.

title: Matthew 19:30
text: "But many who are first shall be last, and many who are last shall be first.

title: Matthew 20:1
text: "For the kingdom of heaven is like a householder who went out at dawn to hire workmen for his vineyard.

title: Matthew 20:2
text: "And when he had agreed with the workmen for two shillings a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

title: Matthew 20:3
text: "About nine o'clock he went out and noticed some other workmen standing idle in the market-place;

title: Matthew 20:4
text: "and he said to them, "'Do you also go into the vineyard, and whatever is just I will pay you.'

title: Matthew 20:5
text: "So they went. Again at noon, and about three o'clock, he went out and did the same thing.

title: Matthew 20:6
text: "When he went out about five o'clock, he found others standing around, and said to them, "'Why have you been standing here idle, all the day long?'

title: Matthew 20:7
text: "'Because no one has hired us,' they replied. "He said to them, 'Do you also go into the vineyard.'

title: Matthew 20:8
text: "And when evening came, the Lord of the vineyard said to his steward, "'Call the workmen and pay them their wages, beginning with the last hired and ending with the first.'

title: Matthew 20:9
text: "When those came who had begun at five o'clock, they received two shillings apiece;

title: Matthew 20:10
text: "and when the first came they supposed that they would get more, but they also received each two shillings.

title: Matthew 20:11
text: "And as they took it they began to grumble against the master of the house:

title: Matthew 20:12
text: "'Those last men,' they said, 'have toiled only one hour, and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden and the burning heat of the day.'

title: Matthew 20:13
text: "In reply he said to one of them: 'My friend, I am doing no wrong. Did you not agree with me for two shillings?

title: Matthew 20:14
text: "Take your wage and begone! I chose to give to this last man the same as to you.

title: Matthew 20:15
text: "Have I not the right to do what I choose with my own property? Or is your eye evil because I am generous?'

title: Matthew 20:16
text: "So the last shall be first, and the first, last."

title: Matthew 20:17
text: When Jesus was about to go up to Jerusalem, he took the Twelve aside by themselves, and as they went he said to them:

title: Matthew 20:18
text: "Look! We are on the way up to Jerusalem, and the Son of man will be betrayed to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death,

title: Matthew 20:19
text: "and hand him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and scourged and crucified; and on the third day he will rise from the grave."

title: Matthew 20:20
text: Then came to him the mother of the sons of Zebedee, with her sons, kneeling down and begging a favor of him.

title: Matthew 20:21
text: "What is it you wish?" he said. She answered, "Command that these my two sons may sit upon your right hand and your left in your kingdom."

title: Matthew 20:22
text: "None of you know what you are asking," said Jesus. "Can you drink the cup which I am about to drink?" "We can," they replied.

title: Matthew 20:23
text: My cup you indeed shall drink," he answered, "but to sit at my right hand or at my left is not mine to grant, but belongs to those for whom it has been prepared by my Father."

title: Matthew 20:24
text: When the ten heard of this, they were indignant at the two brothers;

title: Matthew 20:25
text: but Jesus called them to him and said: "You know how the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their great men exercise authority over them.

title: Matthew 20:26
text: "Not so shall it be among you. But whoever among you wishes to become great, shall be your minister,

title: Matthew 20:27
text: "and whoever wishes to be first among you, shall be your slave;

title: Matthew 20:28
text: "just as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life as a ransom for many."

title: Matthew 20:29
text: Now as they were leaving Jericho a great crowd followed him.

title: Matthew 20:30
text: And two blind men, sitting by the side of the road, heard that it was Jesus who was passing by, and cried out, "Have pity on us, Master, Son of David!"

title: Matthew 20:31
text: But the crowd checked them, to make them keep still. They cried out all the louder, saying, "Master, have pity on us, Son of David!"

title: Matthew 20:32
text: Then Jesus stopped and called to them, "What do you want me to do for you?"

title: Matthew 20:33
text: "Master," they answered, "let our eyes be opened."

title: Matthew 20:34
text: Then Jesus, moved with compassion, touched their eyes, and they saw at once, and followed him.

title: Matthew 21:1
text: And when they approached Jerusalem, and had reached Bethphage on the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples, saying to them:

title: Matthew 21:2
text: "Go on into the village facing you, and at once you will find an ass tied, and her colt with her. Loose them and bring them to me.

title: Matthew 21:3
text: "And if any one says anything to you, tell him, 'The Master needs them,' and he will send them without delay."

title: Matthew 21:4
text: This happened in fulfilment of the word spoken through the prophet:

title: Matthew 21:5
text: Say to the daughter of Zion, "Behold your King cometh to thee, Gentle and sitting upon an ass, And upon a colt, the foal of a beast of burden."

title: Matthew 21:6
text: So the disciples went and did as Jesus told them;

title: Matthew 21:7
text: they led back the ass and her colt, and placed their cloaks on them.

title: Matthew 21:8
text: Then Jesus seated himself upon them, and most of the crowd kept spreading their cloaks on the road, and others began cutting branches off the trees, and spreading them in the road.

title: Matthew 21:9
text: And the crowds who preceded and those who followed after him shouted again and again, "Hosanna to the Son of David! Blessed be he who is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!"

title: Matthew 21:10
text: And as he came into Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred. "Who is this?" they said.

title: Matthew 21:11
text: And the crowds answered, "This is the Prophet Jesus, from Nazareth, in Galilee."

title: Matthew 21:12
text: Then Jesus entered into the Temple courts, and cast out all who were buying and selling there, and overturned the tables of the money-changers, and the seats of those who sold pigeons.

title: Matthew 21:13
text: "It is written," he said, "My house shall be called a house of prayer, but you are making it a den of thieves."

title: Matthew 21:14
text: Then the blind and the lame came to him in the Temple courts, and he healed them.

title: Matthew 21:15
text: But when the chief priests and the Scribes saw the wonderful works he did, and the boys who were shouting in the Temple Courts and saying, "Hosanna to the Son of David!"

title: Matthew 21:16
text: they asked him, "Do you hear what they are saying?" "Surely," said Jesus, "and have you never read, Out of the mouths of babes and sucklings You hast perfected praise?"

title: Matthew 21:17
text: So he left them and went outside the city, to Bethany, and spent the night there.

title: Matthew 21:18
text: At dawn, when he was on his way back into the city, he was hungry;

title: Matthew 21:19
text: and when he saw a solitary fig tree beside the road, he went to it, but found nothing on it but leaves. And he said to it, "Let no man gather fruit from you forever." And at once the fig tree withered away.

title: Matthew 21:20
text: When his disciples saw this, they were astonished. "How instantaneously," they said, "the fig tree withered!"

title: Matthew 21:21
text: In reply Jesus said to them, "In solemn truth I tell you that if you have faith and never doubt, you will not only do what has been done to the fig tree, but even if you say to this mountain, 'Up, cast yourself into the sea!' it shall be done;

title: Matthew 21:22
text: "and everything that you ask for in your prayers you shall have, if you believe."

title: Matthew 21:23
text: When he had entered the Temple courts, and was teaching, the high priests and elders of the people came to him and asked him, "By what authority are you doing these things, and who gave you this authority?"

title: Matthew 21:24
text: Jesus answered: "I also will put a question to you, which, if you tell me, I also will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.

title: Matthew 21:25
text: John's baptism, whence was it, from heaven or from man?" So they began debating about it among themselves:

title: Matthew 21:26
text: "If we say, 'From heaven,' he will ask us, 'Why then did you not believe him?' But if we say, 'From men,' we are afraid of the crowd, for they all regard John as a prophet."

title: Matthew 21:27
text: So they answered Jesus, "We do not know." He said to them, "Nor am I going to tell you in what authority I do these deeds.

title: Matthew 21:28
text: "But give me your judgment. There was once a man who had two sons. He went to the first and said to him, "'Son, go work today in my vineyard!'

title: Matthew 21:29
text: "'I will go, sir,' he answered; yet he did not go.

title: Matthew 21:30
text: "Then he went to the second, and said the same thing to him. "'I will not,' he answered; but afterward he changed his mind and went.

title: Matthew 21:31
text: "Which of these two did the will of his father?" "The last," they replied. "I tell you truly," said Jesus, "that the tax-gatherers and harlots are going into the kingdom of heaven before you!

title: Matthew 21:32
text: "For John came to you in the road of righteousness, and you did not give credence to him; but the tax-gatherers and the harlots gave credence to him. But you, although you saw this, did not even then change your minds and give credence to him.

title: Matthew 21:33
text: "Listen to another parable: "A man who was a householder planted a vineyard, fenced it about, dug a wine vat in it, built a tower, then rented it to vine-dressers and went abroad.

title: Matthew 21:34
text: "When the time of fruit drew near, he sent his slaves to the vine-dressers to get his fruit.

title: Matthew 21:35
text: "And the vine-dressers seized his slaves, flogged one, killed another, and stoned a third.

title: Matthew 21:36
text: "Again he sent other slaves, a larger number than at first, and they treated them in the same way.

title: Matthew 21:37
text: "And last he sent his son to them; 'Surely they will respect my son,' he said.

title: Matthew 21:38
text: "But when the vine-dressers saw his son, they said to themselves: "'This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, and take his inheritance.'

title: Matthew 21:39
text: "So they took him and cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him.

title: Matthew 21:40
text: "When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those vine-dressers?"

title: Matthew 21:41
text: "He will utterly destroy those wretches," they answered, "and will entrust his vineyard to other vine-dressers, who will pay back the fruits to him in their season."

title: Matthew 21:42
text: "Have you never read in the Scriptures," Jesus answered, "how The stone that the builders rejected Has been made the corner-stone; This is the Lord's doing, It is wonderful in our eyes?

title: Matthew 21:43
text: "I tell you that for this reason the kingdom of God will be taken away from you, and will be given to a nation that does produce the fruit of it.

title: Matthew 21:44
text: "He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces; but he upon whom it falls will be scattered as dust."

title: Matthew 21:45
text: As they listened to his parables, the chief priests and the Pharisees recognized that he was speaking about them;

title: Matthew 21:46
text: but although they longed to apprehend him, they were afraid of the crowds, because they held him to be a prophet.

title: Matthew 22:1
text: Once more Jesus answered them in parables.

title: Matthew 22:2
text: "The kingdom of heaven," he said, "may be compared to a king who made a wedding-feast for his son.

title: Matthew 22:3
text: "He sent out his slaves to summon the invited guests to the feast, but they did not want to come.

title: Matthew 22:4
text: "Again he sent out other slaves. 'Tell the invited guests,' he said, 'that my luncheon is now ready; my oxen and fat cattle are killed; everything is ready; come to the wedding-feast.'

title: Matthew 22:5
text: "They, however, paid no attention, but went off, one to his own farm, another to his business;

title: Matthew 22:6
text: "while the rest seized his slaves and maltreated and murdered them.

title: Matthew 22:7
text: "Then the king's wrath was roused, and he sent his troops and destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.

title: Matthew 22:8
text: "Then he said to his slaves, "'The wedding-feast indeed is ready, but the invited guests were not worthy.

title: Matthew 22:9
text: "'So go out into the partings of the highways, and summon everybody you find there to the wedding-feast.'

title: Matthew 22:10
text: "So those slaves went out into the roads, and gathered together all whom they found, good or bad, and the banquet-hall was filled with the guests.

title: Matthew 22:11
text: "Then the king came in to inspect his guests, and he discovered there a man who had not put on a wedding-garment. He said to him,

title: Matthew 22:12
text: "'Friend, how did you come in here without a wedding-garment?' "The man was speechless.

title: Matthew 22:13
text: "'Bind him hand and foot, 'said the king to his officers, 'and cast him into the outer darkness; there will be the wailing and the gnashing of teeth.'

title: Matthew 22:14
text: "For there are many called, but few are chosen."

title: Matthew 22:15
text: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might ensnare him during conversation.

title: Matthew 22:16
text: So they sent their disciples to him, with the Herodians. "Teacher," they said, "we know that you are honest, and that you are teaching the way of God in sincerity; and are not afraid of any one, for you do not court men's favor.

title: Matthew 22:17
text: "Give us your advice, then: Is it allowable to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?"

title: Matthew 22:18
text: And Jesus, because he knew their malice, said:

title: Matthew 22:19
text: "Hypocrites! Why are you tempting me? Show me the tribute money." So they brought him a shilling.

title: Matthew 22:20
text: "Whose likeness and inscription is this?" he asked.

title: Matthew 22:21
text: "Caesar's," they answered. Then he said to them, "Render unto Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and unto God the things that are God's."

title: Matthew 22:22
text: When they heard this they were astonished, and left him and went away.

title: Matthew 22:23
text: That very day there came to him some Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection: and they questioned him.

title: Matthew 22:24
text: "Master," they said, "Moses taught that if a man dies without issue, his brother is to marry the widow, and raise up a family for his brother.

title: Matthew 22:25
text: "Now there were of our number seven brothers; and the first married and died. As he had no children, he left his wife to his brother;

title: Matthew 22:26
text: "In the same way the second also died, and the third, unto the seventh.

title: Matthew 22:27
text: "Last of all the woman died.

title: Matthew 22:28
text: "In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be? They all had her."

title: Matthew 22:29
text: In answer Jesus said: "You err because you do not know the Scriptures, nor the power of God.

title: Matthew 22:30
text: "For in the resurrection men do not marry, nor are women given in marriage, but they are like angels in heaven.

title: Matthew 22:31
text: "But concerning the resurrection of the dead, did you never read what was spoken to you by God,

title: Matthew 22:32
text: "I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living."

title: Matthew 22:33
text: And when the crowds heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.

title: Matthew 22:34
text: As soon as the Pharisees heard that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, they gathered themselves together,

title: Matthew 22:35
text: and one of them, a lawyer, tested him by asking a question:

title: Matthew 22:36
text: "Master, which is the great commandment in the law?"

title: Matthew 22:37
text: Jesus answered, "You shalt love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind.

title: Matthew 22:38
text: "This is the great and first commandment.

title: Matthew 22:39
text: "The second, which is like it, is this, "You shalt love your neighbor as thyself.

title: Matthew 22:40
text: "On these two commandments hang the whole law and the prophets."

title: Matthew 22:41
text: Now while the Pharisees were together, Jesus put this question to them:

title: Matthew 22:42
text: "What is your opinion concerning the Christ? Whose Son is he?" "David's," they answered.

title: Matthew 22:43
text: "How then, " he said, "does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

title: Matthew 22:44
text: "The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit You on my right hand Until I put thine enemies beneath your feet?

title: Matthew 22:45
text: "If David calls him Lord, how can he be his Son?"

title: Matthew 22:46
text: No one could answer him a word, nor did any one dare from that day to ask him another question.

title: Matthew 23:1
text: Then said Jesus to the crowds and to his disciples:

title: Matthew 23:2
text: "The Scribes and Pharisees sit in Moses' seat;

title: Matthew 23:3
text: "therefore do and observe whatever they bid you; but do not do as they do, for they preach, but do not practice.

title: Matthew 23:4
text: "For they bind heavy burdens and lay them on men's shoulders, but they themselves will not lift a finger to move them.

title: Matthew 23:5
text: "For they do all their good deeds to be gazed on of men. They widen their phylacteries,

title: Matthew 23:6
text: "and lengthen the tassels, and are fond of the best places at banquets, and the front seats in the synagogues.

title: Matthew 23:7
text: "They enjoy salutations in the market-places, and to have men call them 'Rabbi.'

title: Matthew 23:8
text: "But you are not to be called 'Rabbi'; for one is your Teacher, and you are all brothers;

title: Matthew 23:9
text: "and call no one 'Father' on earth, for One is your Father in heaven.

title: Matthew 23:10
text: "And call no one 'Leader,' because One is your leader, even the Christ.

title: Matthew 23:11
text: "Whoever is great among you shall be your minister;

title: Matthew 23:12
text: "whoever exalts himself shall be humbled, and he who humbles himself shall be exalted.

title: Matthew 23:13
text: "But woe unto you, Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You shut the kingdom of heaven in men's faces; for you do not enter, yourselves, nor do you permit those who are about to come in, to enter.

title: Matthew 23:14
text: (Is wanting in the oldest manuscripts.)

title: Matthew 23:15
text: "Woe unto you, Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you scour sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is gained, you make him twofold more a son of hell than you are, yourselves.

title: Matthew 23:16
text: "Woe unto you, blind guides, who say, If any one swears by the Sanctuary, it is nothing, but if any one swears by the gold of the Sanctuary, the oath is binding.

title: Matthew 23:17
text: "You fools and blind; for which is greater, the gold, or the Sanctuary which hallows the gold?

title: Matthew 23:18
text: "You say, too, that whoever swears by the alter, it is nothing, but whoever swears by the offering that is upon it, his oath is binding.

title: Matthew 23:19
text: "You blind! Which is greater, the offering or the altar which hallows the offering?

title: Matthew 23:20
text: "He then, who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it;

title: Matthew 23:21
text: "and he who swears by the Sanctuary swears by it and by Him who dwells therein;

title: Matthew 23:22
text: "and he who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by Him who sits thereon.

title: Matthew 23:23
text: "Woe unto you, Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint and anise and cummin, and neglect the weightier matters of the Law--justice and mercy and good faith; these latter you ought to have done, and not to have left the former undone.

title: Matthew 23:24
text: "You blind guides! who strain out the gnat and swallow the camel!

title: Matthew 23:25
text: "Woe unto you, Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and the plate, but within they are filled with extortion and excess.

title: Matthew 23:26
text: "You blind Pharisees, first clean the inside of the cup and of the plate, so that the outside of it may be clean also.

title: Matthew 23:27
text: "Woe unto you, Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You are like white-washed sepulchers. They look beautiful without, but within they are filled with dead men's bones and all rottenness.

title: Matthew 23:28
text: "Just so you also outwardly appear to men, just, but within you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.

title: Matthew 23:29
text: "Woe unto you, Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You rebuild the tombs of the prophets, and adorn the monuments of the righteous, and say,

title: Matthew 23:30
text: "'If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we would not have been their comrades in the murder of the prophets.'

title: Matthew 23:31
text: "So you bear witness against yourselves, that you are the descendants of those who slew the prophets!

title: Matthew 23:32
text: "Fill up then the measure of your fathers!

title: Matthew 23:33
text: "You serpents! You vipers brood! How shall you escape the judgment of hell?

title: Matthew 23:34
text: "For this cause, behold! I am sending you prophets and wise men and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; some of them you will scourge in your synagogues, and pursue from city to city;

title: Matthew 23:35
text: "that upon your heads may come every drop of innocent blood spilt upon the earth, from the blood of Abel, the just, to the blood of Zechariah the son of Berechiah, whom you murdered between the Sanctuary and the altar.

title: Matthew 23:36
text: "In solemn truth I tell you that all these things will come upon this generation.

title: Matthew 23:37
text: "O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, murdering the prophets, and stoning those who have been sent to you! How often would I have gathered your children together, as a hen gathers her chickens under her wings, and you would not!

title: Matthew 23:38
text: "Behold, your house is left to you desolate!

title: Matthew 23:39
text: "For I tell you that never shall you see me again until you say, "Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord."

title: Matthew 24:1
text: Then Jesus left the Temple courts and was walking away, when his disciples came to point out to him the Temple buildings.

title: Matthew 24:2
text: "You see all these buildings?" he answered them; "I tell you solemnly that there shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be torn down."

title: Matthew 24:3
text: When he had seated himself on the Mount of Olives, his disciples came to him privately, saying, "Tell us, when will these things happen, and what will be the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?"

title: Matthew 24:4
text: "Take care," Jesus answered, "that no one mislead you;

title: Matthew 24:5
text: "for many will come in my name saying, 'I am the Christ,' and will mislead many.

title: Matthew 24:6
text: "And you will hear of wars and rumors of wars; see to it that you are not afraid. Such things must happen, but the end is not yet.

title: Matthew 24:7
text: "For nation will rise against, nation, and kingdom against kingdom, and there will be famines and earthquakes in various places.

title: Matthew 24:8
text: "All these things are the beginning of birth-pangs.

title: Matthew 24:9
text: "Then they will deliver you up to suffer affliction, and will put you to death, and you will be hated by all nations for my name's sake.

title: Matthew 24:10
text: "And then many will stumble and fall, and will betray one another, and hate one another.

title: Matthew 24:11
text: "Many false prophets will rise up and mislead many;

title: Matthew 24:12
text: "and because of the increase of iniquity the love of the majority will grow cold;

title: Matthew 24:13
text: "but he who endures to the end will be saved.

title: Matthew 24:14
text: "And this gospel of the kingdom shall be proclaimed throughout the whole inhabited earth, for a testimony to the Gentiles, and then will come the end.

title: Matthew 24:15
text: "So when you see the Abomination of Desolation spoken of by the prophet Daniel, standing in the holy place let the reader take note of this,

title: Matthew 24:16
text: "then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains;

title: Matthew 24:17
text: "let him who is upon the housetop not go down to get the things in his house,

title: Matthew 24:18
text: "and the man in the field not turn back to get his cloak.

title: Matthew 24:19
text: "Alas for thee women who are with child, and for the nursing mothers in those days!

title: Matthew 24:20
text: "But pray that your flight may not be in the winter; nor on a Sabbath;

title: Matthew 24:21
text: "for then shall be a time of great tribulation, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, and never shall be again.

title: Matthew 24:22
text: "And if these days had not been shortened, no flesh would have been saved; but for the elect's sake these days will be cut short.

title: Matthew 24:23
text: "If at that time any one should say to you, 'See, here is the Christ!' or 'There he is!' believe him not.

title: Matthew 24:24
text: "For false christs and false prophets will arise, and will work great signs and wonders, so as to mislead, if it were possible, the very elect.

title: Matthew 24:25
text: "See, I have forewarned you! So if they say to you,

title: Matthew 24:26
text: "'See, He is in the desert,' do not go out there. "'See, He is in the inner room,' do not believe it.

title: Matthew 24:27
text: "For just as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west; so will be the coming of the Son of man.

title: Matthew 24:28
text: "Wherever the corpse lies, there will the vultures flock together.

title: Matthew 24:29
text: "But immediately after the tribulation of those days, "The sun will be darkened, The moon will not shed her light, The stars will fall from the sky, And the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

title: Matthew 24:30
text: "Then the signs of the Son of man will appear in the sky; and then all the tribes of the earth will lament, when they see the Son of man coming upon the clouds of heaven, with power and great glory.

title: Matthew 24:31
text: "And he will send forth his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather his elect together from the four winds, from utmost heaven to utmost earth.

title: Matthew 24:32
text: "Learn from the fig tree, her parable; when her branches are become soft, and put forth leaves, you know that summer is near;

title: Matthew 24:33
text: "so you also, when you see these signs, know that He is near, at the very doors.

title: Matthew 24:34
text: "I tell you in solemn truth, that the present generation shall not pass away till all these things happen.

title: Matthew 24:35
text: "Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

title: Matthew 24:36
text: "But no one knows about that day and hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

title: Matthew 24:37
text: "And as were the days of Noah, so will be the coming of the Son of man.

title: Matthew 24:38
text: "For just as in the days before the deluge they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the very day when Noah entered the ark,

title: Matthew 24:39
text: "nor did they know until the deluge came and swept them away; so will be the coming of the Son of man.

title: Matthew 24:40
text: "At that time there will be two men in the field; one will be taken, and one will be left.

title: Matthew 24:41
text: "Two women will be grinding at the mill; one will be taken and the other left.

title: Matthew 24:42
text: "Keep guard then, for you do not know the day on which your Master is coming.

title: Matthew 24:43
text: "But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch the thief was coming, he would have been on his guard, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

title: Matthew 24:44
text: "Therefore you also must be ready, for in an hour when you do not expect him, the Son of man is coming.

title: Matthew 24:45
text: "Who, then, is the faithful and prudent slave, to whom his master has entrusted his household, to give them their food in due season?

title: Matthew 24:46
text: "Blessed is that slave whom his Master, when he comes, shall find so doing.

title: Matthew 24:47
text: "In solemn truth I tell you that he will set him over all his property.

title: Matthew 24:48
text: "But if, because he is a bad slave, he should say to himself, 'My Master is a long time in coming,'

title: Matthew 24:49
text: "and if he begins to beat his fellow slaves, and to eat or drink with the drunkards,

title: Matthew 24:50
text: "on a day when he is not expecting him, and at an hour which he does not know, the Master of that servant will arrive

title: Matthew 24:51
text: "and will scourge him severely, and allot him a place among hypocrites, where will be weeping and gnashing of teeth."

title: Matthew 25:1
text: "Then will the kingdom of heaven be likened to ten maidens who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom and the bride.

title: Matthew 25:2
text: "And five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

title: Matthew 25:3
text: "The foolish took their lamps, but took no oil with them;

title: Matthew 25:4
text: "but the wise took oil in their flasks with their lamps.

title: Matthew 25:5
text: "Now because the bridegroom tarried, they all fell to nodding and went on sleeping.

title: Matthew 25:6
text: "But at midnight there arose a cry, "'Behold, the bridegroom! Go out to meet him!'

title: Matthew 25:7
text: "Then all those maidens rose and trimmed their lamps;

title: Matthew 25:8
text: "and the foolish said to the wise, "'Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.'

title: Matthew 25:9
text: "'Not so, answered the wise, 'for there may not be enough for you and for us. Go to the shops, rather, and buy some for yourselves.'

title: Matthew 25:10
text: "And while they were going away to buy, the bridegroom came; and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding-feast. And the door was shut.

title: Matthew 25:11
text: "Afterwards the other maidens came and cried, "'Lord, Lord, open unto us!'

title: Matthew 25:12
text: "'In solemn truth I tell you,' he replied, 'I know you not.'

title: Matthew 25:13
text: "Be watchful then, for you know neither the day nor the hour.

title: Matthew 25:14
text: "For it is like a man going into another country, who summoned his slaves, and committed his property to their care.

title: Matthew 25:15
text: "To one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another, one--to each according to his individual ability--and then set out on his travels.

title: Matthew 25:16
text: "At once the man who had received the five talents went out and traded with them, and made five talents more.

title: Matthew 25:17
text: "In the same way the one who got two talents made another two.

title: Matthew 25:18
text: "But he who had received the one talent went off, and dug a hole in the ground, and hid his master's money.

title: Matthew 25:19
text: "After a long time the master of those slaves came, and demanded a reckoning with them.

title: Matthew 25:20
text: "The man who had received the five talents came, bringing five more, and said: "'Master, five talents you entrusted to me; see, I have gained five more.'

title: Matthew 25:21
text: "'Well done, good and faithful slave,' replied his master; 'You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into your master's joy.'

title: Matthew 25:22
text: "The second, who had received the two talents, came up and said: "'Master, it was two talents that you entrusted to me; see, I have gained two more.'

title: Matthew 25:23
text: "'Well done, good and faithful slave,' his master replied, 'You have been faithful over many things; enter into your master's joy.'

title: Matthew 25:24
text: "Then the man who had received the one talent came up and said: "'Master, I knew you were a hard man, reaping where you had not sown, and gathering where you had not scattered;

title: Matthew 25:25
text: "so I was afraid; I went away and buried your talent in the earth. There, you have what belongs to you!'

title: Matthew 25:26
text: "'You wicked and lazy slave,' said his master. 'You say you knew that I reap where I have not sowed, and gather where I have not scattered?

title: Matthew 25:27
text: "'Then you ought to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my property with interest.

title: Matthew 25:28
text: "'So take away the talent from him, and give it to the man who has ten talents.

title: Matthew 25:29
text: "'(For to every one who has, it shall be given, and he shall have abundance; but from him who has not shall be taken away even what he has.)

title: Matthew 25:30
text: "'But cast out the worthless slave into the outer darkness; there will be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.'

title: Matthew 25:31
text: "But when the Son of man comes in his glory, and all the angels with him, then will he take his seat on the throne of his glory;

title: Matthew 25:32
text: "and all the nations will be gathered in his presence. And he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd divides his sheep from the goats;

title: Matthew 25:33
text: "and he will place the sheep on his right hand, and the goats on his left.

title: Matthew 25:34
text: "Then he, the King will say to those on his right hand: "'Come, my Father's blessed ones, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.

title: Matthew 25:35
text: "'For I was hungry, and you gave me food; I was thirsty, and you gave me drink; I was a stranger, and you took me in;

title: Matthew 25:36
text: "'I was naked, and you clothed me; I was sick, and you visited me; I was in prison, and you came to see me.'

title: Matthew 25:37
text: "Then shall the righteous answer him, saying: 'Master, when did we see you hungry and feed you; or thirsty and give you drink?

title: Matthew 25:38
text: "'When did we see you a stranger and take you in; or naked and clothe you?

title: Matthew 25:39
text: "'When did we see you sick or in prison, and come to see you?'

title: Matthew 25:40
text: "'In solemn truth I tell you,' the King will answer them, 'that inasmuch as you have done it unto one of the least of these, my brothers, you have done it unto me.'

title: Matthew 25:41
text: "Then he will say to those also at his left hand: 'Depart from me, accursed ones, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels;

title: Matthew 25:42
text: "for I was hungry, and you gave me no food; I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink;

title: Matthew 25:43
text: "I was a stranger, and you took me not in; naked, and you clothed me not; sick, or in prison, and you visited me not.'

title: Matthew 25:44
text: "Then will they also answer, 'Master, when did we ever see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister to you?'

title: Matthew 25:45
text: "But he will reply, 'In solemn truth I tell you that inasmuch as you did not do it unto one of these least, you did not do it unto me.'

title: Matthew 25:46
text: "And these will go away into eternal punishment; but the righteous into eternal life."

title: Matthew 26:1
text: Now it happened that after Jesus had finished all these discourses, he said to his disciples,

title: Matthew 26:2
text: "You know that the Passover is coming in two days, and the Son of man will be delivered up to be crucified."

title: Matthew 26:3
text: Then the chief priests and the elders of the people met together in the court of the palace of the high priest who was called Caiaphas,

title: Matthew 26:4
text: and they plotted together to get Jesus into their power by a trick, and to put him to death;

title: Matthew 26:5
text: but said they, "Not during the feast, for fear of causing a riot among the people."

title: Matthew 26:6
text: While Jesus was staying in Bethany, in the house of Simon the Leper,

title: Matthew 26:7
text: a woman came up to him who had an alabaster vase of very costly perfume, and poured it over his head, as he reclined at table.

title: Matthew 26:8
text: when the disciples saw it, they were indignant, and exclaimed:

title: Matthew 26:9
text: "Why is this waste? This perfume could have been sold for a good sum, and the money given to the poor."

title: Matthew 26:10
text: But when Jesus understood it he said to them: "Why are you annoying the woman? This is a beautiful deed she has done for me;

title: Matthew 26:11
text: "for the poor you have with you always, but me you will not always have.

title: Matthew 26:12
text: "In pouring this perfume on my body, she was preparing me for my burial.

title: Matthew 26:13
text: "In solemn truth I tell you that wherever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, what she has done shall be told about, as her memorial."

title: Matthew 26:14
text: It was then that one of the Twelve, he who was called Judas Iscariot,

title: Matthew 26:15
text: went to the chief priests and said, "What are you ready to give me for betraying him to you?" So they weighed him thirty pieces of silver;

title: Matthew 26:16
text: and from that time he kept looking for a chance to betray him.

title: Matthew 26:17
text: On the first day of the feast of Unleavened Bread, the disciples came to Jesus and said, "Where do you want us to make preparation for you to eat the Passover?"

title: Matthew 26:18
text: "Go into the city," he answered, "to a certain man, and tell him: "'The Teacher says: "My time is near. I am going to keep the Passover at your house, with my disciples."'"

title: Matthew 26:19
text: The disciples did as Jesus told them, and made ready the Passover.

title: Matthew 26:20
text: When evening came he reclined at table with the Twelve;

title: Matthew 26:21
text: and as they were eating, he said to them, "In solemn truth I tell you that one of you is going to betray me!"

title: Matthew 26:22
text: In deep distress they began to ask him, each in turn, "It is not I, is it, Master?"

title: Matthew 26:23
text: In reply he said: "One who has dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me.

title: Matthew 26:24
text: "The Son of man is indeed to go as it is written concerning him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of man shall be betrayed. It were good for that man if he had never been born."

title: Matthew 26:25
text: In answer, Judas, who betrayed him, said, "Surely it is not I, Rabbi?" He said to him, "Is it not?"

title: Matthew 26:26
text: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread and, when he had blessed it, he broke it and gave to his disciples, saying, "Take, eat, this is my body."

title: Matthew 26:27
text: And when he had taken the cup and given thanks, he gave it to them, saying:

title: Matthew 26:28
text: "Drink from it, all of you; for this is my blood of the Covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.

title: Matthew 26:29
text: "But I say to you, I will never again drink of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in the kingdom of my Father."

title: Matthew 26:30
text: So after singing a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

title: Matthew 26:31
text: Then Jesus said to them: "This very night even you will all stumble and fall away from me; for it is written, "I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.

title: Matthew 26:32
text: But after I am raised up I will go before you into Galilee."

title: Matthew 26:33
text: "If they all stumble and fall away from you," answered Peter, "I will never do so!"

title: Matthew 26:34
text: Jesus said to him, "In solemn truth I tell you that on this very night, before cockcrow, you will deny me three times!"

title: Matthew 26:35
text: But Peter said to him, "Even if I must die with you, I will never deny you." And so said all the disciples.

title: Matthew 26:36
text: Then Jesus went with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, "Sit down here, while I go and pray yonder."

title: Matthew 26:37
text: And he took Peter and the two sons of Zebedee with him, and began to be in anguish and sore distress,

title: Matthew 26:38
text: and he said to them: "My soul is an anguish, even unto death! Stay here, and keep watch with me."

title: Matthew 26:39
text: Then he went forward a short distance, and fell on his face and prayed: "O, my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me; nevertheless, not as I will, but as You wilt."

title: Matthew 26:40
text: Then he came to his disciples, and found them asleep, and said to Peter: "So you were none of you strong enough to watch with me even one hour!

title: Matthew 26:41
text: "Watch and pray that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak."

title: Matthew 26:42
text: Then he went away again a second time and prayed, saying, "O, my Father, if this cup cannot pass except I drink it, Your will be done."

title: Matthew 26:43
text: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

title: Matthew 26:44
text: So he left them and went away again, and prayed the third time in the same words as before.

title: Matthew 26:45
text: Then he came to the disciples and said: "Sleep on now, and take your rest. Look! the hour is at hand; the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of wicked men.

title: Matthew 26:46
text: "Rouse yourselves! Let us go. My betrayer is close at hand!"

title: Matthew 26:47
text: Barely had he spoken these words when Judas, one of the Twelve, appeared, accompanied by a great crowd of men with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

title: Matthew 26:48
text: Now his betrayer had given them a sign, saying: "Whoever I kiss is the man; arrest him."

title: Matthew 26:49
text: So he came straight up to Jesus and said, "Hail, Rabbi!" and kissed him eagerly.

title: Matthew 26:50
text: "Friend, do that for which you came," said Jesus. Then they came forward and laid hands on Jesus, and arrested him.

title: Matthew 26:51
text: And, behold, one of these who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and smote the slave of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

title: Matthew 26:52
text: Then Jesus said to him: "Put back your sword into its place! for all who take the sword will perish by the sword.

title: Matthew 26:53
text: "Do you not suppose that I am able to appeal to my Father to furnish me at this very moment with twelve legions of angels?

title: Matthew 26:54
text: "But if I did, how could the Scriptures be fulfilled that say that thus it must happen?"

title: Matthew 26:55
text: Then Jesus said to the crowds: "Are you come out as against a robber, with swords and staves to arrest me? Day after day, I sat in the temple courts teaching, and you did not apprehend me.

title: Matthew 26:56
text: "But all this has happened in order that the Scriptures might be fulfilled."

title: Matthew 26:57
text: Then all his disciples forsook him and fled; but those who had apprehended Jesus led him away to Caiaphas, the high priest, where the scribes and the elders had assembled.

title: Matthew 26:58
text: Now Peter was following him, afar off, as far as the courtyard of the high priest; and when he got in, he was sitting with the officers, to see the end.

title: Matthew 26:59
text: And the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were trying to get false evidence against Jesus, in order that they might have him executed;

title: Matthew 26:60
text: but they found none, although many false witnesses came forward.

title: Matthew 26:61
text: However, at last two came forward who said, "This fellow declared, 'I can destroy the Temple of God and build it in three days.'"

title: Matthew 26:62
text: Rising to his feet the high priest asked Jesus: "Do you make no answer? What is it that these are testifying against you?"

title: Matthew 26:63
text: But Jesus kept silence. Again the high priest addressed him, "I adjure you by the Living God, tell us if you are the Christ, the Son of God!"

title: Matthew 26:64
text: "I am He," Jesus answered; "yet I tell you that from this time on you will see the Son of man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming upon the clouds of heaven."

title: Matthew 26:65
text: Then the high priest tore his garments, saying: "He has spoken blasphemy! What further need have we of witnesses? For behold, now you have heard his blasphemy!

title: Matthew 26:66
text: "What is your verdict?" "He ought to die," they answered.

title: Matthew 26:67
text: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and some struck him with the palms of their hands, and cried:

title: Matthew 26:68
text: "Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who is it who struck you?"

title: Matthew 26:69
text: Now Peter was sitting outside in the courtyard, and one of the maidservants came up to him and said, "You also were with Jesus, the Galilean!"

title: Matthew 26:70
text: But he denied it before them all; "I do not know what you mean," he said.

title: Matthew 26:71
text: Soon afterward he went out into the porch, and another maid saw him, and said to those who were there, "This fellow certainly was with Jesus, the Nazarene!"

title: Matthew 26:72
text: And again he denied it with an oath, saying, "I never knew the man."

title: Matthew 26:73
text: A little later the bystanders came up and said to Peter, "You also are certainly one of them, for your speech betrays you."

title: Matthew 26:74
text: Then he began to curse and swear, saying, "I never knew the man." Immediately the cock crew!

title: Matthew 26:75
text: Then Peter recalled the word that Jesus had spoken, "Before the cock crow, you shall three times deny me"--and he went out and broke out into bitter weeping.

title: Matthew 27:1
text: And when the morning came, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus, how they might put him to death.

title: Matthew 27:2
text: After they had bound him, they led him away, and handed him over to Pilate, the Roman Governor.

title: Matthew 27:3
text: Then when Judas, his betrayer, saw that he was condemned, he repented and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders.

title: Matthew 27:4
text: "I have sinned," he said, "in betraying innocent blood!" "What is that to us?" they answered; "you must see to that."

title: Matthew 27:5
text: And flinging down the silver into the Sanctuary, he rushed out, and went and hanged himself.

title: Matthew 27:6
text: The chief priests took the money, and said, "It would be wrong to put it into the temple-treasury, because it is the price of blood."

title: Matthew 27:7
text: So after the consultation they bought the Potter's Field with it, for a burial-place for strangers.

title: Matthew 27:8
text: That is the reason why, to this day, the field is called "The Field of Blood."

title: Matthew 27:9
text: Then was fulfilled the word spoken by the prophet Jeremiah: And I took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him who had been priced, whom certain of the Children of Israel had priced;

title: Matthew 27:10
text: and gave them for the Potter's Field, as the Lord had appointed me.

title: Matthew 27:11
text: Now Jesus stood before the Governor, and the Governor questioned him. "Are you the King of the Jews?" he asked.

title: Matthew 27:12
text: "it is as you say," answered Jesus; but while he was being accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

title: Matthew 27:13
text: Then Pilate said to him, "Do you not hear what they are testifying against you?"

title: Matthew 27:14
text: But he made no answer, not even to one charge; insomuch that the Governor was greatly astonished.

title: Matthew 27:15
text: Now it was the Governor's custom, during the Passover, to release to the people any one prisoner whom they selected.

title: Matthew 27:16
text: At that time they had a notorious prisoner named Barabbas.

title: Matthew 27:17
text: So when they had assembled, Pilate said to them, "Whom do you want me to release to you, Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?"

title: Matthew 27:18
text: He knew well that it was because of enmity that they had brought Jesus before him.

title: Matthew 27:19
text: And while he was seated upon the judgment-seat, his wife had sent to him, saying, "Have nothing to do with that innocent man, for I have suffered many things today, in a dream, because of him."

title: Matthew 27:20
text: But the chief priests and the elders urged the crowds to ask for Barabbas, and to destroy Jesus.

title: Matthew 27:21
text: So when Pilate said to them, "Which of the two do you want me to release unto you?" they said, "Barabbas."

title: Matthew 27:22
text: And Pilate asked, "What then shall I do with Jesus, who is called Christ?" What one voice they shouted, "Let him be crucified!"

title: Matthew 27:23
text: But Pilate said, "Why, what evil has he done?" But they kept shouting the more fiercely, "Let him be crucified!"

title: Matthew 27:24
text: So when Pilate saw that he was accomplishing nothing, but that on the contrary a riot was threatening, he took water and washed his hands in the presence of the crowd, saying: "I am innocent of the blood of this man; you must answer for it."

title: Matthew 27:25
text: All the people answered, "His blood be upon us and upon our children."

title: Matthew 27:26
text: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he scourged, and delivered to be crucified.

title: Matthew 27:27
text: Then the soldiers of the Governor took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered all the battalion together.

title: Matthew 27:28
text: They stripped him and put on him a scarlet robe.

title: Matthew 27:29
text: And they twisted a thorny crown for him, and put it on his head, and placed a reed in his right hand. Then they knelt before him, in mockery, crying, "Hail, King of the Jews!"

title: Matthew 27:30
text: And they spit upon him, and took the reed and struck him on the head, again and again.

title: Matthew 27:31
text: At last, when they had finished their mocking, they took the robe off, and put his own garments on him, and led him away to crucify him.

title: Matthew 27:32
text: And as they went out they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, whom they compelled to go with them to carry his cross.

title: Matthew 27:33
text: And when they came to a place called Golgotha (the word means "Place of a Skull"),

title: Matthew 27:34
text: they gave Jesus wine to drink, mingled with gall. But after tasting it he refused to drink it.

title: Matthew 27:35
text: After crucifying him, they parted his garments among them by casting lots.

title: Matthew 27:36
text: Then they sat and watched him there.

title: Matthew 27:37
text: They also placed above his head his accusation written, This is Jesus The King of the Jews

title: Matthew 27:38
text: At that time two robbers, also, were crucified with him; one on his right hand, the other on his left.

title: Matthew 27:39
text: Those who passed by, reviled him, wagging their heads saying:

title: Matthew 27:40
text: "You who were going to destroy the Temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!"

title: Matthew 27:41
text: In like manner the chief priests, too, with the Scribes and elders, kept taunting him:

title: Matthew 27:42
text: "He saved others," they said, "himself he cannot save. He, the King of Israel! Let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe on him!

title: Matthew 27:43
text: He put his trust in God: let Him deliver him now, if He cares for him. For he said, `I am the Son of God!'"

title: Matthew 27:44
text: In the same way the robbers also who were being crucified with him, dept reviling him.

title: Matthew 27:45
text: Now from noon darkness fell upon the whole land, until three o'clock in the afternoon.

title: Matthew 27:46
text: But at three o'clock Jesus cried out in loud voice, "Eli, Eli, Lama Sabachthani?" (That is to say, "My God, my God, why hast You forsaken me?")

title: Matthew 27:47
text: When they heard this, some of the bystanders said "He is calling for Elijah!"

title: Matthew 27:48
text: At once, one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filling it with vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.

title: Matthew 27:49
text: But the rest said: "Let be! Let us see whether Elijah is coming to save him!"

title: Matthew 27:50
text: And Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

title: Matthew 27:51
text: And lo, the veil of the sanctuary was torn in two, from the top to the bottom;

title: Matthew 27:52
text: the earth quaked; the rocks split; the tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised.

title: Matthew 27:53
text: And coming forth out of the tombs, after his resurrection, they went into the holy city and appeared to many.

title: Matthew 27:54
text: When the Roman captain and the soldiers who were with him, guarding Jesus, saw the earthquake and all that happened, they were greatly terrified and said, "Certainly this man must have been God's Son."

title: Matthew 27:55
text: And there were present several women who were looking on from a distance; they had followed Jesus from a Galilee, ministering to him:

title: Matthew 27:56
text: among them being Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's sons.

title: Matthew 27:57
text: When it was eventide, there came a rich man of Arimathea, named Joseph, who was himself a disciple of Jesus.

title: Matthew 27:58
text: This man went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.

title: Matthew 27:59
text: Pilate then commanded that it be given over to him.

title: Matthew 27:60
text: So Joseph took the body, and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth, and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut in the rock; and after rolling a great stone against the opening of the tomb, he went away.

title: Matthew 27:61
text: And Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

title: Matthew 27:62
text: The day after--that is, the day following the Preparation--the chief priests and Pharisees went in a body to Pilate and said:

title: Matthew 27:63
text: "We recollect, Sir, that when he was living this imposter said, `I will rise again after three days.'

title: Matthew 27:64
text: Now therefore give orders to have the sepulcher securely guarded until the third day, for fear his disciples may come and steal him away, and then tell the people, `He is risen from the dead'; and so the last error will be worse than the first."

title: Matthew 27:65
text: "You can have a guard," said Pilate. "Go your way, make it as secure as you can."

title: Matthew 27:66
text: So they went and made the sepulcher secure, by sealing the stone in the presence of the guard.

title: Matthew 28:1
text: At the end of the Sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came down to see the sepulcher, when lo!

title: Matthew 28:2
text: There had been a great earthquake; for an angel of the Lord had come down from heaven, and gone and rolled away the stone, and was sitting upon it.

title: Matthew 28:3
text: His appearance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow.

title: Matthew 28:4
text: The guards trembled for fear of him, and became like dead men.

title: Matthew 28:5
text: But to the women the angel said: "You need have no fear, for I know that you are seeking Jesus, the Crucified One.

title: Matthew 28:6
text: He is not here; for he is risen, even as he said. Come, see the place where the Master was lying!

title: Matthew 28:7
text: And go quickly and tell his disciples: `He is risen from the dead; he goes before you into Galilee; you will see him there.' Remember, I have told you."

title: Matthew 28:8
text: On this they ran quickly from the sepulcher, in fear and great joy, to tell the news to his disciples.

title: Matthew 28:9
text: And behold! Jesus himself met them, saying, "All hail!" And they went up to him and clasped his feet and worshiped him.

title: Matthew 28:10
text: Then Jesus said to them: "Fear not! Go tell my brothers to depart into Galilee, and they will see men there."

title: Matthew 28:11
text: Now while they were on their way, some of the guard went into the city and told the high priest all that had happened.

title: Matthew 28:12
text: And when they had met with the elders and conferred together, they heavily bribed the soldiers and told them to say,

title: Matthew 28:13
text: "His disciples came by night and stole him away, while we were asleep."

title: Matthew 28:14
text: "If this should reach the Governor's ears," they said, "we will satisfy him and screen you from punishment."

title: Matthew 28:15
text: So the soldiers took the money, and did as they were told; and this story has been noised abroad among the Jews, and continues to this day.

title: Matthew 28:16
text: But the eleven disciples went away to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had appointed them.

title: Matthew 28:17
text: And when they saw him they worshiped him; but some doubted.

title: Matthew 28:18
text: And Jesus came forward to them and spoke to them, saying: "All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

title: Matthew 28:19
text: Go, therefore, and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them into the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit;

title: Matthew 28:20
text: teaching them to observe every command which I have given you: and lo! I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world."

title: Mark 1:1
text: Beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;

title: Mark 1:2
text: even as it is written in the prophet Isaiah,/@Behold, I am sending my messenger before your face to prepare your way.

title: Mark 1:3
text: The voice of one crying aloud: In the desert make ready a road for the Lord. Make his paths straight/@.

title: Mark 1:4
text: In the desert came John who baptized, and preached a baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;

title: Mark 1:5
text: and all the land of Judea, and all the people of Jerusalem, kept going out to him, and were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.

title: Mark 1:6
text: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and he had a leather girdle round his loins, and he ate locusts, and "honey of the wood."

title: Mark 1:7
text: He made proclamation: "There is One mightier than I coming after me, and I am not worthy to stoop down and unfasten his sandal strap;

title: Mark 1:8
text: I have baptized you in water, but he shall baptize you in the Holy Spirit."

title: Mark 1:9
text: It was at that time that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan;

title: Mark 1:10
text: and as soon as he rose from the water he saw the sky cleft asunder, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him,

title: Mark 1:11
text: and a voice from the sky: "Thou art my Son, my beloved; in thee is my delight."

title: Mark 1:12
text: Then the Spirit drove him at once into the desert,

title: Mark 1:13
text: and he remained in the desert for forty days, tempted by Satan; and he was among the wild beasts, but the angels were ministering to him.

title: Mark 1:14
text: After John had been thrown into prison Jesus came into Galilee preaching the gospel of God.

title: Mark 1:15
text: "The time is now come," he said, "and the kingdom of God is near! Repent and believe the gospel."

title: Mark 1:16
text: And as he was passing along by the sea of Galilee he saw Simon and Andrew, Simon's brother, casting their net into the sea, for they were fishermen;

title: Mark 1:17
text: so Jesus said to them, "Come after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men."

title: Mark 1:18
text: At once they left their nets and followed him.

title: Mark 1:19
text: As he went a little farther on he saw James, the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in their boat mending the nets.

title: Mark 1:20
text: Straightway he called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants and went after him.

title: Mark 1:21
text: So they came to Capernaum, and as soon as the Sabbath Day came he went into the synagogue and began to teach.

title: Mark 1:22
text: They were astonished at his teaching, for he was teaching them with authority, not like the Scribes.

title: Mark 1:23
text: And at that very moment, there in their synagogue, a man in the grip of an unclean spirit shrieked out:

title: Mark 1:24
text: "What business have you with us, you Jesus of Nazareth? Are you come to destroy us? I know you who you are, the Holy One of God."

title: Mark 1:25
text: But Jesus rebuked him, saying: "Be quiet! Come out of him."

title: Mark 1:26
text: So the unclean spirit, after tearing him, came out of him with a loud cry;

title: Mark 1:27
text: and every one was amazed so that they began questioning among themselves: "What does this mean? A new teaching with authority? He lays commands even upon unclean spirits and they obey him."

title: Mark 1:28
text: And at once his fame spread everywhere through that part of Galilee.

title: Mark 1:29
text: On leaving the synagogue they went at once with James and John to the house of Simon and Andrew.

title: Mark 1:30
text: Now Simon's mother-in-law lay sick of fever, and without delay they told him about her.

title: Mark 1:31
text: So he came and took her hand and raised her up. The fever left her at once, and she began to wait upon them.

title: Mark 1:32
text: At evening when the sun had set, people came and brought to him all the sick and demon-possessed,

title: Mark 1:33
text: and the whole town was gathered at the door.

title: Mark 1:34
text: He cured many who were ill with various diseases, and drove out many demons. But he did not allow the demons to speak, because they knew who he was.

title: Mark 1:35
text: In the morning he rose a great while before day and went out to a desert place, and there prayed.

title: Mark 1:36
text: And Simon and his companions hunted him up,

title: Mark 1:37
text: and told him, "Every one is looking for you."

title: Mark 1:38
text: "Let us go away," he answered, "to the neighboring country towns, that I may preach there, too; because for that purpose I came forth."

title: Mark 1:39
text: So he went throughout Galilee, preaching in the synagogues and driving out demons.

title: Mark 1:40
text: One day a leper cane to him and besought him as he knelt down to him, saying, "If you choose, you are able to cleanse me."

title: Mark 1:41
text: Jesus, moved with compassion, put out his hand and touched him, saying, "I do choose, be clean!"

title: Mark 1:42
text: The leprosy at once left him, and he was made clean.

title: Mark 1:43
text: Jesus immediately sent him away, charging him sternly and saying:

title: Mark 1:44
text: "See you say nothing to any one; but go your way, show yourself to the priest, and offer for your purification what Moses commanded for a testimony to them."

title: Mark 1:45
text: But he went out and began to tell every one and to publish it broadcast, so that Jesus could no longer enter any town openly; but he had to remain outside in lonely places, and people kept coming to him from every quarter.

title: Mark 2:1
text: Some days later when Jesus entered Capernaum again the news spread, "He is in the house";

title: Mark 2:2
text: and at once such a crowd gathered that there was no longer room for them, even around the door.

title: Mark 2:3
text: While he was speaking his message, they came bringing to him a paralytic, carried by four men.

title: Mark 2:4
text: When they could not get him near to Jesus because of the crowd, they removed the roof under which he stood, and after making an opening, they let down the cot on which the paralytic was lying.

title: Mark 2:5
text: Then Jesus, when he perceived their faith, said to the paralytic, "Son your sins are forgiven."

title: Mark 2:6
text: But there were some Scribes sitting there who reasoned in their hearts:

title: Mark 2:7
text: "Why does this man speak like this? He blasphemes. Who is able to forgive sins but One, God himself?"

title: Mark 2:8
text: Jesus clearly perceived at once be the Spirit that they were thus reasoning in their hearts and said to them:

title: Mark 2:9
text: "Why do you reason thus in your hearts? Which is easier, to say to the paralytic, 'Your sins are forgiven,' or to say, 'Rise, take up your cot and walk'?

title: Mark 2:10
text: But to let you see that the Son of man has authority on earth to forgive sins" --he said to the paralytic--

title: Mark 2:11
text: "I bid you rise, take up your cot, and go home."

title: Mark 2:12
text: The man rose, at once took up his cot, and went out before them all; at which they were all astounded, and gave God glory, saying, "We never saw anything like this."

title: Mark 2:13
text: Then Jesus went again to the seaside, and the whole crowd kept coming to him, and he taught them.

title: Mark 2:14
text: As he was passing by he saw Levi, the son of Alphaeus, sitting in the tax-office; and he said to him, "Follow me." So he rose and followed him.

title: Mark 2:15
text: Later on Levi was sitting at table in his house, and together with Jesus and his disciples a number of tax-gatherers and sinners were guests, for there were many of them who used to follow him.

title: Mark 2:16
text: But when some scribes of the Pharisees saw him eating with the sinners and tax-gatherers, they said to his disciples, "Is he eating and drinking with tax-gatherers and sinners?"

title: Mark 2:17
text: On hearing this Jesus said to them: "It is not the healthy who need a physician, but the sick. I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners."

title: Mark 2:18
text: Now the disciples of John and the Pharisees were keeping a fast, and people came to ask him, "How is it that the disciples of John and the Pharisees are fasting, but your disciples are not?"

title: Mark 2:19
text: "Can friends of the bridegroom fast while he is still with them?" asked Jesus. "As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.

title: Mark 2:20
text: But the days will come when the Bridegroom will be taken away from them; then, on that day, they will fast.

title: Mark 2:21
text: No one ever sews a piece of unshrunk cloth onto an old garment, otherwise the patch tears away from it--the new from the old--and a worse tear is made.

title: Mark 2:22
text: And no one ever pours new wine into old wine-skins, else the wine would burst the skins, and both wine and skins would be lost. New wine is poured into fresh wine-skins.

title: Mark 2:23
