text: But Pilate wondered whether he were already dead. So he summoned the army captain, and inquired if he had been any time dead;

title: Mark 15:45
text: and when he learned the fact from the army captain he gave the body to Joseph.

title: Mark 15:46
text: So Joseph bought him a sheet, and took Jesus down, wound him in the sheet, and laid him in a tomb which had been hewn out of a rock, and then rolled a stone against the opening of the tomb;

title: Mark 15:47
text: and Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses were watching to see where he was laid.

title: Mark 16:1
text: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James, and Salome brought spices in order to go and anoint him.

title: Mark 16:2
text: And very early in the morning, on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb as the sun was rising;

title: Mark 16:3
text: and they kept saying to one another, "Who will roll away the stone for us from the door of the tomb?"

title: Mark 16:4
text: But then as they looked up they saw that the stone, which was a very large one, was already rolled away;

title: Mark 16:5
text: and upon entering the tomb they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a white robe.

title: Mark 16:6
text: They were terrified, but he said to them: "Do not be terrified! You are seeking Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified? He is risen; he is not here. See, the place where they laid him!

title: Mark 16:7
text: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, "'He is going before you into Galilee, where you will see him, as he told you.'"

title: Mark 16:8
text: So they went out, and ran from the tomb, for they were trembling and amazed; and they said nothing to any one, for they were afraid--

title: Mark 16:9
text: Now after his resurrection, early on the first day of the week he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had driven out seven demons.

title: Mark 16:10
text: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

title: Mark 16:11
text: But they, although they heard that he was living and had been seen by her did not believe it.

title: Mark 16:12
text: After this he appeared in another form to two of them as they were walking on their way into the country.

title: Mark 16:13
text: They too went, and told the others; but they did not believe them, either.

title: Mark 16:14
text: Afterward he appeared to the Eleven themselves, as they were eating, and reproached them for their lack of faith, and stubborn hearts, because they disbelieved those who had seen him risen.

title: Mark 16:15
text: And he said to them: "Go into all the world and preach the gospel to the whole creation.

title: Mark 16:16
text: He who believes and is baptized shall be saved, but he who disbelieves shall be condemned.

title: Mark 16:17
text: Moreover these signs shall follow those who believe: They shall drive out demons in my name; they shall speak with new tongues in foreign languages;

title: Mark 16:18
text: they shall pick up serpents, and if they drink any poison it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick and they shall recover."

title: Mark 16:19
text: So then the Lord Jesus, after he had spoken to them, was taken up into heaven, and sat down at the right hand of God.

title: Mark 16:20
text: But they went forth and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the message by the miracles which followed.

title: Luke 1:1
text: Seeing that many have taken it in hand to draw up an account of those matters which have been fully established among us,

title: Luke 1:2
text: just as they reported them to us, who were from beginning eye-witnesses and ministers of the word,

title: Luke 1:3
text: it seemed good to me also accurately, from the very beginning, to write them to you in order, most excellent Theophilus,

title: Luke 1:4
text: so that you may know the certainty of the story which you have been taught by the word of mouth.

title: Luke 1:5
text: In the reign of Herod, King of Judea, there was a certain priest, named Zachariah, belonging to the class of Abijah. He had a wife named Elizabeth,

title: Luke 1:6
text: who was a descendant of Aaron. They were both righteous in the sight of the Lord, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the law, blameless.

title: Luke 1:7
text: Now they had no child, for Elizabeth was barren, and both were far advanced in years.

title: Luke 1:8
text: Now while Zachariah was acting as priest before God in the due course of his class, it fell to his lot, according to the custom of priesthood,

title: Luke 1:9
text: to enter into the sanctuary of the Lord and to burn incense.

title: Luke 1:10
text: And the whole multitude of the people were without, praying at the hour of incense.

title: Luke 1:11
text: Then there appeared to him an angel of the Lord, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

title: Luke 1:12
text: And as he saw him Zachariah was troubled, and fear fell upon him.

title: Luke 1:13
text: But the Angel said to him: "Do not be afraid, Zachariah, because your petition has been heard, and your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you are to call him John.

title: Luke 1:14
text: "And he shall be to you a joy and an exultation, and many shall rejoice over his birth.

title: Luke 1:15
text: "For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, "He shall drink neither wine nor strong drink, "He shall be filled with the Holy Spirit from the hour of his birth,

title: Luke 1:16
text: "And shall win many of the sons of Israel to the Lord, their God.

title: Luke 1:17
text: "He shall go before Him in the wisdom and power of Elijah to turn the hearts of the fathers to their children and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous, and so to make ready for the Lord a people prepared for him."

title: Luke 1:18
text: "How shall I be sure of this?" said Zachariah to the Angel. "For I am an old man and my wife is advanced in years."

title: Luke 1:19
text: "I am Gabriel," answered the angel, "who stand in the presence of God; and I have been sent to speak to you and to bring and to bring you this good news.

title: Luke 1:20
text: "And now you shall be silent and unable to speak until the day the day when this has taken place; because you did not believe my words--Words which will be fulfilled at their appointed time."

title: Luke 1:21
text: Meanwhile the people were waiting for Zachariah and wondering why he stayed so long in the sanctuary.

title: Luke 1:22
text: And when he came out he could not speak to them, and then they knew that he had seen a vision in the sanctuary. He kept making signs to them and remained dumb.

title: Luke 1:23
text: As soon as his term of priestly service was ended he went home;

title: Luke 1:24
text: and after those days Elizabeth, his wife, Conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying:

title: Luke 1:25
text: "This has the Lord done for me. He has now deigned to take the away my reproach among men."

title: Luke 1:26
text: Six months later the angel Gabriel was sent by God to a town in Galilee, called Nazareth,

title: Luke 1:27
text: to a maiden betrothed to a man named Joseph, a descendant of David. Her name was Mary.

title: Luke 1:28
text: The angel went in and said to her: " Joy to you, highly favored one! "The Lord is with you."

title: Luke 1:29
text: Mary was greatly agitated at his word, and was revolving in her mind what this salutation could mean.

title: Luke 1:30
text: when the angel said to her: "Fear not Mary, for you have found grace with God.

title: Luke 1:31
text: "And behold, you shall conceive in your womb and bear a son; and you shall call his name Jesus.

title: Luke 1:32
text: "He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Most High. "And the Lord God will give him the throne of his forefather David,

title: Luke 1:33
text: "and he shall reign over the House of Jacob forever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end."

title: Luke 1:34
text: And Mary said to the angel: "How can this be? For I have no husband?"

title: Luke 1:35
text: "The Holy Spirit shall come upon you," said the angel, "and the power of the most High shall overshadow you, and therefore the holy offspring which is born, shall be called the son of God.

title: Luke 1:36
text: "And behold your kinswoman, Elizabeth, she also has conceived a son in her old age, and this was the sixth month with her that was called barren.

title: Luke 1:37
text: "For no word of God shall be void of power."

title: Luke 1:38
text: Then Mary said: "Behold I am Lord's slave. Let it be to me as you have said." Then the angel departed from her.

title: Luke 1:39
text: Soon after this Mary set out and hastened unto the hill-country to a town in Judah;

title: Luke 1:40
text: and there she came into the house of Zachariah, and greeted Elizabeth.

title: Luke 1:41
text: And when Elizabeth heard her salutation, the babe leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth herself was filled with the Holy Spirit,

title: Luke 1:42
text: and called out with a loud cry: "Blessed are you among women, and blessed is your unborn child!

title: Luke 1:43
text: "But why is this honor done me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

title: Luke 1:44
text: "For behold when the sound of your salutation reached my ears, the babe leaped with joy within my womb.

title: Luke 1:45
text: "And blessed is she who believed that the Lord's words spoken to her would be fulfilled."

title: Luke 1:46
text: And Mary said: "My soul doth magnify the Lord,

title: Luke 1:47
text: "My spirit exults in the God, who is my Saviour,

title: Luke 1:48
text: "For he has regarded the humiliation of his slave, And from this hour all ages will count me blessed.

title: Luke 1:49
text: "For he who is mighty has done great things for me; And holy is his name.

title: Luke 1:50
text: "His mercy is unto generations and generations on those who reverence him.

title: Luke 1:51
text: "He has showed strength with his arm: "He has scattered proud in the imagination of their hearts;

title: Luke 1:52
text: "he has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted those of low degree.

title: Luke 1:53
text: "The hungry he has filled with good things, But the rich he has sent empty away.

title: Luke 1:54
text: "He has helped Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,

title: Luke 1:55
text: "As he spoke to our forefathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever."

title: Luke 1:56
text: So Mary stayed with Elizabeth about three months and then returned home.

title: Luke 1:57
text: Now when the time of Elizabeth's delivery was come, she gave birth to a son;

title: Luke 1:58
text: and her neighbors and kinsfolk heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her; and they rejoiced with her,

title: Luke 1:59
text: and came on the eighth day to circumcise the child. They were about to call him "Zachariah," after his father,

title: Luke 1:60
text: when his mother said, "No, he is to be called John."

title: Luke 1:61
text: Said they, "You have no relatives of that name!"

title: Luke 1:62
text: Then they asked his father by signs what he wished to call the child.

title: Luke 1:63
text: So he asked for a writing tablet and wrote down, "His name is John."

title: Luke 1:64
text: Every one was surprised, and at once his mouth was opened and his tongue loosed, and he spoke, blessing God.

title: Luke 1:65
text: And there came a great fear upon all in the neighborhood; and throughout the hill country of Judea all these sayings were much talked about.

title: Luke 1:66
text: All who heard the story laid it up in their hearts, saying "What, then, will this child be?" For the Lord's hands was with him.

title: Luke 1:67
text: And his father, Zachariah, was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied, saying:

title: Luke 1:68
text: "Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, For he has visited and redeemed his people,

title: Luke 1:69
text: "And has raised up a mighty Deliverer for us In the house of his servant David,

title: Luke 1:70
text: "As he spake by the mouth of his holy Prophets Which have been since the world began

title: Luke 1:71
text: To deliver us from our enemies, and from the power Of all who hate us.

title: Luke 1:72
text: "He showed mercy to our forefathers, He remembered his holy covenant,

title: Luke 1:73
text: "The oath which he swore to Abraham, our forefather,

title: Luke 1:74
text: "That he we should be delivered out of the Hand of our enemies, And should serve him without fear,

title: Luke 1:75
text: "In holiness and righteousness before him All our days.

title: Luke 1:76
text: "And thou, child, shalt be called the Prophet of the Most High, For thou shalt go before the Lord to prepare the way

title: Luke 1:77
text: "To give to his people a knowledge of salvation Through the remission of their sins,

title: Luke 1:78
text: "Through the heart of mercy of our God, Whereby the Dayspring from on high shall visit us,

title: Luke 1:79
text: "To give light to those who sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, And to guide our feet into the paths of peace."

title: Luke 1:80
text: And the child grew, and became strong in the Spirit, and remained ever in the desert till the day of his showing to Israel.

title: Luke 2:1
text: In those days Augustus Caesar issued an edict for a census of the whole inhabited world.

title: Luke 2:2
text: This was the first census, when Quirinius was governor of Syria.

title: Luke 2:3
text: And every one went to be registered, each to the town to which he belonged.

title: Luke 2:4
text: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city if Nazareth, into Judea, to David's town of Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David.

title: Luke 2:5
text: He went to be registered along with Mary, who was espoused to him, and was pregnant.

title: Luke 2:6
text: But while they were there the days were fulfilled for her delivery.

title: Luke 2:7
text: And she gave birth to her firstborn son; and she wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger because there was no room for them in the inn.

title: Luke 2:8
text: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the fields, keeping watch over their flocks by night.

title: Luke 2:9
text: When suddenly an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone round them; and they feared with a great fear. The angel said to them:

title: Luke 2:10
text: "Have no fear, for behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be for all the people.

title: Luke 2:11
text: "For unto you born this day in there is born in David's town a Saviour, who is the Anointed Lord.

title: Luke 2:12
text: "And this is a sign to you; You shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling-clothes lying in a manger."

title: Luke 2:13
text: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the Heavenly army praising God and saying,

title: Luke 2:14
text: /@"Glory to God in the highest, And in earth peace among men who please him"/@

title: Luke 2:15
text: Now when the angels had left them, and gone away to heaven, the shepherds said to one to another, "Let us go now even to Bethlehem, and see this saying which has come to pass, which the Lord has made known to us."

title: Luke 2:16
text: so they made haste, and came and found Mary and Joseph, and the babe lying in the manger.

title: Luke 2:17
text: When they had seen, they made known about the words which had been spoken to them concerning the child.

title: Luke 2:18
text: And all who heard it were astonished at the things which were told them by the shepherds.

title: Luke 2:19
text: But Mary treasured up all those words, often pondering on them in her heart.

title: Luke 2:20
text: And the shepherds returned, glorifying God and praising him for all the things that they had seen and heard, even as it was told them.

title: Luke 2:21
text: When eight days had passed, and the time had come to circumcise him, he was called Jesus, the name given him by the angel before his conception in the womb.

title: Luke 2:22
text: And when the days for their purification according to the law of Moses had passed, they took him up to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord,

title: Luke 2:23
text: as it is written in the law of Moses, /@Every firstborn male shall be called holy to the Lord./@

title: Luke 2:24
text: And they also offered a sacrifice as commanded in the Law of the Lord /@A pair of turtle-doves or two young pigeons/@.

title: Luke 2:25
text: Now there was in Jerusalem a man whose name was Simeon. He was righteous and devout, and was waiting for the consolation of Israel. The Holy Spirit was upon him.

title: Luke 2:26
text: Now it has been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.

title: Luke 2:27
text: And he came into the Temple, led by the Spirit. And when his parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him according to the custom of the law,

title: Luke 2:28
text: he took him up in his arms and blessed God and said,

title: Luke 2:29
text: "Now lettest thou thy slave depart, O Master; according to thy word, in peace,

title: Luke 2:30
text: "Because my eyes have seen thy salvation,

title: Luke 2:31
text: "Which thou hast prepared before the face of all peoples;

title: Luke 2:32
text: "A light for the unveiling of the Gentiles And the glory of thy people Israel."

title: Luke 2:33
text: And while his father and mother were marveling at the words that were spoken concerning him, Simeon blessed them and said to Mary, his mother:

title: Luke 2:34
text: "Behold, this child is set for the falling and rising up of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.

title: Luke 2:35
text: Yea, and a sword shall pierce through your own soul also, that the thoughts out of many hearts may be revealed."

title: Luke 2:36
text: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher. She was advanced in age, having lived with her husband seven years, after her girlhood,

title: Luke 2:37
text: and then being a widow even for fourscore and four years. She departed not from the temple, but worshiped with the fasting and prayer, night and day.

title: Luke 2:38
text: She came up at that very hour, and gave thanks to God, and spoke of the child to all who were looking for the redemption of Jerusalem.

title: Luke 2:39
text: As soon as all that the law required had been done, they returned to Galilee to their own town, Nazareth.

title: Luke 2:40
text: And the child grew and became strong, becoming full of wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.

title: Luke 2:41
text: Now his parents were accustomed to go up to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the Passover.

title: Luke 2:42
text: And when he was twelve years old they went up, as was customary, at the time of the feast

title: Luke 2:43
text: After spending the full number of days they started home, but the boy Jesus remained behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother did not know this,

title: Luke 2:44
text: but supposed that he was in the company, and went a day's journey. Then they hunted for him among his kinsfolk and acquaintance;

title: Luke 2:45
text: and when they did not find him they returned to Jerusalem, making anxious inquiry for him.

title: Luke 2:46
text: On the third day they found him sitting in the Temple, among the Rabbis, both listening to them and asking them questions.

title: Luke 2:47
text: All that heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.

title: Luke 2:48
text: When they saw him they were astonished, and his mother said to him, "Child, why have you treated us so? Behold your father and I have been looking for you in anguish."

title: Luke 2:49
text: He answered, "Why is it that you have been looking for me, did you not realize that I had to be in my Father's house?"

title: Luke 2:50
text: But they did not understand the words that he spoke to them.

title: Luke 2:51
text: Then he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and he was always obedient to them. But his mother kept treasuring up all these incidents in her heart.

title: Luke 2:52
text: And Jesus was ever advancing in wisdom and in status and in favor with God and man.

title: Luke 3:1
text: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, when Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, and Herod was tetrarch of Galilee, his brother Philip, tetrarch of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias, tetrarch of Abilene;

title: Luke 3:2
text: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zachariah, in the Desert.

title: Luke 3:3
text: And John went into all the region about the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.

title: Luke 3:4
text: As it is written in the book of the prophet Isaiah: @The voice of one crying in the desert, Prepare the way for God, make straight paths for him.@

title: Luke 3:5
text: @Every ravine shall be filled up, Every hill and mountain shall be laid low, The crooked shall be made straight, And the rough roads smooth;@

title: Luke 3:6
text: @And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.@

title: Luke 3:7
text: So John used to say to the crowd of those who were going out to be baptized by him: "You breed of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

title: Luke 3:8
text: Then bring forth fruit befitting your penitence, and do not begin to say to yourselves, "We have Abraham as our father." I tell you that God is able to raise up sons to Abraham out of these stones.

title: Luke 3:9
text: And now truly the axe is already laid at the root of the trees. So every tree which is not bearing good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire."

title: Luke 3:10
text: And the crowd began to ask him questions. "What shall we do then?" they asked. In reply he said to them:

title: Luke 3:11
text: "If you have two shirts share with him who has none; and let him who has food do the same."

title: Luke 3:12
text: There came to him publicans also to be baptized, and they said to him, "Master, what must we do?"

title: Luke 3:13
text: And he said to them, "Exact no more than the sum allowed you."

title: Luke 3:14
text: The soldiers also repeatedly questioned him, saying, "And we, what shall we do?" "Do not intimidate any one," he replied, "nor lay false charges, and be content with your pay."

title: Luke 3:15
text: And while the people were in expectation, and all men were debating in their hearts about John,

title: Luke 3:16
text: whether perhaps he were the Christ, John answered, saying to all of them: "I indeed am baptizing you in water, but One is coming after me, mightier than I, whose shoe-latchet I am not worthy to unloose. He shall baptize you in the Holy Ghost and in fire.

title: Luke 3:17
text: He has his fan in his hand to cleanse his threshing-floor thoroughly, and to gather the wheat into his storehouse, but the chaff will he burn with unquenchable fire."

title: Luke 3:18
text: With many other exhortations then John declared the gospel to the people;

title: Luke 3:19
text: but Herod, the Tetrarch, when reproved by him because of Herodias, his brother's wife, and because of all the wicked deeds that he had done,

title: Luke 3:20
text: added yet this above them all that he shut up John in prison.

title: Luke 3:21
text: Now after all the people had been baptized, and Jesus himself had been baptized and was praying,

title: Luke 3:22
text: heaven opened, and the Holy Spirit, in bodily form like a dove, descended upon him: and a voice came out of heaven, saying: "Thou art my Son, dearly beloved; in thee is my delight."

title: Luke 3:23
text: And Jesus himself when he began to teach was about thirty years of age. He was the son (as it was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,

title: Luke 3:24
text: son of Matthat, son of Levi, son of Melchi,

title: Luke 3:25
text: son of Matthias, son of Nahum, son of Esli, son of Naggai,

title: Luke 3:26
text: son of Mahath, son of Matthias, son of Semein, son of Joseph, son of Joda,

title: Luke 3:27
text: son of Johann, son of Resa, son of Zerubbabel, son of Shealtiel, son of Neri,

title: Luke 3:28
text: son of Melchi, son of Addi, son of Cosam, son of Elmadam, son of Er,

title: Luke 3:29
text: son of Joshua, son of Eliezar, son of Jorim, son of Mathat, son of Levi,

title: Luke 3:30
text: son of Symeon, son of Judah, son of Joseph, son of Jonan, son of Eliakim,

title: Luke 3:31
text: son of Melea, son of Menna, son of Mattatha, son of Nathan, son of David,

title: Luke 3:32
text: son of Jesse, son of Obed, son of Boaz, son of Salmon, son of Nahshon,

title: Luke 3:33
text: son of Amminadab, son of Admin, son of Arni, son of Hezron, son of Perez, son of Judah,

title: Luke 3:34
text: son of Jacob, son of Isaac, son of Abraham, son of Terah, son of Nahor,

title: Luke 3:35
text: son of Serug, son of Reu, son of Peleg, son of Eber, son of Shelah,

title: Luke 3:36
text: son of Cainan, son of Arpachshad, son of Shem, son of Noah, son of Lamech,

title: Luke 3:37
text: son of Methuselah, son of Enoch, son of Jared, son of Mahalel, son of Kenan,

title: Luke 3:38
text: son of Enos, son of Seth, son of Adam, son of God.

title: Luke 4:1
text: Then Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, came back from the Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the desert for forty days, all the time tempted by the devil.

title: Luke 4:2
text: He ate nothing during these days, and at the close of them he was hungry.

title: Luke 4:3
text: The devil said to him, "If you are the Son of God tell this stone to become bread."

title: Luke 4:4
text: And Jesus answered him, saying, "It is written that /@not by bread alone shall man live./@"

title: Luke 4:5
text: And the devil led him up and showed him all the kingdoms of the inhabited earth in an instant of time, and the devil said to him:

title: Luke 4:6
text: "To you will I give all this authority and this glory; for it has been handed over to me, and I give it to whomever I wish.

title: Luke 4:7
text: "If then you will worship me, it shall all be yours."

title: Luke 4:8
text: "It is written," answered Jesus, /@"Thou shalt worship the Lord, thy God, and him only shalt thou serve./@"

title: Luke 4:9
text: Then he brought him to Jerusalem, and caused him to stand upon the Temple roof, and said to him: "If you really are the Son of God throw yourself down here;

title: Luke 4:10
text: for it is written, /@"He shall give his angels charge of thee, To guard thee safely;/@

title: Luke 4:11
text: /@"They will bear thee up in their hands, Lest thou dash thy food against a stone."/@

title: Luke 4:12
text: "It has been said," replied Jesus, /@"Thou shalt not tempt the Lord, thy God."/@

title: Luke 4:13
text: So, after exhausting on him every kind of temptation, the devil left him for a time.

title: Luke 4:14
text: Then Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit to Galilee, and his fame spread throughout all the surrounding country,

title: Luke 4:15
text: and he began to teach in their synagogues, and was glorified by all.

title: Luke 4:16
text: Then he came to Nazareth where he had been brought up: and, as was his custom, he entered into the synagogue on the Sabbath Day, and stood up to read.

title: Luke 4:17
text: And there was handed him the roll of the prophet Isaiah; and unrolling it he found the place where it was written,

title: Luke 4:18
text: /@The Spirit of the Lord is upon me Because He has anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor, He has sent me to proclaim release to the prisoners, And recovery of sight to the blind; To set at liberty those that are bruised,/@

title: Luke 4:19
text: /@To proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord./@

title: Luke 4:20
text: Then rolling up the papyrus, he gave it back to the attendant and sat down.

title: Luke 4:21
text: The eyes of all in the synagogue were fixed on him, and he began to say to them, "Today is this scripture fulfilled in your hearing."

title: Luke 4:22
text: And they all spoke well of him, and marveled at the words of charm that fell from his lips. "Is not this the son of Joseph?" they asked.

title: Luke 4:23
text: Jesus answered: "Doubtless you will quote the proverb to me, "Physician, heal thyself! Do also here in your own country all that we hear that you have done in Capernaum."

title: Luke 4:24
text: "I tell you in solemn truth," he added, "that no prophet is acceptable in his own country.

title: Luke 4:25
text: In very truth I tell you there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the heavens were closed for three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land;

title: Luke 4:26
text: yet Elijah was not sent to any one of them, but only to a widow in Zarephath in Sidon.

title: Luke 4:27
text: And there were many lepers in Israel in the days of the prophet Elisha, yet none of them was cleansed but only Naaman the Syrian."

title: Luke 4:28
text: When they had heard these words, those in the synagogue were filled with fury;

title: Luke 4:29
text: they rose, hurried him outside the town, and brought him to the brow of the hill on which their city was built, intending to cast him down headlong.

title: Luke 4:30
text: But he, passing through the midst of them, took his departure.

title: Luke 4:31
text: Then he went down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and continued to teach the people on the Sabbath Days.

title: Luke 4:32
text: They were deeply impressed by his teaching because his speech was with authority.

title: Luke 4:33
text: And there was in the synagogue a man possessed by the spirit of a foul demon. He cried out, in a loud voice, saying:

title: Luke 4:34
text: "Ha! Jesus of Nazareth, what business have you with us? Are you come to destroy us? I know you who you are, you holy one of God!"

title: Luke 4:35
text: And Jesus rebuked him, saying: "Be quiet! Come out of him." And when the demon had thrown the man down before them, he came out of him without doing him any harm.

title: Luke 4:36
text: All were amazed, and began to ask one another, saying: "What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits and they come out."

title: Luke 4:37
text: And the talk about him spread into every locality in the surrounding country.

title: Luke 4:38
text: Now when he rose and left the synagogue, he entered into the house of Simon, where Simon's mother-in-law lay sick of a great fever. And they kept entreating him for her.

title: Luke 4:39
text: And he stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her; and at once she arose and began to minister unto them.

title: Luke 4:40
text: At sunset all they who had any sick with any sort of disease brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them and healed them.

title: Luke 4:41
text: Demons also came out of many, screaming and saying, "You are the Son of God." But he rebuked them, and did not permit them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.

title: Luke 4:42
text: And when it was daybreak he leftt the town, and went away to solitary place; and the crowd kept seeking him. Coming at length upon him, they attempted to detain him so that he should not leave them.

title: Luke 4:43
text: But he said to them: "I must preach the gospel of the kingdom of God to the other towns also; for that is what I was sent to do."

title: Luke 4:44
text: So he continued to preach in the synagogues of Galilee.

title: Luke 5:1
text: On one occasion when he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret, the crowd pressed upon him to listen to the word of God.

title: Luke 5:2
text: But he saw two fishing-boats on the shore of the lake; the fishermen had disembarked, and were washing their nets.

title: Luke 5:3
text: He went on board one of the boats which belonged to Simon, and asked him to push out a little way from land. Then he sat down and continued to teach the crowd from the boat.

title: Luke 5:4
text: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, "Push out into deep water, and let down your nets for a haul."

title: Luke 5:5
text: "Master," answered Simon, "although we toiled all night, we took nothing; but at your bidding I will let down the nets."

title: Luke 5:6
text: And when they had done this they enclosed a great multitude of fish; and their nets began to break.

title: Luke 5:7
text: So they motioned to their partners in the other boat to come and help them. They came and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.

title: Luke 5:8
text: When Simon Peter saw this he fell down at the knees of Jesus, exclaiming, "Depart from me, O Lord, for I am a sinful man!"

title: Luke 5:9
text: (For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the haul of fish which they had made;

title: Luke 5:10
text: and so were Simon's partners, James and John, sons of Zebedee.) But Jesus answered Simon: "Fear not; from this time on, you will be catching men."

title: Luke 5:11
text: So when they had brought their boats to land they left everything and followed him.

title: Luke 5:12
text: Another time when he was in one of their cities, there was a man there full of leprosy. And, upon seeing Jesus, he fell on his face and implored him. "Lord," he said, "if only you choose you can make me clean."

title: Luke 5:13
text: And he stretched out his hand and touching him, said: "I do choose; be made clean."

title: Luke 5:14
text: And instantly the leprosy left him. Jesus ordered him to tell no one, "But be off," he said, "show yourself to the priest, and make the offering for your cleansing, as Moses commanded, for a testimony to them."

title: Luke 5:15
text: But all the more the report about him continued to spread; and great crowds began to come together to hear him, and to be healed of their infirmities.

title: Luke 5:16
text: But Jesus himself habitually withdrew into solitary places, and there used to pray.

title: Luke 5:17
text: One day he was teaching, and near to him were seated Pharisees and teachers of the Law, who had come from every village of Galilee and Judea and from Jerusalem; and the power of the Lord was with him to heal.

title: Luke 5:18
text: And behold there came men carrying a paralytic on a bed; and they tried to bring him and lay him before Jesus, but they could not because of the crowd.

title: Luke 5:19
text: So they went up on the roof, and let him down through the tiling, with his bed, into the crowd, before Jesus.

title: Luke 5:20
text: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to him, "Man, your sins are forgiven you!"

title: Luke 5:21
text: And the Scribes and Pharisees began to cavil. "Who is this?" they asked, "speaking blasphemies? Who can forgive sins but God alone?"

title: Luke 5:22
text: Conscious of their cavilings, Jesus answered, saying:

title: Luke 5:23
text: "What is this caviling in your hearts? Which is easier to say, "Your sins are forgiven," or to say, "Rise and walk?"

title: Luke 5:24
text: But that you may know that the Son of man has authority on earth to forgive sins (he said to the paralytic), "I bid you rise, take up your bed, and go to your house."

title: Luke 5:25
text: And instantly he arose up before them, took up what he had been lying on, and went away to his house, glorifying God.

title: Luke 5:26
text: Astonishment fell upon them all, and they began to glorify God, and they were filled with awe, and they said, "We have seen strange things today."

title: Luke 5:27
text: After this he went forth and noticed a tax-gatherer, named Levi, sitting at the tax-office, and said to him, "Follow me."

title: Luke 5:28
text: He rose, left everything, and followed him.

title: Luke 5:29
text: Levi also made him a great reception at his house. There was a large party of tax-gatherers and others who were dining with them.

title: Luke 5:30
text: And the Pharisees and their scribes began complaining to his disciples, saying, "Why are you eating and drinking with tax-gatherers and sinners?"

title: Luke 5:31
text: Jesus answered them saying: "They who are well have no need of a physician, but they who are ill.

title: Luke 5:32
text: I am not come to call the righteous but sinners, to repentance."

title: Luke 5:33
text: Again they said unto him: "Why do the disciples of John fast frequently, and make supplications, as also do the disciples of the Pharisees, but your disciples are eating and drinking?"

title: Luke 5:34
text: "Can you make the bridal party fast," he asked, while the bridegroom is still with them?

title: Luke 5:35
text: "But there is coming a day when the Bridegroom will have been taken away from them; then at that time they will fast."

title: Luke 5:36
text: He also told them a parable. "No one," he said, "tears a piece from a new garment, and patches it upon an old one; otherwise he will tear the new garment, and the patch from the new will not mend the old.

title: Luke 5:37
text: "Nor does any one pour new wine into old wine-skins; otherwise the new wine will burst the skins, and will itself be spilled, and the skins be destroyed

title: Luke 5:38
text: "But new wine must be put into fresh wine-skins

title: Luke 5:39
text: "And no man after drinking old wine, wishes for new; for he says, "The old is better.""

title: Luke 6:1
text: It happened that on a Sabbath he was going through the wheat-fields. His disciples were picking the ears and eating the wheat, rubbing it out with their hands.

title: Luke 6:2
text: And some of the Pharisees asked, "Why are you doing what it is not lawful to do on the Sabbath?"

title: Luke 6:3
text: "Have you never read," answered Jesus, "what David did when he and his followers were hungry?

title: Luke 6:4
text: "How he entered into God's house and took and ate the Presented Loaves, and gave some to his followers, loaves which none must eat but the priests?

title: Luke 6:5
text: "THE SON OF MAN," he told them, "IS LORD EVEN OVER THE SABBATH."

title: Luke 6:6
text: On another Sabbath he went into a synagogue and was teaching; and there was there a man whose right hand was withered.

title: Luke 6:7
text: Now the Scribes and Pharisees kept watching to see if he would heal on the Sabbath, so that they might be able to bring on accusations to him.

title: Luke 6:8
text: He was all along aware of their thoughts; and he said to the man with the withered hand, "Rise, and stand there in the midst."

title: Luke 6:9
text: So he rose and stood. Then Jesus said to them: "I ask you whether it is lawful on the Sabbath Day to do good or to do harm? To save a life or to destroy it?"

title: Luke 6:10
text: Then he looked round about on them in anger, and said to him, "Stretch out your hand!"

title: Luke 6:11
text: He did so; and his hand was restored. But they were filled with fury, and they began to talk over together what they could do to Jesus.

title: Luke 6:12
text: It happened about that time that he went out into the mountain to pray. He continued all night in prayer to God.

title: Luke 6:13
text: And when day dawned he called his disciples, and from among them he selected twelve, whom also he called Apostles [missionaries].

title: Luke 6:14
text: They were Simon, whom he had also called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James and John;

title: Luke 6:15
text: Philip and Bartholomew; Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon called the Zealot;

title: Luke 6:16
text: Jude the son of James, and Judas Iscariot who was the traitor.

title: Luke 6:17
text: With these he came down till he reached a level place, where there was a great crowd of his disciples and a great many people from all Judea and Jerusalem and from the seacoast of Tyre and Sidon. These came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases.

title: Luke 6:18
text: Those who were tormented by unclean spirits were healed also.

title: Luke 6:19
text: The whole crowd were trying to touch him, because power emanated from him and cured them all.

title: Luke 6:20
text: Then raising his eyes upon his disciples he began to say to them: "Blessed are you poor, For the kingdom of God is yours.

title: Luke 6:21
text: "Blessed are you who are hungry now, For you shall be filled. "Blessed are you who are wailing now, For you shall laugh.

title: Luke 6:22
text: "Blessed are you when men shall hate you, And excommunicate you and reproach you, and cast out your name as evil because of the Son of man.

title: Luke 6:23
text: "Rejoice in that day and exult, For your reward is great in heaven; For even so did their fathers to the prophets.

title: Luke 6:24
text: "But woe to you rich! For you already have received your consolation.

title: Luke 6:25
text: "Woe unto you who are full now! For you shall suffer hunger. "Woe to you who are laughing now! For you shall wail and weep.

title: Luke 6:26
text: "Woe to you when all men shall speak well of you! For even so did their fathers to the false prophets.

title: Luke 6:27
text: "But to you who are listening to me I say, Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

title: Luke 6:28
text: Bless those who curse you, pray for those who calumniate you.

title: Luke 6:29
text: To him who gives you a blow on the jaw Turn the other jaw also; And from him who is robbing you of your cloak Withhold not your coat also.

title: Luke 6:30
text: Give to every one who asks you; And do not demand your goods back from him who is taking them away.

title: Luke 6:31
text: And as you would like men to do to you, So do you also to them.

title: Luke 6:32
text: "If you love those who love you what credit is it to you? Why even sinners love those who love them.

title: Luke 6:33
text: "And if you are kind to those who are kind to you, what credit is it to you? Even sinners do the same.

title: Luke 6:34
text: "And if you lend to those from whom you are hoping to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, so as to get as much back.

title: Luke 6:35
text: "But you must love even your enemies and be kind to them, And lend, despairing of no man. Then your reward will be great, And you will be the sons of the Most High; For he is kind even to the ungrateful and to the evil.

title: Luke 6:36
text: "Do you therefore be merciful, As your Father is merciful.

title: Luke 6:37
text: "Do not judge, and you shall not be judged; Do not condemn, and you shall not be condemned;

title: Luke 6:38
text: "Pardon, and you shall be pardoned; Give, and gifts shall be given to you; Full measure, pressed down, shaken together, running over, they shall pour into your bosom. For with what measure you measure, they will measure back to you."

title: Luke 6:39
text: He also told them a parable: "Can a blind man lead a blind man? Will they not both fall into a pit?

title: Luke 6:40
text: "There is no disciple who is above his master; But every one when he is completely trained will be like his master.

title: Luke 6:41
text: "And why do you look at the splinter that is in your brother's eye, but never consider the beam that is in your own eye?

title: Luke 6:42
text: "Or how can you say to your brother: "Brother, allow me to pull that splinter out of your eye," when you do not see the beam in your own eye? Hypocrite! Take out first the beam from your own eye, and then you will see clearly to take out the splinter from your brother's eye.

title: Luke 6:43
text: "For there is not good tree which bears worthless fruit, nor again any worthless tree which bears good fruit; for each tree is known by its own fruit.

title: Luke 6:44
text: "You do not gather figs from thorns, and grapes are not plucked from a bramble-bush.

title: Luke 6:45
text: "The good man out of the good treasure-house of his heart brings forth good; and the evil man out of the evil treasure-house of his heart brings forth evil; for the mouth speaks out of the abundance of the heart.

title: Luke 6:46
text: "And why are you calling me Lord, Lord, and not doing what I tell you?

title: Luke 6:47
text: "I will show whom the man that comes to me, and listens to my works, and does them, is like.

title: Luke 6:48
text: "He is like a man who is building a house who digged and went deep and laid a foundation upon rock. And, when a flood came, the torrent dashed against that house, but could not move, because it had been founded upon rock.

title: Luke 6:49
text: "But he who listens but does not do, is like a man who built a house upon the soil, without foundations, against which the torrent burst, and at once it fell in, and the ruin of that house was great."

title: Luke 7:1
text: After he had ended all his sayings in the hearing of the people, he went to Capernaum.

title: Luke 7:2
text: Here the slave of a certain [Roman] captain, a man dear to his master, was ill, and at the point of death.

title: Luke 7:3
text: So when the captain heard about Jesus, he sent elders of the Jews to ask him to come and save his slave.

title: Luke 7:4
text: And they, when they reached Jesus, asked him earnestly to do this. "He deserves that you should do this," they said,

title: Luke 7:5
text: "for he loves our nation, and himself has built a synagogue for us."

title: Luke 7:6
text: So Jesus started to go with them, but while he was not far from the house, the captain sent friends to him with a message: "Lord do not trouble yourself, for I am not fit that you should come under my roof,

title: Luke 7:7
text: "and so I did not think myself worthy to come to you; but speak the word, and let my man be cured.

title: Luke 7:8
text: "For I also am a man obedient to authority, and have soldiers under me. And I say to one `come,' and he comes, and to my slave `do this or that,' and he does it."

title: Luke 7:9
text: But when Jesus heard this he was astonished and he turned and said to the crowd that was following him, "I tell you that not even in Israel have I found faith like that."

title: Luke 7:10
text: And those who had been sent, on returning to the house, found the slave well.

title: Luke 7:11
text: Soon afterward he went to a city called Nain, accompanied by his disciples, and a great crowd of people.

title: Luke 7:12
text: Now when he drew near the gate of the city, behold, they were there carrying out one who was dead, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow.

title: Luke 7:13
text: A great crowd accompanied her. And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her and said to her, "Do not weep."

title: Luke 7:14
text: And he came near and touched the bier; the bearer stopped and he said, "Young man, I bid you to rise."

title: Luke 7:15
text: And he who was dead sat up and began to speak; and he gave him to his mother.

title: Luke 7:16
text: And awe took hold on them all, and they began to glorify God saying: "A great prophet has risen among us;" and, "God has visited his people."

title: Luke 7:17
text: And the report of what Jesus had done went forth throughout Judea and the surrounding regions.

title: Luke 7:18
text: John's disciples brought him word of all these things

title: Luke 7:19
text: and, calling a certain two disciples to him, he sent them to Jesus, to say, "Are you `the coming one,' or if we are to expect another?"

title: Luke 7:20
text: So the men came to Jesus and said, "John the Baptist has sent us to ask you if you are the coming one, or if we are to expect another."

title: Luke 7:21
text: At that moment Jesus was healing many people of diseases and plagues and evil spirits, and to many that were blind he was freely giving their sight.

title: Luke 7:22
text: So he answered them: "Go your way, tell John what you have seen and heard. How the blind are seeing, the lame are walking, the lepers are being cleansed, the deaf are hearing, the dead are being raised, and the poor are hearing the proclamations of glad tidings.

title: Luke 7:23
text: "And blessed is he who finds no cause of stumbling in me."

title: Luke 7:24
text: When John's messengers were gone he began to speak to the crowds about John, saying, "What went out you out to the desert to behold? A reed shaken by the wind?

title: Luke 7:25
text: "But what you went out to behold? A man clothed in soft robes? Behold, men who are gorgeously dressed and live in luxury are in kings' palaces.

title: Luke 7:26
text: "But what went you to see? A prophet?

title: Luke 7:27
text: "Yes, I tell you and more than a prophet. This is he who it is written: "Behold I send a messenger before thy face, Who shall prepare thy way before thee.

title: Luke 7:28
text: "I tell you that among all that are born of women not one is greater than John; yet he that is little in the kingdom of God is greater than he."

title: Luke 7:29
text: On hearing this all the people and the tax-gatherers acknowledged the justice of God by being baptized with the baptism of John;

title: Luke 7:30
text: but the Pharisees and lawyers who had refused his baptism, frustrated God's purpose for themselves.

title: Luke 7:31
text: "To what then shall I compare the men of this generation?

title: Luke 7:32
text: "To What are they like, they are like children sitting in the market-place and calling to one another. "`We have piped to you,' they say, `and you have not danced; we have wailed, and you did not cry.'

title: Luke 7:33
text: "For John the Baptist has come eating no bread and drinking no wine, and you say, `He has a demon!'

title: Luke 7:34
text: "The son of man has come eating and drinking, and you say, `Behold a gluttonous man and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!'

title: Luke 7:35
text: "Nevertheless, wisdom is justified by all her children."

title: Luke 7:36
text: One of the Pharisees kept urging him to dine, so he entered the house and reclined at table.

title: Luke 7:37
text: Now there was a woman who was in the city, a sinner and when she knew that that Jesus was reclining at meat in the Pharisees house, she brought an alabaster vase of perfume,

title: Luke 7:38
text: and standing behind, at his feet, weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and to wipe them with her hair, while she tenderly kissed his feet, and poured the perfume over them.

title: Luke 7:39
text: When he noticed this the Pharisee, who had invited him, said to himself, "If this man were really a prophet he would have perceived who and what sort of woman this is who is touching him, and would know that she is a sinner."

title: Luke 7:40
text: Jesus then spoke to him: "Simon, I have a word to say to you." "Rabbi, say on," he replied.

title: Luke 7:41
text: "There were once to men," said Jesus, "in debt to one money- lender. One owed him fifty pounds; the other five.

title: Luke 7:42
text: "When they had nothing pay he forgave them with such charm. "Tell me, then, which of these will love him most?"

title: Luke 7:43
text: "I take it," said Simon, " the one he forgave the most."

title: Luke 7:44
text: "You have rightly judged." answered Jesus, and turning to the woman, he said to Simon: "Do you see this woman? When I came into your house you gave me no water for my feet; but she has wet my feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.

title: Luke 7:45
text: "You gave me no kiss; but she, since she came in, has never ceased tenderly kissing my feet;

title: Luke 7:46
text: "you never anointed my head with oil; but she has anointed my feet with my feet with perfume.

title: Luke 7:47
text: "This is why I tell you that her sins, many as they are, are forgiven, for her love is great; but he who is forgiven little, loves but little.

title: Luke 7:48
text: "Your sins are forgiven," he said to her.

title: Luke 7:49
text: Then the other guest began to say among themselves, "Who is this even to forgive sins?"

title: Luke 7:50
text: But he said to the woman: "Your faith has saved you. Go in peace."

title: Luke 8:1
text: It happened shortly afterwards that he began to go from town to town and village to village, preaching and telling the good news of the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 8:2
text: The twelve were with him, and certain women whom he had delivered from evil spirits and various diseases: Mary of Magdala, out of whom seven demons have been driven,

title: Luke 8:3
text: and Joanna, the wife of Chuza, Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many other women, who used to minister to him out of their substance.

title: Luke 8:4
text: As a great crowd was gathering, and men of town after town kept restoring to him, he spoke a parable to them:

title: Luke 8:5
text: "A sower went out to sow his seed, and as he sowed some fell by the wayside, and was trodden under foot, and the wild birds ate it up.

title: Luke 8:6
text: "Some other seed dropped on the rock, as soon as it grew it withered away, because it had no moisture.

title: Luke 8:7
text: "Another part fell among the thorns; and the thorns grew with it and choked it.

title: Luke 8:8
text: "But some fell on good soil, and grew up, and brought forth fruit, a hundredfold." When he said this, he called out, "Whoever has ears to hear with, let him listen."

title: Luke 8:9
text: Then his disciples began to interrupt him, saying, "What does this parable mean?"

title: Luke 8:10
text: He answered: "To you it is given to understand the mysteries of the kingdom of God; But all others are taught in parables so that seeing they shall not see, and hearing they shall not hear.

title: Luke 8:11
text: "This is the meaning of the parable: The seed is the word of God.

title: Luke 8:12
text: "Those by the wayside are people who hear, but then comes the devil and carries off the word from their heart, so that they may not believe and not be saved.

title: Luke 8:13
text: "Those on the rock are people who, upon hearing, receive the word with joy; but they have no root. For a time indeed they all believe, but in time of temptation they fall away.

title: Luke 8:14
text: "And that which fell upon thorns is those who have heard, but as they go on their way of word is choked with the cares and riches and pleasures of life; so they bring no fruit of perfection.

title: Luke 8:15
text: "And that in the good soil is those who have listened to the message and, in an honest and good heart, hold fast, and bring forth fruit with patience.

title: Luke 8:16
text: "When he lights a lamp no one covers it with a vase or hides it under a bed; he puts it on a lamp-stand so whoever may behold the light.

title: Luke 8:17
text: "For is nothing hidden that shall not be disclosed; there is nothing secret which shall not be made known and come to the light.

title: Luke 8:18
text: "Take heed, then, how you listen: for he who has, to him shall it be given, but from him who has not, shall be taken away even what he has."

title: Luke 8:19
text: There came to him his mother and his brothers, and they could not reach him because of the crowd.

title: Luke 8:20
text: But some one told him, "Your mother and brothers are standing outside, desiring to see you."

title: Luke 8:21
text: "My mother and brothers," he answered, "are those who listen to the word of God and obey it."

title: Luke 8:22
text: Now it happened that one of these days he got into a boat, And him his disciples, and he said to them, "Let us cross to the other side of the lake."

title: Luke 8:23
text: So they set sail. While they were sailing he fell asleep. And there fell on the lake a squall of wind, so that the boat began to fill, and they to be in deadly peril.

title: Luke 8:24
text: Then they came to him and woke him, saying, "Master, Master, we are lost!" Then he awoke, and rebuked the winds and the raging of the sea. They ceased, and there was a calm.

title: Luke 8:25
text: "Where is your faith?" he asked them, In their terror they were filled with amazement, and said to one another, "Who is this who commands even the winds and the sea, and they obey him?"

title: Luke 8:26
text: Then they put in at the country of Gadarenes, which is across from Galilee.

title: Luke 8:27
text: When he landed here he was met by a certain townsman who was possessed by demons. For a long time he had worn no clothes and nor lived in any house, but in tombs.

title: Luke 8:28
text: When he saw Jesus he cried out, and fell down before him, and in a loud voice exclaimed: "What have we to do with you, Jesus, you son of God Most High? I implore you to torment me not!"

title: Luke 8:29
text: For Jesus was already commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For many times it had seized him and held him, and they again and again kept him under guard, and put him in chains and fetters. But he would break his bonds asunder, as he was driven by the demon in to the desert.

title: Luke 8:30
text: So Jesus asked him, "What is your name?" And he answered, "Legion" (for many demons had entered into him).

title: Luke 8:31
text: So they besought Jesus not to command them to go away into the abyss.

title: Luke 8:32
text: Now there was a great herd of swine feeding on the hillside, and the demons begged him to give them leave to enter them. He gave them leave.

title: Luke 8:33
text: The demons came out of the man, and entered into the swine; the herd rushed violently down over the cliff into the lake.

title: Luke 8:34
text: And those who saw what had happened fled and reported it in the town and the villages.

title: Luke 8:35
text: Then the people came out to see what had happened, and came to Jesus, and found the man out of whom the demons had gone sitting clothed and in his right mind, at the feet of Jesus. And they were terrified.

title: Luke 8:36
text: Then those who had seen it told them how the demon-possessed man had been saved.

title: Luke 8:37
text: And the whole populace of Gadarenes and the surrounding territory besought Jesus to go away from them; for they were terror-stricken. So he entered a boat and returned.

title: Luke 8:38
text: But the man out of whom the demons had gone kept begging him that he might be with him. But Jesus sent him away saying,

title: Luke 8:39
text: "Return to your home, and tell them all that God has done for you." So he went away and throughout the whole city he published how much Jesus had done for him.

title: Luke 8:40
text: And as Jesus returned the crowd welcomed him;

title: Luke 8:41
text: for they were all waiting for him. Just then there came a man named Jarius, and he was ruler in the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus' feet and begged him to come into his house;

title: Luke 8:42
text: for he had only one daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay dying. But as he went the crowds continued to press in on him.

title: Luke 8:43
text: And a woman who for twelve years had had a hemorrhage, and had spent on doctors all that she had, but none had cured her,

title: Luke 8:44
text: came close behind him, and touched the hem of his garment; and instantly the hemorrhage ceased.

title: Luke 8:45
text: "Who is that touched me?" said Jesus and when everybody denied it, Peter said, "Master, the crowds are hemming you in and pressing upon you."

title: Luke 8:46
text: But Jesus said: "Some one did touch me; for I perceived that the power was proceeding out of me."

title: Luke 8:47
text: Then the woman, who saw that she had not escaped notice, came trembling, and falling down before him, stated before the people for what reason she had touched him, and how she had been instantly healed.

title: Luke 8:48
text: "Daughter," he said "your faith has made you well, go on into peace."

title: Luke 8:49
text: As he was speaking some one came from the house of the synagogue, saying: "Your daughter is dead! Do not trouble the Master."

title: Luke 8:50
text: But Jesus heard and answered: "Have no fear. Only believe, and she shall be restored."

title: Luke 8:51
text: So he came to the house, and would not permit anyone to go in with him except Peter and John and James, and the father and Mother of the little girl.

title: Luke 8:52
text: The people were weeping and bewailing her, but he said: "Stop your wailing; for she is not dead, but asleep."

title: Luke 8:53
text: They began to laugh him to scorn, because they knew well that she was dead.

title: Luke 8:54
text: But he took her by the hand and called to her, "Little daughter, rise!"

title: Luke 8:55
text: And her spirit returned and instantly she stood up.

title: Luke 8:56
text: He bade them to get her some food. Her parents were amazed; but he forbade them to tell any one what had been done.

title: Luke 9:1
text: Then he called the Twelve together, and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to heal;

title: Luke 9:2
text: and sent them out to preach the kingdom of God, and heal the sick.

title: Luke 9:3
text: And he said to them: "Take nothing for your journey, neither staff, nor bag, nor bread, nor money, and do not have two tunics.

title: Luke 9:4
text: "Into whatever house you enter, there stay, and thence depart.

title: Luke 9:5
text: "If any one will not receive you, shake off the dust from your feet as you leave this town, as a testimony against them."

title: Luke 9:6
text: So they went forth, and walked from village to village, preaching the gospel and healing everywhere.

title: Luke 9:7
text: Now Herod, the Tetrarch, heard of all that was happening; and he was perplexed because of its being said by someone that John was risen from the dead;

title: Luke 9:8
text: and by some that Elijah had appeared; and by others that one of the ancient prophets was risen again.

title: Luke 9:9
text: So Herod said, "I beheaded John, but who is this of whom I am hearing such reports," And he kept seeking to see him.

title: Luke 9:10
text: On their return the apostles told him what they had done: and he took them and withdrew in private to a town called Bethsaida.

title: Luke 9:11
text: But when the crowd learned this they followed him. He received them kindly and spoke to them concerning the kingdom of God, and healed those who needed restored to good health.

title: Luke 9:12
text: But now the day began to decline, and the twelve came to him and said: "Send away the crowd so that they may go into the villages and surrounding the country to lodge and buy provisions; for here we are on a solitary place."

title: Luke 9:13
text: "Do you yourselves give them food," he answered. "We have nothing," they replied "Except five loaves, and a couple fish, unless you mean for us to go and buy provisions for all the crowd."

title: Luke 9:14
text: (For there were about five thousand men.) "Make them sit down in table-companies, of about fifty each," he said to his disciples.

title: Luke 9:15
text: This they did, and made them all sit down.

title: Luke 9:16
text: Then he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up in heaven, he blessed them, broke them in pieces, and began to giving to his disciples to apportion among the crowd.

title: Luke 9:17
text: So they ate and were filled, all of them. And there was picked up that which remained over to them, of broken pieces, twelve basketfuls.

title: Luke 9:18
text: Now it happened that while he was praying by himself, the disciples were with him, and he asked them a question: "Who do the crowd think I am?"

title: Luke 9:19
text: "John the Baptist," they answered, "But others say Elijah, and others that one of the ancient prophets is risen again."

title: Luke 9:20
text: Then he said to them, "But who do you say I am? Then Peter answered saying, "The Christ of God.'

title: Luke 9:21
text: Then he strictly forbade them to tell this to any one;

title: Luke 9:22
text: and he said, "The Son of man must suffer much, and be restricted by the elders and high priests and scribes and be put to death, and on the third day be raised again."

title: Luke 9:23
text: And he said to all: "If any man wills to follow me, Let him renounce self and take up his cross daily and follow me.

title: Luke 9:24
text: "For whoever wills to save his life shall lose it; and whoever loses his life for my sake shall save it.

title: Luke 9:25
text: "For what shall it profit a man if he shall gain the whole world and lose or forfeit himself?

title: Luke 9:26
text: "For whoever is ashamed of me and of my teachings, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed when he comes in his own and in his Father's glory, and in that of the holy angels.

title: Luke 9:27
text: "But I tell you truly there are some of those standing here who will not taste death till they see the kingdom of God."

title: Luke 9:28
text: About eight days after this it happened that Jesus took Peter, James, and John, and went up on the mountain to pray.

title: Luke 9:29
text: And as he was praying the appearances of his countenance became different, and his clothing became white and dazzling.

title: Luke 9:30
text: And suddenly there were two men talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah.

title: Luke 9:31
text: These appeared in glory and talked about his departure which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.

title: Luke 9:32
text: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep; but when they were fully awake they saw his glory, and the two men were standing beside him.

title: Luke 9:33
text: And when they were preparing to depart from him Peter said to Jesus: "Master, it is good for us to be here; and let us make three tents, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah"--not knowing what he was saying.

title: Luke 9:34
text: And while he was saying this, there came a cloud and began to overshadow them; and they were awestruck as they entered into the cloud.

title: Luke 9:35
text: And a voice came out of the cloud, saying: "This is my Son, my chosen one; listen to him."

title: Luke 9:36
text: When the voice ceased Jesus was found alone. And they held their peace, and told no one at that time about what they had seen.

title: Luke 9:37
text: It happened the next day, when they were come down from the mountain, that a large crowd came to meet him;

title: Luke 9:38
text: and a man called out of the crowd saying: "Teacher, I beg you to look upon my son; for he is my only boy,

title: Luke 9:39
text: "and behold a spirit seizes hold of him, and rudely he shouts out, It convulses him till he foams; indeed it will hardly leave off bruising him sorely.

title: Luke 9:40
text: "I begged your disciples to cast it out, but they could not."

title: Luke 9:41
text: "O faithless and perverse generation," said Jesus, "how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son to me."

title: Luke 9:42
text: But while he was yet coming the demon dashed him down, and cruelly convulsed him. Then Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and cured the boy, and gave him back to his father.

title: Luke 9:43
text: And they were all awestruck at the mighty power of God. But while everyone was marveling at what he was doing, he said to his disciples:

title: Luke 9:44
text: "Let these words sink into your ears; for the son of man is about to be betrayed into the hands of men."

title: Luke 9:45
text: But they did not understand this saying; it was hidden from them so that they perceived it not, and they were sore afraid to ask him about his saying.

title: Luke 9:46
text: Now there arose a dispute among them as to which one of them was the greatest.

title: Luke 9:47
text: And Jesus who knew the dispute that was in their hearts, took a young child, and placed him by his side;

title: Luke 9:48
text: then he said to them: "Whoever shall receive this little child in my name receives me; and whoever shall receive me receives him that sent me. For it is the lowliest among you all who is great."

title: Luke 9:49
text: "Master," said John, "we saw a man who was casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he was not following us."

title: Luke 9:50
text: But Jesus said, "Forbid him not, for he who is not against you is for you."

title: Luke 9:51
text: When now when the time drew near for him to be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,

title: Luke 9:52
text: and sent messengers before him. These went and entered into a Samaritan village to make ready for him.

title: Luke 9:53
text: But they did not receive him because his face was set to go to Jerusalem.

title: Luke 9:54
text: And when his disciples, James and John, saw this they said, "Lord, are you willing for us to bid fire come down from heaven and destroy them?" [As Elijah did.]

title: Luke 9:55
text: But he turned and rebuked them [and said,

title: Luke 9:56
text: "You know not what kind of spirit you share, for the Son of man came not to destroy men's lives, but to save them."] And they went to another village.

title: Luke 9:57
text: As they were going on their way, a man came to him and said, "I will follow wherever you go."

title: Luke 9:58
text: "The foxes have their holes," Jesus answered, "and the wild birds have their nest, but the Son of man has not where to lay his head."

title: Luke 9:59
text: To another he said, "Follow me!" But he replied, "Permit me first to go and bury my father."

title: Luke 9:60
text: "Leave the dead to bury their own dead," said Jesus to him, "go you and announce, far and wide the kingdom of God."

title: Luke 9:61
text: And another man also said to him: "I will follow you, Lord; but first permit me to bid farewell to those who are in my house."

title: Luke 9:62
text: But Jesus answered him, "No man who puts his hand to the plow and then looks back, is fit for the kingdom of God."

title: Luke 10:1
text: After this the appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two before his face, into every city and place into which he himself intended to go.

title: Luke 10:2
text: And he thus addressed them: "The harvest is abundant, but the harvesters are few: do you therefore pray the lord of the harvest to send forth harvesters into his harvest.

title: Luke 10:3
text: "Go your way; behold, I am sending you forth like lambs among wolves.

title: Luke 10:4
text: "Carry no purse, no bag, no shoes; and do not salute any one on your journey.

title: Luke 10:5
text: "Into whatever you first enter, say, `Peace be to this house!'

title: Luke 10:6
text: "And if there be any son of peace there, your peace shall rest upon him; but if not it shall return to you.

title: Luke 10:7
text: "Stay in that same house, eating and drinking what they give: for the laborer is worthy of his hire. Do not go from house to house.

title: Luke 10:8
text: "And whatever town you come to, and they receive you, eat whatever they put before you.

title: Luke 10:9
text: "Heal the sick in that town and tell them, The kingdom of God draws near to you.

title: Luke 10:10
text: "But whatever town you enter, and they do not receive you, Go out into the streets and cry,

title: Luke 10:11
text: "`The very dust of your town which clings to your feet we wipe off as protest; but know this, that the kingdom of God is drawing near to you.'

title: Luke 10:12
text: "For I tell you that it will be mare tolerable for Sodom in that day than for that town.

title: Luke 10:13
text: "Woe unto you, Chorazin! Woe unto you, Bethsaida! For had the mighty been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

title: Luke 10:14
text: "However, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.

title: Luke 10:15
text: "And you Capernaum, shall you be exalted to heaven? No! you shall be brought down to Hades!

title: Luke 10:16
text: "He who listens to you listens to me: and he who rejects you, rejects me; he who rejects me, rejects him who sent me."

title: Luke 10:17
text: Then the Seventy returned with joy, saying, "Lord even the demons are subject to us in your name."

title: Luke 10:18
text: And he said to them: "I watched Satan fall from heaven like a lightning flash.

title: Luke 10:19
text: "Behold, I give you the power to tread upon serpents and scorpions, and to trample on all the power of the enemy. In no case shall anything do you harm.

title: Luke 10:20
text: "Nevertheless, do not rejoice at this, that the spirits are subject to you; but rejoice that your names are written in Heaven."

title: Luke 10:21
text: In the same hour he thrilled with joy in the Holy Ghost. "I praise thee, Father, Lord of Heaven and Earth," he said "for hiding these things from the wise and prudent, and for revealing them to babes. Yea, Father, for so it was well pleasing in thy sight!

title: Luke 10:22
text: "All things have been delivered to me by my Father, and no one knows who the Son is except the Father; and who the Father is except the Son, and he the Son wishes to reveal him."

title: Luke 10:23
text: And turning to his disciples he said privately: "Blessed are the eyes that see what you see!

title: Luke 10:24
text: "For I tell you that many prophets and kings have longed to see what you see, and have seen it; and to hear what you hear, and have heard it not.'

title: Luke 10:25
text: Then a certain lawyer stood up and tempted him. "Master," he said "what shall I do to inherit eternal life?"

title: Luke 10:26
text: And he said to him: "What is written in the Law? What do you read there?"

title: Luke 10:27
text: "You must love the Lord your God," he answered, with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your strength, and with all your with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself."

title: Luke 10:28
text: "You have answered right," said Jesus "do that and you shall live."

title: Luke 10:29
text: But he, determined to justify himself, said to Jesus, "But who is my neighbor?" Jesus answered:

title: Luke 10:30
text: "A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, when he fell among bandits who both stripped him and beat him, and went off leaving him half dead.

title: Luke 10:31
text: "Now a certain priest chanced to be going down that way, but on seeing him he passed on the other side.

title: Luke 10:32
text: "In like manner also a Levite who came to the spot, came and looked at him, and passed on the other side.

title: Luke 10:33
text: "But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was, and when he saw him was moved with compassion.

title: Luke 10:34
text: "He went to him bound up his wounds, pouring on them oil and wine. He set him on his own beast, and took him to an inn, and took care of him.

title: Luke 10:35
text: "The next day he took two silver pieces and gave them to the landlord and said, "`Take care of him, and whatever more you spend I will repay it to you on my way back.'

title: Luke 10:36
text: "Which then of these three seems to you to have behaved like a neighbor to the man who fell among bandits?"

title: Luke 10:37
text: He replied, "The one who showed mercy on him." "Go, then," said Jesus, "and do likewise."

title: Luke 10:38
text: It happened as they went on their way that he entered into a certain village were a woman named Martha received him into her house.

title: Luke 10:39
text: She had a sister named Mary, who after seating herself at the Lord's feet was listening to his teaching.

title: Luke 10:40
text: But Martha meanwhile was growing distracted about much serving. She came up to him and said: "Lord do you not care that my sister has left me alone to do the serving? Come tell her to take hold of her end of the work along with me."

title: Luke 10:41
text: "Martha, Martha," said Jesus, "you are anxious and worried about many things,

title: Luke 10:42
text: "only one thing is really necessary. Mary, moreover, has chosen that good part which shall not be taken away from her."

title: Luke 11:1
text: It happened he was praying in a certain place, and when he stopped, one of his disciples said to him, "Master, teach us how to pray, just as John taught his disciples."

title: Luke 11:2
text: So he said to them: "When you pray, say, "Father, hallowed be thy name; May thy kingdom come,

title: Luke 11:3
text: "Give us day by day our bread for the coming day;

title: Luke 11:4
text: "Forgive us our sins; for we also forgive everyone who has offended us; "And bring us not into temptation."

title: Luke 11:5
text: He also said to them: "Suppose you have a friend and you go to him, `My friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

title: Luke 11:6
text: "for a friend of mine is come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him.'

title: Luke 11:7
text: "and he from indoors shall answer: `Do not pester me. The door is now closed, and my children are with me in bed. I cannot rise and give to you.'

title: Luke 11:8
text: "I tell you that, though he will not rise and give to him because he is his friend, yet because of his importunate persistence he will rise and give him whatever he needs.

title: Luke 11:9
text: "So I say to you: "Ask, and it shall be given to you; seek, and ye shall find; knock and it shall be opened to you.

title: Luke 11:10
text: "For he that asks receives, and he who seeks finds, and to him who knocks the door shall be opened.

title: Luke 11:11
text: "What father is there among you who, if his son asks for a loaf, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish will give him instead a serpent?

title: Luke 11:12
text: "Or if he asks for an egg, will offer him a scorpion?

title: Luke 11:13
text: "If you give good gifts to your children, how much more shall the Father who is in heaven give the Holy spirit to those that ask him!"

title: Luke 11:14
text: Once he was casting out a dumb demon, and when the demon was gone out, the dumb man spoke, and the people wondered.

title: Luke 11:15
text: But some of them said, "It is by Beelzebub, the prince of demons, that he cast out demons."

title: Luke 11:16
text: Others, tempting him, kept seeking from him a sign from heaven.

title: Luke 11:17
text: He knew their intentions and said to them: "Every kingdom divided against itself is laid waste and house falls upon house.

title: Luke 11:18
text: "And if Satan also is divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand?

title: Luke 11:19
text: "Do you say that I am casting out demons by the power of Beelzebub? If I then am casting out demons by Beelzebub, by whom are your sons casting them out? They therefore shall be your judges.

title: Luke 11:20
text: "But if it is by the finger of God that I am casting out demons, then the kingdom of God is come upon you.

title: Luke 11:21
text: "When the strong man fully aroused keeps guard over his homestead, his property is undisturbed;

title: Luke 11:22
text: "but when the stronger man attacks him, he takes away from the strong armor in which he was trusting and divides up the spoil.

title: Luke 11:23
text: "He who is not for me is against me, and he who is not gathering with me is scattering.

title: Luke 11:24
text: "Whenever a foul spirit is gone out of a man, it roams through waterless places, in search of rest; but when it can find none, it says, `I will go back to the house which I have left.'

title: Luke 11:25
text: When it comes and finds the house completely swept and garnished.

title: Luke 11:26
text: "Then it goes off and fetches seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and live there. And the last state of that man is worse than the first."

title: Luke 11:27
text: It happened while he was saying this, that a certain woman out of the crowd shouted to him, saying, "Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breast that you have sucked."

title: Luke 11:28
text: "No, rather," he answered, "blessed are those who listen to the word of God, and keep it."

title: Luke 11:29
text: When the crowd were beginning to throng about him he proceeded to say: "This is an evil generation! It seeks a sign, and there shall be no sign be given to it except the sign of Jonah;

title: Luke 11:30
text: "for as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so shall the Son of man be to this generation.

title: Luke 11:31
text: "The queen of the South shall rise up in Judgement with the men of this generation, and shall condemn them; because she came from the ends of the earth to listen to the wisdom of Solomon, and lo, one greater than Solomon is here!

title: Luke 11:32
