text: "The men of the Nineveh shall stand up in the judgment with his generation and shall condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and lo! one greater than Jonah is here!

title: Luke 11:33
text: "When one lights a lamp he does not put it in a cellar nor under the bushel, but on a lamp-stand that those who enter may see the light.

title: Luke 11:34
text: "The lamp of the body is your eye; when your eye is single then your whole body is full of light; but when it is evil your whole body is full of darkness.

title: Luke 11:35
text: "Look carefully! Perhaps that very light of yours is darkness.

title: Luke 11:36
text: "If, however, your whole body is full of light, without having any part dark, it will be wholly radiant with light, as when the lamp illumines you with its bright rays."

title: Luke 11:37
text: When he had finished speaking a Pharisee asked him to dine with him; so he went in with him and reclined.

title: Luke 11:38
text: And the Pharisee noticed, to his amazement, that he did not wash his hands before eating,

title: Luke 11:39
text: but the Lord said to him: "You Pharisee do cleanse the outside of your cup or plate, but your secret heart is full of extortion and wickedness.

title: Luke 11:40
text: "Foolish men! Did not He who made the outside make the inside also?

title: Luke 11:41
text: "Better cleanse what is within, and nothing will be unclean for you.

title: Luke 11:42
text: "But woe unto you Pharisee! for you tithe mint and rue and every herb, and disregard justice and the love of God; but these you ought to have done, and not leave the other undone.

title: Luke 11:43
text: "Woe unto you Pharisee! for you delight in the best seats in the synagogue, and in the salutation in the market-places.

title: Luke 11:44
text: "Woe unto you! for you are like the tombs which are hidden, and men walk over them unsuspecting."

title: Luke 11:45
text: Hereupon one of the lawyers exclaimed, "But teacher, in saying such things you are also reproaching us also."

title: Luke 11:46
text: "Woe unto you lawyers also!" said Jesus, "for you load men with irksome burdens, and you yourselves will not touch the burdens with one of your fingers.

title: Luke 11:47
text: "Woe to you! for you are building the tombs of the prophets whom you ancestors killed.

title: Luke 11:48
text: "So you are witnesses, and you consent to the actions of your ancestors: for they killed them, and you build their tombs.

title: Luke 11:49
text: "For this reason also said the Wisdom of God: `I will send them prophets and apostles; some of them they will kill and some they will persecute;

title: Luke 11:50
text: "so that the blood of all the prophets which was shed from the foundation of the world may be required from this generation,

title: Luke 11:51
text: "from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the alter and the sanctuary; yes; I tell you, it shall be required of this generation!

title: Luke 11:52
text: "Woe to you lawyers, for you have taken away the key of knowledge!' You yourselves have not entered, and you have hindered those who are trying to enter."

title: Luke 11:53
text: After he had gone away, the Scribes and the Pharisee began to set themselves vehemently against him, and to cross-question him upon many points,

title: Luke 11:54
text: laying in wait for him, in order to catch a word from his lips.

title: Luke 12:1
text: Meanwhile when myriads of the multitudes were thronging around him so that they trod one upon another, he began to say to his disciples, first of all: "Beware of the leaven of the Pharisee, which is hypocrisy.

title: Luke 12:2
text: "There is nothing hidden which shall not be revealed; nothing concealed that shall not be known.

title: Luke 12:3
text: "So that what you have said in the dark shall be heard in the light; and what you have whispered in the inner chambers shall be proclaimed from the housetops.

title: Luke 12:4
text: "But I say to you who are my friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body and after that have no more that they can do:

title: Luke 12:5
text: "I will warn you whom you ought to fear. Fear him who, after he was after he has killed, has power to throw you into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.

title: Luke 12:6
text: "Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings? Yet not one of them is forgotten in the sight of God!

title: Luke 12:7
text: "But the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not! You are of more value than many sparrow!

title: Luke 12:8
text: "And I tell you that whoever confesses me before men, the Son of man will confess him before the angels of God;

title: Luke 12:9
text: "and whoever disowns me before men, shall be disowned before the angels of God.

title: Luke 12:10
text: "If any one shall speak a word against the Son of man it shall be forgiven him; but he who is blasphemes against the Holy Spirit shall not be forgiven.

title: Luke 12:11
text: "And when they are bringing you before the synagogues and the rulers and authorities, do not worry about how or what you shall answer; or what you shall say;

title: Luke 12:12
text: "for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that hour what you ought to say."

title: Luke 12:13
text: Then one of the crowd said to him, "Master, tell my brother to give me my share of our inheritance."

title: Luke 12:14
text: "Man," said he, "who made me a judge or arbitrator over you?"

title: Luke 12:15
text: And to the people he said, "Take heed and guard yourselves from all covetousness, for a man's life does not consist in the abundance of the things which he possesses."

title: Luke 12:16
text: Then he spoke to them in a parable: "The ground of a certain rich man bore heavy crops.

title: Luke 12:17
text: "So he debated with himself saying, `What shall I do? for I have no place in which to store my crops.'

title: Luke 12:18
text: "And he said to himself: `This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns and build larger ones in which I will store all my wheat and my goods.

title: Luke 12:19
text: "`And I will say to my soul, "`Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years! Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.'

title: Luke 12:20
text: "But God said to him: `Foolish man! This very night your soul is wanted! And these things you have prepared, whose shall they be?

title: Luke 12:21
text: "So is he that lays up treasures for himself and is not rich toward God."

title: Luke 12:22
text: Then he said to his disciples: "For this is the reason I say to you: Be not anxious for your life, what you shall eat; nor yet your body what shall you wear.

title: Luke 12:23
text: "For the life is more than food, and the body is more than clothes.

title: Luke 12:24
text: "Consider the ravens; they neither sow nor reap; they have no storehouse nor barn. And yet God feeds them. How much more are you worth than the birds?

title: Luke 12:25
text: "And which of you by taking anxious thought can add a cubit to his height?

title: Luke 12:26
text: "If then you cannot do even that which is least, why are you anxious concerning the rest?

title: Luke 12:27
text: "Consider the lilies how they grow! They toil not, neither do they spin, yet I say to you that even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

title: Luke 12:28
text: "Now if God so clothe the grass in the field, which today is, and tomorrow is cast into the oven, will he not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?

title: Luke 12:29
text: "So do not be asking what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, and be not of doubtful mind.

title: Luke 12:30
text: "For all these things the nations of the world are seeking; but your Father knows that you have need of these things.

title: Luke 12:31
text: "But seek his kingdom, and these things shall be added to you.

title: Luke 12:32
text: "Fear not, little flock, for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

title: Luke 12:33
text: "Sell what you have and give alms. Provide yourselves with purses which do not grow old, a treasure inexhaustible in the heavens, where no thief draws near, nor does moth destroy.

title: Luke 12:34
text: "For where your treasure is there will your heart be also.

title: Luke 12:35
text: "Let your loins be girded about and your lamps burning;

title: Luke 12:36
text: "and be yourselves like men who are looking for the Lord, on his return from a wedding banquet, so that when he comes and knocks they may at once open the door for him.

title: Luke 12:37
text: "Happy are those slaves whom their master shall find watching when he comes. I tell you truly that will gird himself, and make them sit down to meat, and come and serve them.

title: Luke 12:38
text: "And whether it be in the second watch, or in the third, that he comes, and so finds them, happy are those slaves.

title: Luke 12:39
text: "However, you know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief would come, he would have watched and not have allowed his house to be broken into.

title: Luke 12:40
text: "Do you also be ready, for in an hour that you think not the Son of man is coming."

title: Luke 12:41
text: "Master," said Peter, "are you speaking this parable to us or to all alike?"

title: Luke 12:42
text: The Lord answered: "Who then is that faithful steward, the wise man whom his Lord will put in charge of the rations in due time?

title: Luke 12:43
text: "Blessed is that slave whom his master on his coming shall find so doing.

title: Luke 12:44
text: "Of a truth I tell you that he will put him in charge of his possessions.

title: Luke 12:45
text: "But if that slave should say to himself, `My master delays his coming,' and should begin to beat the men and the maids, and to eat and drink and to get drunk,

title: Luke 12:46
text: "that slave's master will arrive on a day when he is not expecting him, and at an hour when he knows not, and will surely scourge him, and appoint him his portion with the unfaithful.

title: Luke 12:47
text: "The slave who knew his Lord's will, and made not ready, nor did according to his will, will be beaten with many lashes,

title: Luke 12:48
text: "but he who did not know, but did things worthy of a beating, will receive few lashes. To whom much has been given, from him much will be required, and to whom much is entrusted, of him they will ask the more.

title: Luke 12:49
text: "I came to build a fire upon the earth; what is my desire?

title: Luke 12:50
text: "Would it were already kindled! But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how am I straitened till it is accomplished!

title: Luke 12:51
text: "Do you think that I am come to make peace on the earth? No, I tell you, but rather dissension.

title: Luke 12:52
text: "From this time there will be five in one house divided, three against two and two against three;

title: Luke 12:53
text: "father against son and son against father; mother against daughter and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law."

title: Luke 12:54
text: Then he said to the crowd also: "When you see a cloud rising in the west you at once say, `There is going to be a shower,' and it comes to pass.

title: Luke 12:55
text: "And when you feel the south winds blowing you say, `There will be a hot wind,' and it comes to pass.

title: Luke 12:56
text: "Hypocrites! you know how to read the face of the earth and of the sky; but how is it that you do not know how to read the signs of the present time?

title: Luke 12:57
text: "And why do you not, even yourselves, judge what is right?

title: Luke 12:58
text: "For as you go before the magistrate with your opponent do your utmost to get quit of him, lest he drag you before the judge, and the judge delivers you over to the officer, and the officer cast you into prison.

title: Luke 12:59
text: "You shall by no means come out of there until you have paid the very last farthing."

title: Luke 13:1
text: Now there were some present at that very season who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifies.

title: Luke 13:2
text: "Do you suppose," he answered them, "that those Galileans were worse sinners than the rest of the Galileans because they have suffered thus?

title: Luke 13:3
text: "I tell you no; but unless you repent, you will all likewise perish.

title: Luke 13:4
text: "Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them, do you suppose that they were worse offenders than the rest of those who lived in Jerusalem?

title: Luke 13:5
text: "I tell you no; but unless you repent, you will all perish as they did."

title: Luke 13:6
text: Then he gave them this parable: "A man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came to look for fruit on it, but found none.

title: Luke 13:7
text: So he said to the gardener: "`See, for years I have come looking for fruit on this tree, and found none. Cut it down. Why should it actually cumber the ground?'

title: Luke 13:8
text: "But the gardener answered him: `Lord, let it alone this year also, till I have dug around it, and fertilized it.

title: Luke 13:9
text: "If after that it bears fruit, well and good; but if not you shall cut it down.'"

title: Luke 13:10
text: Once he was teaching in one of the synagogues, on the Sabbath,

title: Luke 13:11
text: a woman was present who had a spirit of infirmity for eighteen years. she was bent double, and could not lift herself up at all.

title: Luke 13:12
text: Jesus noticed her and called to him and said, "Woman, you are free from your weakness."

title: Luke 13:13
text: Then he placed his hand on her, and she instantly stood upright and began to give glory to God.

title: Luke 13:14
text: But the ruler of the synagogue was indignant at Jesus for healing her on the Sabbath, and said to the crowd: "There are six days of the week on which men ought to work. Therefore come during those, and get cured, but not on the Sabbath Day."

title: Luke 13:15
text: But the Lord answered him. "Hypocrites!" he said, "does not each one of you loose his ox or his ass from the stall on the Sabbath Day, and lead it to water,

title: Luke 13:16
text: "and this woman, who is the daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has bound these eighteen years, ought she not have been loosened from bondage, though the day be the Sabbath?"

title: Luke 13:17
text: As he said this, all adversaries were put to shame; and all the crowd rejoiced for the glorious things that he continually did.

title: Luke 13:18
text: This led him to say: "What is the kingdom of God like? And to what shall I compare it?

title: Luke 13:19
text: "It is like a grain of mustardseed, which a man took and cast into his own garden. It grew and became a tree, and the wild birds nested in its branches."

title: Luke 13:20
text: And again he said: "To what shall I liken the kingdom of God?

title: Luke 13:21
text: "It is like leaven which a took and hid in three measures of flour until the whole was leavened."

title: Luke 13:22
text: So he went on his way through cities and villages,

title: Luke 13:23
text: teaching as he journeyed toward Jerusalem. And a man came behind him and said, "Lord are there but few that are saved?"

title: Luke 13:24
text: "Struggle to enter in by the narrow door," he answered, "for I tell you that many will try to enter and not be able,

title: Luke 13:25
text: "when once the master of the house is risen up and has shut the door. You will begin to stand outside, and to knock at the door, crying, "`Lord, open to us.' "`I do not know were you came from,' he will reply.

title: Luke 13:26
text: "Then you will begin saying, `But we have eaten and drunk in your presence, and you have taught in our streets.'

title: Luke 13:27
text: "But he will answer: "`I tell you I do not know were you came from;

title: Luke 13:28
text: "`depart from me, all of you, you evil-doers.' There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you shall see Abraham and Isaac and Jacob and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves cast out.

title: Luke 13:29
text: "And people shall come from the Orient and from the Occident, from the north and from the south, and sit down in the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 13:30
text: "And lo, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last."

title: Luke 13:31
text: That very day there came some Pharisees to him, saying, "Get out of here and go away, for Herod wishes to kill you."

title: Luke 13:32
text: "Go, tell that fox," he answered, "`Lo, today and tomorrow I am continuing to cast out demons and perform cures, and on the third day I finish my course.'

title: Luke 13:33
text: "Yet I must continue my journey today, tomorrow, and the day following; for it would never do for a prophet to perish outside of Jerusalem!

title: Luke 13:34
text: "O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those who are sent to you! How often would I have gathered your children, as a hen gathers her chickens under her wings, and you would not!

title: Luke 13:35
text: "Behold! Your house is left to you, desolate! I tell you that you shall never see me again until you say, Blessed is he that comes in the name of the Lord,"

title: Luke 14:1
text: It happened on the Sabbath Day when he went into the house of a certain ruler among Pharisees to take a meal, that they were watching him.

title: Luke 14:2
text: And lo! there was in front of him a man who had dropsy.

title: Luke 14:3
text: So Jesus questioned the lawyers and the Pharisees, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath Day or not?"

title: Luke 14:4
text: They kept silent. Then Jesus took him and healed him and let him go.

title: Luke 14:5
text: And to them he said, "Which of you when an ox or ass has fallen into a well, will at once pull him out on the Sabbath Day?"

title: Luke 14:6
text: They could not answer this.

title: Luke 14:7
text: He told a parable to the guests when he noticed how they began choosing the best seats. He said to them:

title: Luke 14:8
text: "When you are invited by any one to a marriage-feast, do not sit down in the best seat, lest a guest more distinguished than yourself has been invited, and your host come to you and say,

title: Luke 14:9
text: "`Give place to this man,' and then with mortification you proceed to take the lowest place.

title: Luke 14:10
text: "But when you are invited, go and sit down in the lowest place, so that when your host arrives he may say to you, `My friend, come up higher.' Then you will be honored before the other guest.

title: Luke 14:11
text: "For every one who exalts himself shall be humbled, and he who humbles himself shall be exalted."

title: Luke 14:12
text: Also to his host who had invited him, he continued, saying: "When you are making a dinner-party or a supper, do not invite your friends, or your brothers, or your relatives, or your rich neighbors, lest it chance that they invite you in return, and a recompense be made by you.

title: Luke 14:13
text: "But when you make a reception, invite the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind.

title: Luke 14:14
text: "Then you will be blessed, because they have no means to repay you, but you shall be paid in the Resurrection of the Just."

title: Luke 14:15
text: One of his fellow guest who was listening to him, said to him, "Blessed are those who eat bread in the kingdom of God."

title: Luke 14:16
text: Jesus answered: "A certain man was making a great feast to which he invited many guests.

title: Luke 14:17
text: "At dinnertime he sent his slave to say to those who had been invited, `Come, for all things are now ready.'

title: Luke 14:18
text: "And they all, without exception, proceeded to excuse themselves. The first told him: `I have bought a field, and must needs go and see it. Pray have me excused.'

title: Luke 14:19
text: "The second said: `I have bought five yolk of oxen and am on my way to try them. I pray that you will have me excused.'

title: Luke 14:20
text: "`I have taken a wife,' said the another, `and for that reason I am unable to come.'

title: Luke 14:21
text: "So the slave came and presented all these answers to his master. Then the master of the house was indignant, and said to his slave: `Go out, quickly, into the streets and alleys of the city, and bring in hither the poor, the maimed, the blind, the lame.'

title: Luke 14:22
text: "And the slave said, `My master, your orders have been carried out, but yet there is room.'

title: Luke 14:23
text: "Said the master to his slave: `Go out into the roads and the hedges, and make them come in, so that my house may be filled.

title: Luke 14:24
text: "`For I tell you that not one of those invited guests shall taste my supper.'"

title: Luke 14:25
text: Great crowds were along with him, and he turned to them and said:

title: Luke 14:26
text: "If any one comes to me and does not hate father and his mother, his wife and children, his brothers and sisters, yes, and his own very life also, he cannot be a disciple of mine.

title: Luke 14:27
text: "Whoever does not carry his own cross and come after me, cannot be a disciple of mine.

title: Luke 14:28
text: "Which of you who is desirous of building a tower, does not sit down first and count the cost, to see if he has the means to complete it?

title: Luke 14:29
text: "Lest it happen that after he has laid the foundations and is unable to complete it, all who see it shall begin to jeer at him saying,

title: Luke 14:30
text: "`This fellow began to build and could not finish.'

title: Luke 14:31
text: "Or what king as he goes forth to join battle with another king in war does not sit down first and deliberate whether he can meet with ten thousand men the one who is advancing against him with twenty thousand?

title: Luke 14:32
text: "If he cannot, while the other king is yet a great way off, he sends an embassy to ask conditions of peace.

title: Luke 14:33
text: "Just so any one of you who does not renounce all that he has cannot be my disciple.

title: Luke 14:34
text: "Salt is good, but if even the salt have lost its flavor, with what shall it be seasoned?

title: Luke 14:35
text: "It is fit neither for the land nor the dung-hill; men cast it out. He who has ears to hear let him listen to this!"

title: Luke 15:1
text: Now all the tax-gatherers and sinners continued to draw near him, and to listen to him.

title: Luke 15:2
text: And the Pharisees and Scribes began to complain, saying, "He is welcoming sinners and eating with them!"

title: Luke 15:3
text: And he told them a parable:

title: Luke 15:4
text: "Which one of you men, if he has a hundred sheep, and has lost one of them, does not leave the ninety and nine in the desert and go after the lost one until he finds it?

title: Luke 15:5
text: "And after he has found it, he lays it on his shoulder, rejoicing.

title: Luke 15:6
text: "When he gets home he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying, "Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep that was lost.'

title: Luke 15:7
text: "I say to you that even so there shall be joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, more than over ninety and nine just persons who need no repentance.

title: Luke 15:8
text: "Or, again, suppose a woman has ten coins. If she loses one, does she not light a lamp and sweep the house, and search anxiously until she finds it?

title: Luke 15:9
text: "And when she has found it, she calls together her woman friends and neighbors and say, `Rejoice with me, for I have found the coin which I had lost.'

title: Luke 15:10
text: "Even so I tell you there is joy in the presence of the angels for God over one sinner who repents."

title: Luke 15:11
text: And he said: "There was a man who had two sons.

title: Luke 15:12
text: "The younger of them said to his father, `Father, give me the share of your property which is coming to me.' So he divided his means among them.

title: Luke 15:13
text: "Not many days after that the younger son gathered everything together and took his journey into a distant country; and there he wasted his money on living unsavingly.

title: Luke 15:14
text: "After he had spent everything there came a terrible famine in the land, and he began to be in want.

title: Luke 15:15
text: "So he went and hired to one of the citizens of that land, who sent him out into the fields to feed swine.

title: Luke 15:16
text: "And he was longing to be filled with the husks which the swine were eating, but no one gave him any.

title: Luke 15:17
text: "When he came to himself he said: "`How many of my father's hired men have bread enough and to spare, while I am perishing of hunger!

title: Luke 15:18
text: "`I will rise and go to my father, and say to him: "Father, I have sinned against Heaven and in your sight,

title: Luke 15:19
text: "`"I am no more worthy to be called your son; only make me like one of your hired men."'

title: Luke 15:20
text: "So he arose and went to his father; but while he was yet a great way off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion, and ran and fell on his neck and kissed him.

title: Luke 15:21
text: "The son said to him, `Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight and am no more worthy to be called your son.'

title: Luke 15:22
text: "`Fetch the best robe, quick,' said the father to his slaves, `and put it on him, and give him a ring on his finger, and shoes on his feet.

title: Luke 15:23
text: "`Bring that fatted calf and kill it, and let us eat and make merry,

title: Luke 15:24
text: "`for this son of mine was dead and is alive again--he was lost and is found.'

title: Luke 15:25
text: "So they began to make merry. But his elder son was in the field, and as he drew near to the house he heard music and dancing,

title: Luke 15:26
text: "and he summoned one of the slaves, and began to inquire of him what all this meant.

title: Luke 15:27
text: "`Your brother is come,' he replied, `and your father has killed the fatted calf, because he has him safe and sound.'

title: Luke 15:28
text: "But he was angry and would not go in; so his father came out, and attempted to plead with him; but he said to his father:

title: Luke 15:29
text: "`All these years I have been slaving for you and never disobeyed a command of yours. Yet you never gave me even a kid so that I might make merry with my friends.

title: Luke 15:30
text: "`But when this son of yours came, who has devoured your property with harlots, you have killed him the fatted calf.'

title: Luke 15:31
text: "`My dear son,' answered his father, `you are always with me and all that is mine is yours.

title: Luke 15:32
text: "`But it was fitting that we should make merry and rejoice, for this brother of yours was dead and is alive; he was lost and is found.'"

title: Luke 16:1
text: To his disciples he said: "There was a certain rich man who had a steward, and this steward was accused to him of wasting his property.

title: Luke 16:2
text: "He called to him to him and said: "`What is this that I hear about you? Render an account of your stewardship; for you can no longer be steward.'

title: Luke 16:3
text: "Now the steward said to himself: `What shall I do, now that my master is taking away my stewardship? I am not strong enough to dig, to beg I am ashamed.

title: Luke 16:4
text: "`I know what I will do, so that when I am put out of my stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.'

title: Luke 16:5
text: "So he called to him each of his master's debtors and said to the first, `How much money do you owe my master?'

title: Luke 16:6
text: "`A hundred measures of oil,' he answered. "He said to him, `Take your bill and sit down quickly and write fifty."

title: Luke 16:7
text: "To a second he said, `How much do you owe?' "The man answered, `A hundred measures of wheat.' "`Here is you bill,' he said, `change it to eighty measures.'

title: Luke 16:8
text: "And the master praised the unjust steward because he had acted shrewdly; for the sons of this world are in relation to their own generation wiser than the sons of the light.

title: Luke 16:9
text: "And to you I say, Use mammon, dishonest as it is, to make yourselves friends, so that when it shall fail they will welcome you to the eternal tabernacles.

title: Luke 16:10
text: "The man who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much, and he who is unjust in a very little, is unjust also as much.

title: Luke 16:11
text: "If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will trust to you the true riches?

title: Luke 16:12
text: "And if you are not faithful with what belongs to another, who will give you what is your own?

title: Luke 16:13
text: "No one can be a household servants to two masters; for either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will cling to the one and despise the other. You cannot be the slave of God and of Mammon."

title: Luke 16:14
text: Now the Pharisees who loved money listened to all this and they jeered at him.

title: Luke 16:15
text: He said to them: "You are those that justify themselves in the eyes of men; but God knows you hearts; for that which is lofty in the eyes of men is abomination in the eyes of God.

title: Luke 16:16
text: "The Law and the Prophet lasted until John; since then the gospel of the kingdom of God is preached, and any one presses in.

title: Luke 16:17
text: "Yet it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away then for one title of the law to fail.

title: Luke 16:18
text: "Every man who divorces his wife and marries some one else, commits adultery; and he who marries one who is put away by her husband commits adultery.

title: Luke 16:19
text: "Now there was a certain rich man who was clothed in purple and fine linen, and made merry every day in splendor.

title: Luke 16:20
text: "And a certain beggar named Lazarus was thrown at his door.

title: Luke 16:21
text: "He was full of sores, and longingly desired to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man's table. Yes! even the dogs came and licked his sores.

title: Luke 16:22
text: "But in the course of time the beggar died; and he was carried by angels into Abraham's bosom.

title: Luke 16:23
text: "The rich man also died, and was buried. And as he was tormented in Hades, he lifted up his eyes and saw Abraham afar off and Lazarus in his bosom.

title: Luke 16:24
text: "And he cried out and said, `Father Abraham have mercy on me; and send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue, for I am in anguish in this flame.'

title: Luke 16:25
text: "`Remember my son.' said Abraham, `that you had in your lifetime all your good things, and in the same way Lazarus his evil things; but now here he is comforted, and you are in anguish.

title: Luke 16:26
text: "But besides all this, between us and you there is a great chasm fixed, so that those who want to cross from here to you cannot, nor can those who would cross from you to us.'

title: Luke 16:27
text: "`I beg you then, father,' he said, `send him to my fathers house. For I have five brothers.

title: Luke 16:28
text: "`Let him earnestly warn them, lest they too come to this place of torment.'

title: Luke 16:29
text: "But Abraham said, `They have Moses and the Prophets, let them listen to them.'

title: Luke 16:30
text: "`Nay, Father Abraham,' he said `but if some one went to them from the dead they would repent.'

title: Luke 16:31
text: "`If they will not listen to Moses and the prophets,' said Father Abraham, `neither will they be persuaded if one should rise from the dead.'"

title: Luke 17:1
text: Jesus said to his disciples: "It is not possible but that occasions of stumbling should occur, but woe to him through whom they come!

title: Luke 17:2
text: "It were well for him if a millstone were tied about his neck, and he were hurled into the sea, rather than he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.

title: Luke 17:3
text: "Be on you guard! "If your brother sins, rebuke him, and if he repents forgive him.

title: Luke 17:4
text: "And if he sins against you seven times a day, and seven times a day turns to you saying `I repent,' you shall forgive him."

title: Luke 17:5
text: The apostles said to the Lord, "Increase our faith!"

title: Luke 17:6
text: "If your faith," answered Jesus, "were like a grain of mustard-seed, you would say to this tree, `Tear yourself up and be planted in the sea,' and it would obey you.

title: Luke 17:7
text: "But who of you who has a slave plowing or keeping sheep, will say to him, when he is come in from the field, `Come at once, sit down to dinner,'

title: Luke 17:8
text: "and will not rather tell him, `Get ready something for me to eat, and gird yourself to wait on me until I have eaten and drunken. Then you shall eat and drink.'

title: Luke 17:9
text: "Does he think the slave because he did the things that were commanded?

title: Luke 17:10
text: "Even so, you also, after you have done all the things that are commanded you, should say, `We are but slaves, we have only done what it was our duty to do.'"

title: Luke 17:11
text: Now it happened that as he went his way to Jerusalem, he passed between Samaria and Galilee.

title: Luke 17:12
text: And as he was going certain village ten lepers met him.

title: Luke 17:13
text: They stood at a distance and lifted up their voices, saying, "Jesus, Master, take pity on us."

title: Luke 17:14
text: Perceiving this he said to them, "Go and show yourselves to the priest." And as they went they were made clean.

title: Luke 17:15
text: Now one of them, as he saw that he was cured, came back, glorifying God in a loud voice,

title: Luke 17:16
text: and he fell on his face at the feet of Jesus and thanked him. He was a Samaritan.

title: Luke 17:17
text: "Were there not ten cleansed?" asked Jesus, "but where are the nine?

title: Luke 17:18
text: "Are there none found to return and give glory to God except this foreigner?"

title: Luke 17:19
text: And he said unto him, "Rise and go, your faith has healed you."

title: Luke 17:20
text: The Pharisees asked him when the kingdom of God was coming. He answered: "The kingdom of God does not come so that you can catch sight of it,

title: Luke 17:21
text: "nor will they say, `Look here it is!' or `See there!'--for the kingdom of God is now in your midst."

title: Luke 17:22
text: Then he said turning to his disciples: "The days will come when you shall long to see one of the days of the Son of man, you shall not see it.

title: Luke 17:23
text: "And they shall say to you, `Lo there! Lo there!' But do not go away or follow them.

title: Luke 17:24
text: "For as the lightning when it lightens out of the one part under heaven shines to the other part under heaven, so shall the Son of man be in his day.

title: Luke 17:25
text: "But first he must suffer many things, and be rejected buy his generation.

title: Luke 17:26
text: "And this was in the time of Noah, so will it be in the time of the Son of man.

title: Luke 17:27
text: "Men were eating and drinking; they were marrying and being married, until the day that Noah entered into the ark, and the flood came and destroyed them all.

title: Luke 17:28
text: "The same was true in the time of Lot; they were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building;

title: Luke 17:29
text: "but on the day that Lot left Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven and destroyed them all.

title: Luke 17:30
text: "In the same manner it shall be in the day that the Son of man shall be revealed.

title: Luke 17:31
text: "On that day, if a man is on the housetop and his goods inside, let him not go down to take them away; nor should a man in the field turn back.

title: Luke 17:32
text: "Remember Lot's wife!

title: Luke 17:33
text: "Whoever seeks to keep his life shall lose it; but whoever loses it shall preserve it.

title: Luke 17:34
text: "I tell you that in one night there shall be two men in one bed; one shall be taken and the other left.

title: Luke 17:35
text: "There shall be two women grinding together; the one shall be taken and the other left."

title: Luke 17:36
text: (wanting in the most ancient manuscripts)

title: Luke 17:37
text: "Where, Master?" they asked him. "Where the dead body is," he answered, "there will the vultures be gathered together."

title: Luke 18:1
text: He also taught them by a parable how they ought always to pray and never to lose heart.

title: Luke 18:2
text: "There was a certain town," he said, "a judge who had neither reverence for God, nor respect for man.

title: Luke 18:3
text: "In that same town there was a widow who came again and again before him, saying, "`Do for me the justice of my adversary.'

title: Luke 18:4
text: "For a while he would not, but afterwards he said to himself, `Though I have neither reverence for God nor regard for man,

title: Luke 18:5
text: "`yet because this woman annoys me I will give her justice, lest by her continual coming she wear me out.'

title: Luke 18:6
text: "Listen" said the Lord, "to what this unjust judge says.

title: Luke 18:7
text: "And will not God see justice done to his elect who are crying unto him day and night, even if he seems to delay helping them?

title: Luke 18:8
text: "I tell you that he will quickly see justice done to his elect! Nevertheless, when the Son of man comes, will he find faith upon the earth?"

title: Luke 18:9
text: Moreover he spoke this parable to some who trusted in themselves because they were righteous, and looked down upon the rest:

title: Luke 18:10
text: "Two men are going up to the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, the other a tax-gatherer.

title: Luke 18:11
text: "The Pharisee stood apart and thus began to pray by himself: "`O God, I thank thee that I am not like the rest of men, extortioners, rogues, adulterers, or even like this tax gatherer;

title: Luke 18:12
text: "`I fast twice a week, I pay tithes of all my possessions.'

title: Luke 18:13
text: "But the tax-gatherer, standing far back, would not lift up so much as his eyes to heaven, but kept beating his breast and saying, "`O God be merciful to me, the sinner!'

title: Luke 18:14
text: "I tell you that this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for every one who exalts himself shall be humbled; but he who humbles himself shall be exalted."

title: Luke 18:15
text: And they kept bringing their babies for him to touch them; but when his disciples saw it they began to rebuke them.

title: Luke 18:16
text: But Jesus called for the babies. "Let the little children come to me," he said, "do not hinder them; for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

title: Luke 18:17
text: "I tell you in solemn truth that whoever will not receive the kingdom of God like a little child, he will never get into it."

title: Luke 18:18
text: A ruler put this question to him: "Good teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?"

title: Luke 18:19
text: "Why are you calling me `good'?" said Jesus to him; "no one is good but God.

title: Luke 18:20
text: "You know the commandments: "Do not commit adultery, Do not murder, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honor your father and mother."

title: Luke 18:21
text: "All of these," he replied, "I have kept from my youth up."

title: Luke 18:22
text: And receiving this reply, Jesus said to him: "One thing you are still lacking. Sell all that you have and give it to the poor, and you shall have treasure in heaven. Then come and follow me."

title: Luke 18:23
text: But when he heard these words he became deeply grieved, for he was exceedingly rich.

title: Luke 18:24
text: Jesus looked at him and said: "How hard it is for those who have money to enter into the kingdom of God!

title: Luke 18:25
text: Why, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God."

title: Luke 18:26
text: "Who then can be saved?" exclaimed his hearers.

title: Luke 18:27
text: "Things that are impossible with men," he answered them, "are possible with God."

title: Luke 18:28
text: Then Peter said, "Look! we have left our homes and followed you."

title: Luke 18:29
text: And he said to them, "In Solemn truth I tell you that there is no one who, for the sake of the kingdom of God, has left houses, or wife, or brother, or parents, or children,

title: Luke 18:30
text: "who shall not certainly receive many times as much in this time, and in the age to come eternal."

title: Luke 18:31
text: Then he took the twelve aside and told them: "See, we are on our way to Jerusalem, and all prophets regarding the son of Man will be fulfilled.

title: Luke 18:32
text: "He will be betrayed to the Gentiles, and be mocked, and shamefully treated, and spit upon;

title: Luke 18:33
text: "and they will scourge and kill him; and the third day he will rise again."

title: Luke 18:34
text: But they understood none of these sayings. His words were a mystery to them, and they did not know what he meant.

title: Luke 18:35
text: As Jesus drew near to Jericho, there was a blind man who sat by the wayside begging.

title: Luke 18:36
text: He heard the crowd passing and asked what the matter was.

title: Luke 18:37
text: They told him, "Jesus of Nazareth is passing by."

title: Luke 18:38
text: Then he shouted out, saying, "Jesus, son of David, take pity on me!"

title: Luke 18:39
text: Those who went ahead began to reprove him and to tell him to be still; but he kept clamorously shouting all the more, "Son of David, take pity on me!"

title: Luke 18:40
text: So Jesus stopped and ordered him to be brought to him. When he was come near to him he asked him

title: Luke 18:41
text: "What do you want me to do for you?" "Lord," he answered, "that I might see again."

title: Luke 18:42
text: "Receive your sight," said Jesus, "your faith has saved you."

title: Luke 18:43
text: Instantly he regained his sight and followed Jesus, giving glory to God; and all the people who saw it gave praise to God.

title: Luke 19:1
text: So he entered Jericho and was passing through the town.

title: Luke 19:2
text: There was a man there, called Zaccheus, who was a chief of the tax-gatherers, and was wealthy.

title: Luke 19:3
text: And he kept trying to see what sort of a man Jesus was; but he could not see because he was short.

title: Luke 19:4
text: So he ran on before him and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him; for he was about to pass that way.

title: Luke 19:5
text: As soon as Jesus came to the place, he looked up and said to him, "Come down quickly, Zaccheus, for today I must stay at your house."

title: Luke 19:6
text: He made haste to climb down, and receive him joyfully.

title: Luke 19:7
text: When they all saw it, they began to complain, saying "He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner."

title: Luke 19:8
text: But Zaccheus stood up and said to the Lord, "I give half my property to the poor, Lord, and if I have defrauded any man of anything I am restoring it to him fourfold."

title: Luke 19:9
text: "Today is salvation come to this house," said Jesus "since Zaccheus here is a son of Abraham.

title: Luke 19:10
text: "For the Son of man is come to seek and to save the lost."

title: Luke 19:11
text: As they were listening to his words he added this parable, because he was near Jerusalem and they thought that the kingdom of God was immediately to appear.

title: Luke 19:12
text: So he said: "A certain nobleman went abroad to receive for himself royal power and to return.

title: Luke 19:13
text: "And he summoned ten slaves of his, and gave them ten pounds, and said to them, "`Trade with these until I come.'

title: Luke 19:14
text: "But this fellow citizens hated him, and sent a deputation after him to say, `We do not wish this man to become our king.'

title: Luke 19:15
text: "And upon his return after he had secured the royal power, he ordered the slaves to whom he had given the money to be called in, so that he might know what they had gained by trading.

title: Luke 19:16
text: "And the first came before him, saying, `Master, your pound has made ten pounds.'

title: Luke 19:17
text: "And he said to him, `Well done, good slave! Because you have been faithful in a very little, have authority over ten cities.'

title: Luke 19:18
text: "And the second came and said, `Master, your pound has made five pounds.'

title: Luke 19:19
text: "Then he said to him also, `You shall be over five cities.'

title: Luke 19:20
text: "And the next came to him and said, `Here master is your pound which I was keeping safe in a napkin.

title: Luke 19:21
text: "`For I was afraid of you, because you are a hard man. You take what you did not sow.'

title: Luke 19:22
text: "He said to him, "`By your own words I will Judge you, you wicked slave. You knew, did you, that I was a hard man taking up what I did not lay down, reaping what I did not sow.

title: Luke 19:23
text: "`Then why did you not put my money into the bank, so that at my coming I might I might have gotten it back with interest?'

title: Luke 19:24
text: "Then to those who stood by, he said, `Take the pounds from him and give it to him who has ten pounds.'

title: Luke 19:25
text: "`Master,' they said to him, `he already has ten pounds.'

title: Luke 19:26
text: "`I tell you that to every one who has it shall be given; and from him who has not shall be taken away even what he has.

title: Luke 19:27
text: "`Howbeit these enemies of mine who were not willing for me to become their King, bring them here, and slay them in my presence.'"

title: Luke 19:28
text: When he had so spoken he went on before, going up to Jerusalem.

title: Luke 19:29
text: When he was come near Bethphage and Bethany at the mount called The Olive Orchard,

title: Luke 19:30
text: he sent two of his disciples saying: "Go into the village in the front, and on entering it you will find an ass's colt tied, on which no one has ever ridden.

title: Luke 19:31
text: "Untie it and bring it here. And if any one asks you, `Why are you untying the colt?' Simply say, `The Master needs it.'"

title: Luke 19:32
text: Then those who were sent out and found it as he had told them.

title: Luke 19:33
text: For as they were untying the colt, the owners said to them, "Why are you untying the colt?"

title: Luke 19:34
text: They answered, "The Master needs it."

title: Luke 19:35
text: So they led it to Jesus, and, after throwing their outer garments on the colt, they placed Jesus on it.

title: Luke 19:36
text: So he rode on, while they kept throwing their garments in the way.

title: Luke 19:37
text: And when now he was coming near Jerusalem, and descending the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice, and to praise God with a loud voice for the almighty works they had seen.

title: Luke 19:38
text: They cried, "Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in Heaven and glory in the Highest"

title: Luke 19:39
text: And some of the Pharisees said to them out of the crowd, "Teacher reprove your disciples!"

title: Luke 19:40
text: "I tell you," he answered, "that if these should hold their peace, the very stones would cry out."

title: Luke 19:41
text: And when he came into view of the city, as he approached it he broke into loud weeping,

title: Luke 19:42
text: exclaiming: "Oh that at this time you knew, yes, even you, on what your peace depends! But now it is hidden from your eyes.

title: Luke 19:43
text: "The time will come for you when your enemies will throw ramparts around you, and encompass you, and shut you in on every side, and raze you to the ground,

title: Luke 19:44
text: "you and your children within you. And they will not leave in you one stone upon the another. Because you knew not the time of your visitation."

title: Luke 19:45
text: Then Jesus went into the Temple and began to drive out dealers,

title: Luke 19:46
text: saying, "It is written, "The house of God shall be called a house of prayer, but you have made it a den of robbers."

title: Luke 19:47
text: Day after day he continued to teach in the Temple. The high priests and scribes tried to have him put to death, so did the rulers of the people.

title: Luke 19:48
text: But they could not find how to do it, for the people all hung upon him, listening to him.

title: Luke 20:1
text: On one of the days while he was teaching the people in the Temple and preaching the gospel, there came up the priest and the Scribes with the elders.

title: Luke 20:2
text: They spoke to him saying: "Tell us by what authority you are doing these things? Who is it that gave you this authority?"

title: Luke 20:3
text: "I will also ask you a question," he replied.

title: Luke 20:4
text: "Was John's baptism from heaven or from man?"

title: Luke 20:5
text: So they reasoned among themselves: "If we say, `From heaven,' he will ask us, `Why did you not believe in him?'

title: Luke 20:6
text: "And if we say, `From man,' all the people will stone us, for they were persuaded that John was a prophet."

title: Luke 20:7
text: So they answered that they did not know whence it was.

title: Luke 20:8
text: "Nor will I tell you," Jesus answered, "by whose authority I do these things."

title: Luke 20:9
text: Then he began to tell the people this parable: "There was a man who planted a vineyard, and let it out to vine-dressers, and went to another country for a long time.

title: Luke 20:10
text: "At harvest-time he sent a slave to the vine-dressers, to ask them to give him a share of the crop; but the vine-dresser beat him and sent him away empty-handed.

title: Luke 20:11
text: "Then he sent another slave; and him also they flogged and handled shamefully and sent him away empty-handed.

title: Luke 20:12
text: "Then he sent yet a third, and him to they wounded and threw him out.

title: Luke 20:13
text: "Then the master of the vineyard said: "`What shall I do? I will send my beloved Son; it may be that they will reverence him.'

title: Luke 20:14
text: "But when the vine-dressers saw him, they reasoned together, saying: `This is the heir. Let us kill him so that the inheritance may be ours.'

title: Luke 20:15
text: "So they turned him out of the vineyard and killed him. "What will the master of the vineyard do to them?

title: Luke 20:16
text: "He will come and destroy those vine-dressers, and will give the vineyard to others."

title: Luke 20:17
text: He looked at them and said: "Then what does this scripture mean. "The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the head of the corner?

title: Luke 20:18
text: "Every one who falls on that stone will be broken in pieces; but whoever it falls upon will be scattered as dust."

title: Luke 20:19
text: At this the Scribes and the high priests were seeking to arrest him; only they were afraid of the people. For they perceived that he had referred to them in this parable.

title: Luke 20:20
text: So they watched him, and sent spies who pretended to be honest men, in order to seize on his speech, and to deliver him up to authority and jurisdiction of the governor.

title: Luke 20:21
text: So they put a question to him saying: "Rabbi, we know that you speak and teach what is right, and that you do not regard any man's person, but teach the way of God honestly.

title: Luke 20:22
text: "Is it lawful for us to pay tribute to Caesar or not?"

title: Luke 20:23
text: But he perceived their knavery and answered:

title: Luke 20:24
text: "Show me a shilling. Whose image and superscription does it bear?" "Caesar's," they replied.

title: Luke 20:25
text: "Then give to Caesar what belongs to him," he said, "to God give what is God's."

title: Luke 20:26
text: So they could not lay hold of his sayings before the people; and marveling at his answer, they held their peace.

title: Luke 20:27
text: Next came some of the Sadducees who deny that there is resurrection, and they asked him:

title: Luke 20:28
text: "Teacher, Moses wrote a law for us that if a man's brother should die, but leave no children, his brother should take up his wife and raise up his children for his brother.

title: Luke 20:29
text: "Now there were seven brothers: the first took a wife and died childless,

title: Luke 20:30
text: "and the second and third took her,

title: Luke 20:31
text: "and likewise all the seven, but left no children when they died.

title: Luke 20:32
text: "Last of all the woman died too.

title: Luke 20:33
text: "In the resurrection whose wife shall she be? For they all seven had her as wife."

title: Luke 20:34
text: "People in this world marry and are given in marriage," said Jesus,

title: Luke 20:35
text: "but those who are counted worthy to reach that world and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage.

title: Luke 20:36
text: "For indeed they cannot die any more; they are equal to the angels, and through being sons of the resurrection are sons of God.

title: Luke 20:37
text: "But that the dead are raised, even Moses clearly implied in the passage about the Bush, when he calls the Lord. ["The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, the God of Jacob.]

title: Luke 20:38
text: "Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living; for to him all are alive.'

title: Luke 20:39
text: Then some of the Scribes said, "Teacher, that was nobly said,"

title: Luke 20:40
text: for they no longer dared to ask him any questions.

title: Luke 20:41
text: "How is it," he asked them, "that they say that Christ is David's son?

title: Luke 20:42
text: "for David himself say's in the book of the Psalms, "The Lord said to my Lord: Sit at my right hand,

title: Luke 20:43
text: Until I make thy enemies the footstool at thy feet.

title: Luke 20:44
text: "David therefore himself calls him `Lord,' and how can he be his son?"

title: Luke 20:45
text: Then, in the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples:

title: Luke 20:46
text: "Beware of the Scribes who like to walk about in long robes, and dote on salutations in the marketplaces, and on securing the front seats in the synagogues and the best places at banquets;

title: Luke 20:47
text: "but they devour widows' houses and for a pretense make long prayers. These shall receive severer condemnation."

title: Luke 21:1
text: And he looked up and saw people casting their offerings into the treasury, and they were rich.

title: Luke 21:2
text: And he saw a certain poor widow casting in two mites

title: Luke 21:3
text: And he said: "Of truth I tell you that this poor widow has put in more than than they all;

title: Luke 21:4
text: "for these men have all contributed to the offering out of their surplus, but she, out of her want, contributed all she had to live on."

title: Luke 21:5
text: And to some who were about the Temple, how it was adorned with beautiful stones votive offerings, he said,

title: Luke 21:6
text: "As for what you are looking at, the time is coming when not one stone will be left upon another, that shall not be thrown down."

title: Luke 21:7
text: "Teacher, when will this be?" they asked him, "and what shall be the sign that these things are about to happen?"

title: Luke 21:8
text: "Take heed," he answered, "that you are not led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, `I am he,' and `The time is close at hand.' Do not go and follow them.

title: Luke 21:9
text: "And when you shall hear of wars and tumults, do not be frightened; for these things must happen first, but the end does not come immediately."

title: Luke 21:10
text: Then he said to them: "Nation shall rise against nation, kingdom against kingdom:

title: Luke 21:11
text: "and there shall be great earthquakes, and, in many places, famines and pestilences; and there shall be terror and great portents from heaven.

title: Luke 21:12
text: "But before all these things happen, they will apprehend you and persecute you and deliver you to the synagogues and to prisons, and bring you before kings and governors for the sake of my name.

title: Luke 21:13
text: "It shall turn out for a testimony to you.

title: Luke 21:14
text: "So settle it in your hearts not to prepare a defense beforehand,

title: Luke 21:15
text: "for I will give you utterance and a wisdom which none of your adversaries will be able to answer or withstand.

title: Luke 21:16
text: "You will be betrayed even by parents or brothers and kinsfolk, and friends.

title: Luke 21:17
text: "Some of you they will put to death. And you shall be hated by all men for the sake of my name.

title: Luke 21:18
text: "And not a hair on your head shall perish.

title: Luke 21:19
text: "In your patience you shall purchase your souls.

title: Luke 21:20
text: "But when you see Jerusalem encompassed with armies, then know that her desolation is at hand.

title: Luke 21:21
text: "Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains; and let those who are in the country enter not in.

title: Luke 21:22
text: "For these are the days of vengeance and of fulfilment of all that is written.

title: Luke 21:23
text: "Woe to women with child and to those who are nursing infants in those days! For sore anguish will come upon the land, and wrath upon all his people.

title: Luke 21:24
text: "They shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led captive among the Gentiles, and Jerusalem shall be trampled under foot by the Gentiles, until the appointed times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.

title: Luke 21:25
text: "And there will be signs in the sun and the moon and the stars; and on the earth distress of nations in perplexity at the roar of the sea and the billows;

title: Luke 21:26
text: "men lifeless through fear, and foreboding of that which is about to come upon the habitable earth. For the powers of the heavens shall be shaken,

title: Luke 21:27
text: "and then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud, with power and great glory.

title: Luke 21:28
text: "But when these things begin to come to pass, look up, lift your heads! for your redemption is drawing near."

title: Luke 21:29
text: And he told them a parable:

title: Luke 21:30
text: "Look at the fig tree and all the trees! When they put out their leaves you can see for yourselves that summer is coming.

title: Luke 21:31
text: "So whenever you see all these things comings to pass, you know that the kingdom of God is near.

title: Luke 21:32
text: "In solemn truth I tell you that this generation shall not pass away until all this happens.

title: Luke 21:33
text: "Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words shall never pass away.

title: Luke 21:34
text: "But take heed to yourselves lest your hearts be surcharged with self-indulgence and drunkenness and worldly cares, and that day catches you suddenly like a trap.

title: Luke 21:35
text: "For it will come upon all the dwellers on the face of the earth.

title: Luke 21:36
text: "So be on your guard at all times, praying that you may be worthy to escape these things that shall come to pass, and to take your stand in the presence of the Son of man."

title: Luke 21:37
text: And each day he was habitually in the Temple teaching, and at night he used to go out and lodge on the mount called the Olives Orchards.

title: Luke 21:38
text: And all the people used to come him early in the morning in the Temple, to listen to him.

title: Luke 22:1
text: Now the festival of Unleavened Bread, which is called the Passover, was drawing near.

title: Luke 22:2
text: The high priest and the Scribes continually sought means to put him to death.

title: Luke 22:3
text: Satan however, entered into Judas (the man called Iscariot), who was one of the twelve.

title: Luke 22:4
text: And he went out and conferred with the chief priests and commanders

title: Luke 22:5
text: They were delighted, and agreed to give him money.

title: Luke 22:6
text: He consented to this, and looked for an opportunity to betray him, when the people were not present.

title: Luke 22:7
text: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread, on which the paschal lamb must be sacrificed.

title: Luke 22:8
text: So Jesus went to Peter and John saying, "Go and prepare for us the Passover, that we may eat it."

title: Luke 22:9
text: "Where shall we get it ready?" they asked.

title: Luke 22:10
text: He answered: "No sooner will you have entered the city than you will meet a man carrying a water-jug. Follow him into the house were he is going.

title: Luke 22:11
text: "And to the good man of the house say, `The teacher asks you, "Where is the room in which I can eat the Passover with my disciples?"'

title: Luke 22:12
text: "Then he will show you a large upper room furnished. There make your preparations."

title: Luke 22:13
text: So they went and found everything as he had told them, they prepared the Passover.

title: Luke 22:14
text: And when the hour was come he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him,

title: Luke 22:15
text: and he said to them: "With desire have I longed to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.

title: Luke 22:16
text: For I tell you that I certainly will not eat again until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God."

title: Luke 22:17
text: Then he had received a cup and given thanks, he said,

title: Luke 22:18
text: "Take this, and divide it among yourselves; for I tell you that I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God is come."

title: Luke 22:19
text: And he took a loaf, and after giving thanks, he broke it and gave it to them saying: "This is my body, which is given for you; this do in remembrance of me.'

title: Luke 22:20
text: He gave them a cup in like manner, after supper saying: "This cup is the new covenant in my blood, poured out for your sake.

title: Luke 22:21
text: "But behold, the hand of my betrayer is at the table with me!

title: Luke 22:22
text: "The Son of man indeed goes on his way, as it has been determined; but woe to that man by who he is betrayed."

title: Luke 22:23
text: And they began to question among themselves which of them it could be who was going to do such a thing.

title: Luke 22:24
text: And there arose also a dispute among them as to which of them could be considered the greatest,

title: Luke 22:25
text: and he said to them: "The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them, and those who have who have authority over them are called Benefactors.

title: Luke 22:26
text: "But you shall not be so. But he who is greater among you let him become like the younger; and he who is leader like him who serves.

title: Luke 22:27
text: "For which is greater, he who sits at table, or he who serves? Is it not he who sits at table? But I am in your midst as one who serves.

title: Luke 22:28
text: "You, however, are those who have stood by me in my trials.

title: Luke 22:29
text: "And I promise you a kingdom, even as my Father has promised me a kingdom;

title: Luke 22:30
text: "so that you shall eat and drink in my kingdom, and you shall sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

title: Luke 22:31
text: "Simon, Simon," said the Lord, "behold, Satan has asked to have you all that he might sift you like wheat.

title: Luke 22:32
text: "But I made supplication for you that your own faith may not fail. And you, when you have turned again, must strengthen your brothers."

title: Luke 22:33
text: "Lord," Simon said to him, "I am ready to go with you, both to prison and to death."

title: Luke 22:34
text: "I tell you, Peter," he answered. "the cock will not crow this day until you will three times deny that you know me."

title: Luke 22:35
text: Moreover, he said to them, "When I sent you out without purse or wallet or sandals, did you lack anything?" They answered him, "We lacked nothing.'

title: Luke 22:36
text: Then he said to them: "But now let him who has a purse take it, and he who has a wallet, let him the do the same. And he who has no sword, let him sell his cloak and buy one.

title: Luke 22:37
text: "For I say to you that this word of Scripture must find it's fulfilment in me: "And he was numbered among the transgressors, For that which concerns me has its accomplishment."

title: Luke 22:38
text: "Master" they said, "here are two swords!" "That is enough," he answered.

title: Luke 22:39
text: Then he went out, and began to go to the Mount of Olives, as was his wont; and his disciples followed him.

title: Luke 22:40
text: But he arrived at the place he said to them, "Pray that you enter not into temptation."

title: Luke 22:41
text: But he himself withdrew from them about a stone's throw, kneeling down he prayed repeatedly, saying:

title: Luke 22:42
text: "Father, if thou art willing, take away this cup from me; but thy will, not mine, be done!"

title: Luke 22:43
text: (And there appeared to him an angel from heaven, strengthening him.

title: Luke 22:44
text: (And being in agony he kept praying more earnestly; and his sweat became as if it were great drops of blood falling down upon the ground.)

title: Luke 22:45
text: When he arose from his prayers, and came to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,

title: Luke 22:46
text: and said to them: "Why are you asleep? Get up, and pray that you enter not into temptation."

title: Luke 22:47
text: While he was still speaking there came a crowd, and he who was called Judas, one of the Twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus in order to kiss him,

title: Luke 22:48
text: but Jesus said to him, "Judas, you are betraying the Son of man with a kiss?"

title: Luke 22:49
text: Those who were around him, when they saw what was about to happen, said to him, "Lord, shall we strike with our swords?"

title: Luke 22:50
text: Then one of them did strike a blow at the high priest's slave, and cut off his right ear.

title: Luke 22:51
text: "Permit me to do this at least," said Jesus, as he touched his ear and healed him.

title: Luke 22:52
text: Then Jesus said to the corps of priests and captains of the temple and elders who had come out to arrest him: "Have ye come for me with swords and clubs to arrest me like a robber?

title: Luke 22:53
text: "When daily I was with you in the temple you did not stretch out your hands to take me; but this is your hour and the power of darkness."

title: Luke 22:54
text: So they seized him and led him away, and took him to the house of the high priest; while Peter was following him a long way off.

title: Luke 22:55
text: And when they had lighted a fire in the center of the court, and had sat down together, Peter was taking his seat among them.

title: Luke 22:56
text: But a certain maid servant saw him taking his seat near the fire and, with a sharp glance at him, she said, "This fellow was with him, too!"

title: Luke 22:57
text: But he denied it, saying, "Woman, I know nothing about him."

title: Luke 22:58
text: A little later a man saw him, and said, "You too are one of them" But Peter declared, "Man, I am not."

title: Luke 22:59
text: But an hour afterwards another man kept insisting, saying: "Really , this fellow was with him. Why, he is a Galilean."

title: Luke 22:60
text: "Man," said Peter, "I do not know what you mean." And immediately, while he was still speaking, the cock crew.

title: Luke 22:61
text: Then the Lord turned and looked at Peter, and Peter recollected the word of the Lord, how he had said to him, "This very day, before the cock crows, you will deny me three times."

title: Luke 22:62
text: And Peter went outside and wept with bitter crying.

title: Luke 22:63
text: Meanwhile the men who were holding Jesus in custody kept mocking and striking him.

title: Luke 22:64
text: They would blindfold him and ask him: "Prophesy! Tell who struck you!"

title: Luke 22:65
text: And they said many other insulting things against him.

title: Luke 22:66
text: When it became the day the elders if the people met with the high priests and the Scribes and had brought before the Sanhedrin, saying:

title: Luke 22:67
text: "Are you the Christ? Tell us!" "If I tell you," he answered, "you will not believe;

title: Luke 22:68
text: "And if I ask you, you will not answer.

title: Luke 22:69
text: "But from henceforth the Son of man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God."

title: Luke 22:70
text: Then they all said, "Are you then the Son of God."

title: Luke 22:71
text: "What need we of further evidence? for we ourselves have heard it from his own lips."

title: Luke 23:1
text: Then the whole company rose up and brought him to Pilate,

title: Luke 23:2
text: and began to accuse him: "We have found this fellow perverting our nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, and proclaiming that he is the Messiah and King."

title: Luke 23:3
text: Then Pilate asked him, "Are you the King of the Jews?" And he answered him saying, "Certainly I am."

title: Luke 23:4
text: And Pilate said to the chief priest and the crowd, "I find no harm in this man."

title: Luke 23:5
text: But they repeatedly insisted, "He is stirring up the people throughout all Judea with his teaching which started from Galilee."

title: Luke 23:6
text: When Pilate heard the word "Galilee" he asked if the man were a Galilean,

title: Luke 23:7
text: and when he learned that he belonged to Herod's jurisdiction he sent him to Herod, who himself happened to be in Jerusalem during those days.

title: Luke 23:8
text: Now when Herod saw Jesus he was exceedingly glad. He had long been wanting to see him, because he had heard so much about him, and was hoping to see some miracles performed by him.

title: Luke 23:9
text: So he had been asking him many questions, but Jesus made no answers.

title: Luke 23:10
text: Meanwhile the high priests and Scribes were standing around, and continually making accusations to him against him.

title: Luke 23:11
text: Then Herod and his soldiers set him at naught, and mocked him, and throwing about him a gorgeous robe, sent him back to Pilate.

title: Luke 23:12
text: Herod and Pilate became friends again from that very day; for before they had been at enmity between themselves.

title: Luke 23:13
text: So Pilate called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,

title: Luke 23:14
text: and said to them: "You brought before me this man as one who incited the people to rebellion. I have examined him in your presence, and I find no fault in this man regarding the charges that you brought against him.

title: Luke 23:15
text: Neither does Herod; for he sent him back to us. You see that he has done nothing worthy of death.

title: Luke 23:16
text: I will therefore, after flogging him, release him."

title: Luke 23:17
text: "Now he had to release to them at the feast one prisoner."

title: Luke 23:18
text: Then the whole crowd shouted out, "Away with this man, and release to us Barabbas."

title: Luke 23:19
text: (This was a man who had been thrown in prison on account of a riot which had occurred in the city, and for murder.)

title: Luke 23:20
text: Then Pilate spoke to them again, because he wished to release Jesus;

title: Luke 23:21
text: but they continued to shout out and say, "Crucify! Crucify him!"

title: Luke 23:22
text: For the third time he appealed to them: "But what crime has he committed? I have found in him nothing that deserves death. I will therefore flog him, and let him go."

title: Luke 23:23
text: But they kept shouting the more insistently, demanding that he should be crucified, and their shouts won the day.

title: Luke 23:24
text: So Pilate gave sentence what they wished should be done.

title: Luke 23:25
text: He released the man who had been put in prison for riot and murder, the man whom they asked for; but Jesus he handed over to their will.

title: Luke 23:26
text: And when they led him away they took hold of Simon, a Cyrenean, who was coming in from the country, and laid the cross on him to carry it behind Jesus.

title: Luke 23:27
text: He was also followed by a great crowd of people, and of women too, who were beating their breast and lamenting him.

title: Luke 23:28
text: But Jesus turned to and said: "Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for me;

title: Luke 23:29
text: "but weep for yourselves and for your children. For behold, the days are coming when they shall say, `Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that have never bore children, and the breasts that never suckled.'

title: Luke 23:30
text: "Then they will begin to say to the mountains, `Fall on us!' and to the hills, `Cover us!'

title: Luke 23:31
text: "For if this is what they do in the green tree, what will they do in the dry?"

title: Luke 23:32
text: And there were led out with him to be executed, two criminals also.

title: Luke 23:33
text: When they came to the place called "The Skull," there they crucified him and the criminals also, one upon his right hand, and one upon his left.

title: Luke 23:34
text: Jesus kept saying, "Father forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing." And they divided his garments among them, casting lots for them,

title: Luke 23:35
text: and the people stood looking on. Even the rulers repeatedly taunted him, saying, "He saved others, let him save himself, if this fellow is indeed the Christ of God, His Chosen One!"

title: Luke 23:36
text: Even the soldiers made sport of him by coming up and offering him sour wine,

title: Luke 23:37
text: saying, "If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself."

title: Luke 23:38
text: For there was an inscription over his head, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

title: Luke 23:39
text: And one of the criminals who had been hung there kept reviling him, saying: "Are you not the Christ? Save yourself and us."

title: Luke 23:40
text: But the other, answering, reproved him, saying: "Have you no fear of God even? When you are suffering the same punishment as he?

title: Luke 23:41
text: "We indeed justly, for we are receiving due retribution for what we have done. But he has done no wrong."

title: Luke 23:42
text: Then he added, "Jesus, remember me when you come in your kingdom."

title: Luke 23:43
text: "In solemn truth I tell you," said Jesus, "that this day you shall be with me in Paradise."

title: Luke 23:44
text: It was now about the sixth hour, and a darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.

title: Luke 23:45
text: And the sun was darkened, and the curtain of the sanctuary was torn in two in the Temple.

title: Luke 23:46
text: Then with a loud cry, Jesus said, "Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit!" And after uttering these words, he yielded up his spirit.

title: Luke 23:47
text: When the army captain saw what had happened, he glorified God, saying, "This man was really innocent!"

title: Luke 23:48
text: And all the crowds who had assembled to see this spectacle, after witnessing what had been done, were returning beating upon their breast.

title: Luke 23:49
text: But all his acquaintances and the women who had been his followers continued to stand at a distance, looking on.

title: Luke 23:50
text: Now there was a man named Joseph, a member of the Council, a good man and a righteous,

title: Luke 23:51
text: he who came from the Jewish town of Arimathea, and who was on the watch for the kingdom of God. He had not concurred in the designs and deed of the council.

title: Luke 23:52
text: This man went to Pilate, and begged for the body of Jesus.

title: Luke 23:53
text: Then taking it down, he wrapped it in linen, and placed it in a tomb hewn in the rock, where no man has ever been laid.

title: Luke 23:54
text: And it was the day of preparation and the Sabbath was near at hand.

title: Luke 23:55
text: Then the women who had accompanied him out of Galilee followed after, and noted the tomb, and how his body was placed.

title: Luke 23:56
text: Then they returned and prepared spices and perfumes.

title: Luke 24:1
text: On the Sabbath Day they rested in obedience to the commandment, but in the deep dawn of the first day of the week they took the spices which they had prepared, and came to the tomb.

title: Luke 24:2
text: And they found the stone rolled away from the tomb,

title: Luke 24:3
text: and on entering they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.

title: Luke 24:4
text: While they were still perplexed over this, it happened that the two men stood near them in dazzling raiment.

title: Luke 24:5
text: They were terrified, and bowed down their faces to the ground, but the men said to them: "Why are you seeking him who lives among the dead?

title: Luke 24:6
text: "He is not here; he is risen. Do you remember how he told you when he was still in Galilee

title: Luke 24:7
text: that the Son of man had to be betrayed into the hands of sinful men, and to be crucified, and to rise on the third day?"

title: Luke 24:8
text: Then they recollected his words,

title: Luke 24:9
text: and turning away from the tomb they told all this to the eleven, and to all the rest.

title: Luke 24:10
text: It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary, the mother of James, and the rest of the women who were telling all this to the apostles.

title: Luke 24:11
text: But the whole story seemed to them but an idle tale; and they disbelieved the women.

title: Luke 24:12
text: Peter, however, got up and ran to the tomb, but when he stooped and looked in he saw the linen wrappings by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering at that which was come to pass.

title: Luke 24:13
text: On that same day two of his disciples were walking to Emmaus, a village about seven miles from Jerusalem.

title: Luke 24:14
text: They were talking together about all these events,

title: Luke 24:15
text: and as they talked and discussed matter, Jesus himself drew near and began walking beside them.

title: Luke 24:16
text: But their eyes continued to be held that they should not recognize him even for an instant,

title: Luke 24:17
text: And he said to them, "What words are these that you are exchanging one with another, as you walk along ?"

title: Luke 24:18
text: They stood still, looking sad. And one of them named Cleopas, answered him, "Do you sojourn alone in Jerusalem, that you do not know what things have been happening there these days?"

title: Luke 24:19
text: "What kind of things?" he answered. And they said: "The things concerning Jesus of Nazareth, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;

title: Luke 24:20
text: "and how our high priest and ruler delivered him to be condemned to death and crucified him.

title: Luke 24:21
text: "But we were hoping that it was he who should redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this is the third day since these things happened.

title: Luke 24:22
text: "Moreover, some women of our company amazed us. They went to his tomb at daybreak,

title: Luke 24:23
text: "and found that his body was not there; then they came and told us that besides they had seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.

title: Luke 24:24
text: "Thereupon some of our own party to the tomb, and found it even so as the women had said, but him they did not see."

title: Luke 24:25
text: "O foolish men," said Jesus, "slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken!

title: Luke 24:26
text: "Behooved it not the Christ to suffer thus, and then to enter into his glory?"

title: Luke 24:27
text: And beginning with Moses and the Prophets, he interpreted all the passages concerning himself.

title: Luke 24:28
text: When they drew near to the village to which they are were going, he appeared to be going farther.

title: Luke 24:29
text: But they urged him to stay with them, saying, "Abide with us, for it is toward evening, and the day is now far spent."

title: Luke 24:30
text: So he went in to stay with them. But as he sat down with them, and took bread, and had blessed and broken it, and was handing it to them,

title: Luke 24:31
text: their eyes were opened, and they recognized him, and he vanished out of their sight.

title: Luke 24:32
