text: Now just before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his hour was come when he should leave this world to go to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, showed forth his love to the end.

title: John 13:2
text: So while supper was proceeding, and the devil had already put it into the heart of Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon, to betray him,

title: John 13:3
text: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given everything into his hands, and that he was come from God,

title: John 13:4
text: and was now going to God, rose from supper, laid aside his upper garments, and took a towel and girded himself.

title: John 13:5
text: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the feet of his disciples and to wipe them with the towel with which he had girded himself.

title: John 13:6
text: Then he came to Simon Peter, who said to him, "Lord, are you going to wash my feet?"

title: John 13:7
text: Jesus answered him, "What I am doing you do not understand now, but you will understand it later."

title: John 13:8
text: Peter answered, "No, never shall you wash my feet." "If I do not wash you," said Jesus, "you have no part in me."

title: John 13:9
text: "Lord," said Simon Peter, "not my feet only, but also my hands and my head."

title: John 13:10
text: Jesus said: "He who has bathed needs only to have his feet washed, and he is altogether clean; and you are clean, but not all of you."

title: John 13:11
text: (For he knew who should betray him, for that reason he said that they were not every one of them clean.)

title: John 13:12
text: So after he had washed their feet, and had put on his upper garments again, and taken his place, he said to them:

title: John 13:13
text: "Do you understand what I have been doing to you? You call me `Teacher' and `Master', and you say well, for such I am.

title: John 13:14
text: If then I have washed your feet, I the `Master' and the `Teacher', you also ought to wash one another's feet,

title: John 13:15
text: for I have given you an example, that you also should do what I have done to you.

title: John 13:16
text: In solemn truth I tell you that a slave is not greater than his master, neither is a messenger greater than the one who sends him.

title: John 13:17
text: If you know these things, happy are you if you do them.

title: John 13:18
text: I do not speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen, but it is that the Scripture may be fulfilled, which says: "He who eats my bread has lifted up his heel against me.

title: John 13:19
text: "From this time forward, I tell you before it comes to pass, that when it is come to pass you may believe who I am.

title: John 13:20
text: In solemn truth I tell you, he who receives any one that I send is receiving me; and he who receives me is receiving Him who sent me."

title: John 13:21
text: When he had spoken thus, Jesus was deeply moved. He testified and said, "In solemn truth I tell you that one of you will betray me."

title: John 13:22
text: Then the disciples began looking at one another, wondering which one of them he meant.

title: John 13:23
text: There was reclining upon Jesus' breast one of the disciples whom he loved.

title: John 13:24
text: So Simon Peter beckoned to him, saying, "Ask who it is about whom he is speaking."

title: John 13:25
text: So that disciples just leaned back against Jesus' breast and said to him, "Lord, who is it?"

title: John 13:26
text: "It is that one," answered Jesus," to whom I am going to give a piece of bread, after dipping it."

title: John 13:27
text: So when he had dipped the bread, he took it and gave it to Judas Iscariot, son of Simon. And after he had received the piece of bread, Satan entered into him. "What you do, do quickly," said Jesus.

title: John 13:28
text: Now no one at the table understood why he said this to him,

title: John 13:29
text: for some were thinking, as Judas kept the purse, that Jesus meant to tell him, "Buy the things that we need for the feast," or that he should give something to the poor.

title: John 13:30
text: When he had taken the piece of bread, Judas went out immediately; and it was night.

title: John 13:31
text: So when he was gone, Jesus said: "Now has the Son of man been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

title: John 13:32
text: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and straightway will he glorify him.

title: John 13:33
text: "My little children, I am only to be with you a little longer. You will seek me; just as I said to the Jews, `Where I go you cannot come,' so now I say to you.

title: John 13:34
text: I give you a new commandment, Love one another!

title: John 13:35
text: By this shall all men know that you are my disciples, if you have love one for another."

title: John 13:36
text: Simon Peter asked him, "Lord, where are you going?" "Where I am going," answered Jesus, "you cannot follow me now; but you shall follow me later."

title: John 13:37
text: "Why cannot I follow you now, Master?" said Peter. "I will lay down my life for you." Jesus answered him:

title: John 13:38
text: "Your life you will lay down for me? In solemn truth I tell you, the cock shall not crow before you have three times disowned me."

title: John 14:1
text: "Let not your hearts be troubled. You trust in God, trust in me also.

title: John 14:2
text: In my Father's house there are many rooms If it were not so, would I have told you that I went to prepare a place for you?

title: John 14:3
text: I will return and will take you to be with me, so that where I am you may be also.

title: John 14:4
text: And the way is known to you all, where I am going."

title: John 14:5
text: "We do not know where you are going Lord," said Thomas, "so how can we know the way?"

title: John 14:6
text: Jesus answered him: "I am the Way, the Truth and the Life. No man ever comes to the Father but by me.

title: John 14:7
text: If you had known me, you would have known my Father too; from now on you know him and have seen him."

title: John 14:8
text: "Lord," said Philip, "cause us to see the Father, and we shall be satisfied."

title: John 14:9
text: "Have I been so long among you, and yet you, Philip, have you not recognized me? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How can you say, `Cause us to see the Father'?

title: John 14:10
text: "Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father in me? The words that I speak to you I speak not of myself; but the Father, who ever dwells in me, is doing his own work.

title: John 14:11
text: "Believe me, all of you, that I am in the Father and the Father in me, or else believe me for the very words' sake.

title: John 14:12
text: "I tell you solemnly that he who trusts in me shall himself do the works that I am doing; and still greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.

title: John 14:13
text: "And whatever' you ask in my name I will do; that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

title: John 14:14
text: "If you ask anything in my name, I will do it.

title: John 14:15
text: "If you love me, you will obey my commandments,

title: John 14:16
text: "and I will pray the Father,

title: John 14:17
text: "and he will give you another Comforter to be with you forever, the Spirit of Truth. The world cannot receive him because it does not see him nor know him, but you know him, for he is ever with you and within you.

title: John 14:18
text: "I will not leave you comfortless; I will come to you.

title: John 14:19
text: "Yet a little while and the world shall see me no more, but you shall see me; because I live, you, too, shall live.

title: John 14:20
text: "At that day you shall understand that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

title: John 14:21
text: "It is he who has my commands and obeys them that loves me; and he who loves me shall be loved by my Father, and I will love him and will manifest myself to him."

title: John 14:22
text: "How is it, Lord," said Judas (not Iscariot) "that you will manifest yourself to us and not to the world?"

title: John 14:23
text: Jesus replied : "If any loves me he will obey my word, and my Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.

title: John 14:24
text: "He that loves me not does not obey words, and yet the words to which you are listening are not mine, but the Father's who sent me.

title: John 14:25
text: "All this I told you while still with you.

title: John 14:26
text: "But the Comforter, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you everything, and bring to your remembrance everything that I have told you.

title: John 14:27
text: "Peace I leave with you. My own peace I give to you. It is not the world's `Peace' I give you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

title: John 14:28
text: "You heard me tell you, `I am going away, and yet I am coming to you.' If you loved me you would have been glad because I said `I am going to the Father,' for my Father is greater than I.

title: John 14:29
text: "And now I tell you this before it happens, so that when it does happen you may believe.

title: John 14:30
text: "I shall not talk with you much more, for the Prince of this world is coming.

title: John 14:31
text: "He has nothing in me, but in his coming the world may know that I love the Father, and that I do just as the Father commanded. Rise, let us be going!"

title: John 15:1
text: "I am the vine, and my Father the vine-grower.

title: John 15:2
text: "He cuts back any of my branches that bear no fruit, and prunes every fruit-bearing branch, that it may bear more.

title: John 15:3
text: "Now you are clean through the word which I have spoken to you.

title: John 15:4
text: "Abide in me, and I in you. Just as the branch cannot bear fruit of itself except it abide in the vine, no more can you, unless you abide in me.

title: John 15:5
text: "I am the Vine you are the branches. He who abides in me and I in him, bears abundant fruit; because apart from me you can do nothing.

title: John 15:6
text: "If any one does not abide in me he is thrown away like a branch and withers. Such branches are gathered up and thrown into the fire and burned.

title: John 15:7
text: "If you abide in me and my words abide in you, ask whatever your will is, and it shall be yours.

title: John 15:8
text: "By this is my Father glorified, by your bearing abundant fruit, and so being my disciples.

title: John 15:9
text: "As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you; abide in my love.

title: John 15:10
text: "If you obey my commands you will abide in my love, just as I have obeyed my Father's commands and abide in his love.

title: John 15:11
text: "I have told you these things that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.

title: John 15:12
text: "This is my command, Love one another as I have loved you.

title: John 15:13
text: "Greater love has no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

title: John 15:14
text: "You are my friends if you do what I command you.

title: John 15:15
text: "I no longer call you slaves, because a slave does not know what his master is doing; but I have called you friends, because I have made known to you everything that I have learned from my Father.

title: John 15:16
text: "You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; so that whatever you ask the Father in my name, he may give it to you.

title: John 15:17
text: "This is my command: to love one another. If the worlds hates you,

title: John 15:18
text: "do not forget that it hated me first.

title: John 15:19
text: "If you belonged to the world, the world would love its own; but because you do not belong to the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, for that reason the world hates you.

title: John 15:20
text: "Remember what I told you, `A slave is not better than his master.' If they persecuted me, they will persecute you. If they have obeyed my word, they will obey yours also.

title: John 15:21
text: "But they will do all these things to you for my name's sake, because they know not Him who sent me.

title: John 15:22
text: "If I had not come and spoken to them, they would have no sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

title: John 15:23
text: "He who hates me hates my Father also.

title: John 15:24
text: "If I had not done among them such works as none ever did, they would have had no sin; but now they have both seen and hated both me and my Father.

title: John 15:25
text: "And so is fulfilled the word written in their Law, `They hate me without cause.'

title: John 15:26
text: "When the Comforter is come whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of Truth who comes forth from the Father, he will bear witness of me;

title: John 15:27
text: "and you to shall bear witness because you have been with me from the first.

title: John 16:1
text: "I have told you all this so that you may not stumble.

title: John 16:2
text: "They will excommunicate you from their synagogues; indeed the time is coming when any one who kills you will suppose that he is doing God's service.

title: John 16:3
text: "And they will do these things because they have not known my Father, nor me.

title: John 16:4
text: "But I have told you these things, that when the time comes you may remember that I told you about them, myself. I did not, however, speak of these things at first, because I was with you.

title: John 16:5
text: "But now I go my way to Him who sent me, yet none of you asks me, `Where are you going?'

title: John 16:6
text: "but sorrow has filled your hearts because I have told you these things.

title: John 16:7
text: "Yet--I am telling you the truth--my going is for your good. For unless I go away the Comforter will not come to you; but if I depart I will send him unto you.

title: John 16:8
text: "And he, when he comes, will convict the world of sins and of righteousness and of judgment;

title: John 16:9
text: "of sin, because they do not believe in me;

title: John 16:10
text: "of righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you will no longer see me;

title: John 16:11
text: "because the Prince of this world has been judged.

title: John 16:12
text: "I have yet many things to say to you, but you cannot bear them just now.

title: John 16:13
text: "But when he is come, that Spirit of Truth, he will guide you into the whole truth. For he will not speak on his own authority, but all that he hears he will speak, and will make known to you that which is to come.

title: John 16:14
text: "He will glorify me; for he will take of what is mine and will make known to you.

title: John 16:15
text: "Everything that the Father has is mine; that is why I said that he will take of what is mine and make it known to you.

title: John 16:16
text: "In a little while you shall behold me no more; and again in a little while you shall see me, because I am going to the Father."

title: John 16:17
text: At this some of his disciples said among themselves: "What does he mean by telling us, `In a little while you shall behold me no more; and again in a little while you shall see me,' and `because I am going to the Father'?"

title: John 16:18
text: So they kept asking: "What does that `little while' mean of which he speaks? We do not know what he is talking about."

title: John 16:19
text: Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and said: "Are you questioning one another about my saying, `A little while and you shall behold me no more, and again a little while you shall see me'?

title: John 16:20
text: "I tell you solemnly that you will be weeping and wailing while the world is rejoicing; you will be grief-stricken, but your grief shall be turned into gladness.

title: John 16:21
text: "A woman in labor has grief because her hour is come; but when she has given birth to the babe she no longer remembers her anguish, because of joy that a child has been born into the world.

title: John 16:22
text: "So you also have sorrow now, but I will see you again and your heart will rejoice, and your joy shall no man snatch away from you.

title: John 16:23
text: "And in that day you will ask me no questions. Most solemnly I tell you that whatever you ask the Father in my name, he will give you.

title: John 16:24
text: "Hitherto you have asked nothing in my name; ask, and you shall receive, that your joy may be full.

title: John 16:25
text: "I have told you these things in figures; but the time is coming when I shall no longer speak in figures, but will tell you about the Father in plain words.

title: John 16:26
text: "In that day you shall pray in my name; and I do not tell you that I will ask the Father on your behalf;

title: John 16:27
text: "for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me and believed that I came forth from the God.

title: John 16:28
text: "I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I am leaving the world, and am going to the Father."

title: John 16:29
text: "Ah," said the disciples, "now you are speaking plain language, and not using figures.

title: John 16:30
text: Now we are sure that you know all things, and have no need for any one to question you; by this we believe that you came forth from God."

title: John 16:31
text: "Do you now believe?" said Jesus;

title: John 16:32
text: "behold the hour approaches and is already come when you will be scattered, each man to his home, and will leave me alone; and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

title: John 16:33
text: "I have said all this to you that in me you might have peace. In the world you will have tribulation, but be courageous; I have overcome the world."

title: John 17:1
text: When he had thus spoken, Jesus raised his eyes to heaven and said: "Father, the hour is come. Glorify the Son, that thy Son may glorify thee;

title: John 17:2
text: "since thou hast given him authority over all mankind, to give eternal life to all whom thou hast given him.

title: John 17:3
text: "And this is eternal life, to know thee, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom thou hast sent.

title: John 17:4
text: "I have glorified thee on the earth; I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.

title: John 17:5
text: "And now, O Father, glorify thou me with own self, with the glory I had with thee before the world began.

title: John 17:6
text: "I have made known thy name to the men whom thou gavest me out of the world. Thine they were, and thou gavest them to me, and they have kept thy word.

title: John 17:7
text: "They know now that whatever thou hast given me was from thee;

title: John 17:8
text: "for I have given them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and they have believed that thou didst send me.

title: John 17:9
text: "I am praying for them; I am not praying for the world, but for those whom thou hast given me; for they are thine,

title: John 17:10
text: "and all thine are mine, and mine are thine; and I am glorified in them.

title: John 17:11
text: "I am no longer in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own Name these whom thou hast given me, that they may be one as we are one.

title: John 17:12
text: "While I was with them I kept them by the power of thy name which thou hast given me. I guarded them, and none of them was lost except the son of perdition, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

title: John 17:13
text: "But now I am coming to thee, and I am speaking these things while I am in the world, so that they may have my joy in all its fulness in themselves.

title: John 17:14
text: "I have given them thy word; and the world has hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

title: John 17:15
text: "I am not asking that thou wilt take them out of the world, but that thou wilt protect them from the Evil One.

title: John 17:16
text: "They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

title: John 17:17
text: "Dedicate them in thy truth; thy word is truth.

title: John 17:18
text: "As thou hast sent me into the world, even so I also have sent them into the world.

title: John 17:19
text: "And for their sakes I dedicate myself, that they also may be thoroughly dedicated in the truth.

title: John 17:20
text: "Nor do I pray for them alone, but for those also who believe in me through their word,

title: John 17:21
text: "that they may all be one, even as thou, Father, art in me and I in thee; that they also may be in us; in order that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.

title: John 17:22
text: "And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one even as we are one,

title: John 17:23
text: "I in them and thou in me; that they may be made perfectly one, so that the world may recognize that thou didst send me, and hast loved them as thou hast loved me.

title: John 17:24
text: "Father, it is my will that wherever I am these also, thy gift to me, may be with me, that they may see the glory, my glory which thou hast given me, because thou didst love me before the foundations of the world.

title: John 17:25
text: "O righteous Father, though the world knew thee not, I have known thee, and these have known that though didst send me.

title: John 17:26
text: "And I have declared--and will declare--thy name unto them, that the love with which thou hast loved me may be in them, and that I may be in them."

title: John 18:1
text: After he had spoken these words Jesus went forth with his disciples to a place across the Ravine of the Cedars, where there was a garden into which he and his disciples went.

title: John 18:2
text: Judas the Traitor also knew this place; for Jesus and his disciples often met there.

title: John 18:3
text: So after getting troops and some Temple police from the chief priests and Pharisees, Judas came there with lanterns and torches and weapons.

title: John 18:4
text: Then Jesus, knowing all that was coming upon him, went forth to meet them, and asked them, "Who is it that you are looking for?"

title: John 18:5
text: "For Jesus of Nazareth," they answered. He said to them, "I am he." (Now Judas also, the betrayer, was standing with them.)

title: John 18:6
text: When Jesus said "I am he," they drew back and fell to the ground;

title: John 18:7
text: so he asked them once more, "Whom are you looking for?" and they replied, "Jesus of Nazareth."

title: John 18:8
text: "I have already told you that I am he," said Jesus. "If, then, you are looking for me, let these go their way."

title: John 18:9
text: "(In order that the word which he had spoken might be fulfilled, "Of those whom thou hast given me I have not lost one.")

title: John 18:10
text: Then Simon Peter, who had a sword, drew it, and striking at the high priest's slave, cut off his right ear.

title: John 18:11
text: (The slave's name was Malchus.) Then Jesus said to Peter: "Put up your sword in its sheath. the cup which my Father has given me, shall I not drink it?"

title: John 18:12
text: So the troops and their commandant and the Jewish police took Jesus, and bound him,

title: John 18:13
text: and led him to Annas first. (For Annas was the Father-in-law of Caiaphas, who was the high priest that year--

title: John 18:14
text: the Caiaphas who had advised the Jews that it was for their advantage that one man should die for the people.)

title: John 18:15
text: Meanwhile Simon Peter was following Jesus, and so was another disciple who was known to the high priest, and they went in with Jesus into the court of the high priest's palace.

title: John 18:16
text: But Peter took his stand outside, near the door. So the other disciple who was known to the high priest came out and spoke to the doorkeeper and brought Peter in.

title: John 18:17
text: The doorkeeper (a maid servant) then said to Peter, "Are not you also one of this man's disciples?" "No I am not," he answered.

title: John 18:18
text: Now the slaves and the attendants were standing and warming themselves about a charcoal fire, which they had made because it was cold; and Peter also stood with them, and was warming himself.

title: John 18:19
text: Then the high priest questioned Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.

title: John 18:20
text: Jesus answered him: "I have spoken to all the world openly. I always taught in a synagogue and in the temple, places where all the Jews are wont to assemble, and in secret I have spoken nothing.

title: John 18:21
text: "Why do you question me? Ask those who heard what I have said to them; these witnesses here know what I said."

title: John 18:22
text: When he had spoken these words, one of the police standing by gave him a blow with his hand, saying as he did so, "Is that the way you answer the high priest?"

title: John 18:23
text: Jesus replied "If I have said anything wrong, give evidence concerning the wrong; but if I said what was true, why do you strike me?"

title: John 18:24
text: Then Annas sent him in chains to Caiaphas, the high priest.

title: John 18:25
text: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, "You are not also one of his disciples, are you not?" He denied it, saying "I am not."

title: John 18:26
text: One of the slaves of the high priest, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, said, "Did not I myself see you with him in the garden."

title: John 18:27
text: Peter again denied it; and at that very moment a cock crew.

title: John 18:28
text: From the house of Caiaphas they took Jesus to the Praetorium, and it was dawn. They themselves would not enter the Praetorium, in order that they might not be ceremonially defiled, but might be able to eat the Passover.

title: John 18:29
text: So Pilate came outside to them and asked, "What charge do you bring against this man?"

title: John 18:30
text: In reply they said, "If he had not been a criminal, we should not have handed him over you."

title: John 18:31
text: "Take him yourselves," answered Pilate, "and judge him according to your law."

title: John 18:32
text: The Jews answered him, "We are not allowed to put anyone to death" (that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled in which he predicted the kind of death he was to die).

title: John 18:33
text: So Pilate went into the Praetorium again, and summoned Jesus. "Are you the King of the Jews?" he said.

title: John 18:34
text: Jesus answered, "Are you saying this of your own accord, or did others say it to you about me?"

title: John 18:35
text: "I am not a Jew, am I?" replied Pilate; "It is your own nation and the high priests who have handed you over to me. What have you done?"

title: John 18:36
text: Jesus answered him: "My kingdom is not of this world. If my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants have fought hard that I should not be handed the Jews; but in reality my kingdom is not of such origins."

title: John 18:37
text: "You are a king, then? You!" said Pilate. "You say truly that I am a king." answered Jesus, "for this purpose I was born, and to this end came I into the world, that I should bear witness to the truth. Every man who is of the truth listens to my voice."

title: John 18:38
text: Pilate said to him, "What is truth?" As he said this, he went outside again to the Jews and said to them:

title: John 18:39
text: "I find no crime in this man. Now it is a custom of yours that I release one prisoner to you at the time of the Passover feast. Do you wish me to release to you the King of the Jews?"

title: John 18:40
text: Then they all shouted again: "No, not him! Barabbas!" Now Barabbas was a robber.

title: John 19:1
text: After that Pilate took Jesus and had him scourged;

title: John 19:2
text: and the soldiers plaited a crown of thorns, placed it on his head, and threw a purple cloak about him, and kept marching up to him,

title: John 19:3
text: saying, "Hail! King of the Jews!" They also gave him blow after blow with their hands.

title: John 19:4
text: Pilate again came forth and said to the people, "See, I am going to bring his out to you, that you may clearly know that I find no crime in him,"

title: John 19:5
text: Then as Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, "BEHOLD, THE MAN!"

title: John 19:6
text: So when the chief priests and the police saw him, they shouted: "Crucify him! Crucify him!" "Take him yourselves and crucify him," said Pilate, " for I find no crime in him."

title: John 19:7
text: The Jews answered him, "We have a law, and by that law he ought to die, because he made himself out to be God's Son,"

title: John 19:8
text: Now when Pilate heard these words he was more alarmed than ever,

title: John 19:9
text: and entering the Praetorium again, he said to Jesus, "What is your origin?"

title: John 19:10
text: Jesus made no answer. So Pilate said to him: "Do you not speak to me? Do you not know that I have power to release you, or power to crucify you?"

title: John 19:11
text: "You would have no power over me," answered Jesus, "unless it had been given you from above. For this reason he who has betrayed me to you has the greater sin."

title: John 19:12
text: After that Pilate began to seek to release him, but the Jews shouted out: "If you release this man you are no friend of the Emperor. Any man who makes himself out to be king is a rebel against the Emperor."

title: John 19:13
text: On hearing what they said, Pilate brought Jesus out and made him sit on the judge's seat in a place called the Mosaic Pavement (the Hebrew name is Gabbatha).

title: John 19:14
text: And it was the day of Preparation for the Passover, about six o'clock in the morning. Then he said to the Jews, "Behold your King!"

title: John 19:15
text: Then they shouted: "Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!" "Crucify your King?" said Pilate. The chief priests answered, "We have no king but Caesar!"

title: John 19:16
text: So then he gave him over to them to be crucified.

title: John 19:17
text: So they took Jesus, who went forth bearing his own cross, to a place called The Place of a Skull--in the Hebrew tongue, Golgotha.

title: John 19:18
text: There they crucified him; and with him two others, one on either side, and Jesus between them.

title: John 19:19
text: And Pilate moreover wrote an inscription and placed it above the cross. What he wrote was, "JESUS, THE NAZARENE, KING OF THE JEWS"

title: John 19:20
text: This inscription was read by many of the Jews, because the place where they crucified Jesus was near the city, and the inscription was written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek.

title: John 19:21
text: So the high priests of the Jews said to Pilate, "Do not write `King of the Jews,' but `He said, I am King of the Jews.'"

title: John 19:22
text: Pilate answered, "What I have written, I have written!"

title: John 19:23
text: After the soldiers had crucified Jesus, they took his garments and divided them into four parts, to each soldier a part, and the tunic. Now the tunic was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom;

title: John 19:24
text: so the soldiers said one to another: "Let us not tear it. Let us draw lots, to see whose it shall be"--that the Scripture might be fulfilled: They divided my garments among them, For my raiment did they cast lots. This was what the soldiers did.

title: John 19:25
text: Now there stood near the cross of Jesus, his mother and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

title: John 19:26
text: When Jesus saw his mother, and standing near her the disciple whom he loved, he said to his mother, "Woman behold your son."

title: John 19:27
text: Then he said to the disciple, "Behold your mother." And from that hour the disciple took her to his home.

title: John 19:28
text: After that, when Jesus knew that everything was now accomplished, he said in fulfilment of the words of Scripture, "I am thirsty."

title: John 19:29
text: There was a jar full of vinegar standing there; and they filled a sponge with vinegar, and put it upon a stalk of hyssop, and put it to his lips.

title: John 19:30
text: Then after he had taken the vinegar, Jesus said, "IT IS FINISHED!" And bowing his head, he yielded up his spirit.

title: John 19:31
text: It was Preparation Day, so in order to prevent the bodies' hanging on the cross during the Sabbath (for the Sabbath was a great day) the Jews begged Pilate to have the legs broken, and the bodies taken away.

title: John 19:32
text: So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first man and of the other who had been crucified with him.

title: John 19:33
text: But upon coming to Jesus they saw that he was already dead, and did not break his legs.

title: John 19:34
text: One of the soldiers, however, pierced his side with a lance, and immediately blood and water flowed out.

title: John 19:35
text: And he who saw it has borne testimony, and his testimony is trustworthy, and he knows that he is telling the truth in order that you may believe.

title: John 19:36
text: For this happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, Not one of his bones shall be broken.

title: John 19:37
text: And again another Scripture says, They shall look on him whom they have pierced.

title: John 19:38
text: After these things Joseph of Arimathea, who was a disciple of Jesus, but in secret because of fear of the Jews, asked Pilate for permission to take the body of Jesus, and Pilate gave him leave. So he came and took the body.

title: John 19:39
text: Nicodemus also (the one who visited Jesus by night, at first) came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, weighing nearly a hundred pounds.

title: John 19:40
text: So they took the body of Jesus and wound it in linen with the spices, according to the Jewish mode of burial.

title: John 19:41
text: There was a garden near the place where Jesus had been crucified, and in the garden a new tomb in which no one had ever been laid.

title: John 19:42
text: Here, because of its being Preparation Day, and as the tomb was near by, they placed Jesus.

title: John 20:1
text: On the first day of the week, very early in the morning, while it was yet dark, Mary Magdalene came to the tomb and discovered that the stone had been removed from the tomb.

title: John 20:2
text: So she came running to Simon Peter and that other disciple whom Jesus loved, saying, "They have taken the Master out of the tomb, and we do not know where they have laid him!"

title: John 20:3
text: So Peter and the other disciples set out at once to go to the tomb.

title: John 20:4
text: They both began to run; and the other disciple ran faster than Peter, and came first to the tomb.

title: John 20:5
text: Stooping down he glanced in and saw the linen wrapping lying on the ground; but he did not go in.

title: John 20:6
text: Then Peter also came following him, and he went inside the tomb; and he gazed at the linen wrapping as they lay,

title: John 20:7
text: and the napkin which had been about his head not lying with the wrappings, but rolled up in it's own place.

title: John 20:8
text: Then the other disciple also who arrived first at the tomb went inside, and he perceived and believed.

title: John 20:9
text: For not yet had they understood the Scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.

title: John 20:10
text: Then the disciples went back again to their home.

title: John 20:11
text: Meanwhile, outside, Mary stood sobbing near the tomb. Still sobbing she stooped and looked into the tomb,

title: John 20:12
text: and gazed at two angels in glistening white sitting, one at the head the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

title: John 20:13
text: They said to her, "Woman, why are you weeping?" She answered, "Because they have taken away my Master, and I do not know where they have laid him."

title: John 20:14
text: When she had said this she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, but did not know that it was Jesus.

title: John 20:15
text: Jesus said to her: "Woman, why are you weeping? Whom are you seeking?' She, supposing that he was the gardener, said to him, "Sir, if you have borne him away, tell me where you have put him, and I will take him away, myself."

title: John 20:16
text: "Mary," said Jesus. She turned to him. "Rabboni!" she cried in Hebrew. That is to say, "Teacher."

title: John 20:17
text: "Do not cling to me," said Jesus, "for I am not yet ascended to the Father. But go to my brothers and say to them, "`I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.'"

title: John 20:18
text: Away went Mary Magdalene to the disciples with the tidings, "I have seen the Master!" and that he said these things to her.

title: John 20:19
text: On the evening of that same day, the first day of the week, although the doors of the room where the disciples gathered had been locked for fear of the Jews, Jesus came, and there he stood among them, saying. "Peace to you!"

title: John 20:20
text: As he said this he showed them his hands and his side. Then were the disciple glad, when they saw the Lord.

title: John 20:21
text: Then Jesus said to them again: "Peace to you. As my Father has sent me forth, I also now am sending you."

title: John 20:22
text: When he had said this he breathed upon them and said:

title: John 20:23
text: "Receive the Holy Spirit. If you remit any one's sins, they are remitted; if you retain them they are retained."

title: John 20:24
text: But Thomas, one of the Twelve, who was called "The Twin." was not with them when Jesus came.

title: John 20:25
text: Accordingly the other disciples kept telling him, "We have seen the Lord." But he told them, "Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, and thrust my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe it."

title: John 20:26
text: A week later his disciples were again in the house, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, although the doors were locked, and stood there among and said: "Peace to you!"

title: John 20:27
text: Then to Thomas he said: "Place your finger here, and see my hands; and place your hand here, and thrust it into my side, and become not unbelieving, but believing."

title: John 20:28
text: Thomas answered him, "My Lord and my God!"

title: John 20:29
text: "Because you have seen me, Thomas, you have believed," Jesus told him. "Blessed are those who, without seeing, yet believed."

title: John 20:30
text: There were then many other signs which Jesus performed in the presence of his disciples, which have not been written in this book;

title: John 20:31
text: but these have been written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in his name.

title: John 21:1
text: After this Jesus showed himself again to his disciples by the Sea of Tiberias. He showed himself as follows:

title: John 21:2
text: There were together Simon Peter and Thomas, called "The Twin," and Nathanael, from Cana of Galilee, and the two sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples.

title: John 21:3
text: Simon Peter said to them, "I am going fishing." They answered him, "And we are going with you." So they went out and got into the boat, and throughout the night they caught nothing.

title: John 21:4
text: But when day was dawning Jesus stood on the beach. The disciples, however, did not recognize that it was Jesus.

title: John 21:5
text: So Jesus said to them, "Lads, you haven't any fish, have you?" They answered him, "No."

title: John 21:6
text: And he said to them, "Cast your net on the right side of the boat, and you will find." So they cast it, and now they could not haul it in for the multitude of fishes.

title: John 21:7
text: Then that disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, "It is the Lord!" On hearing that it was the Lord, Simon Peter girt his fisher's coat about him (for he was naked), and threw himself into the water.

title: John 21:8
text: The rest of the disciples came in the boat, for they were not far from shore--only about a hundred yards--dragging in the net full of fish.

title: John 21:9
text: When they got to the shore they beheld a charcoal fire ready laid, with fish on it, and some bread.

title: John 21:10
text: "Bring some of the fish you have just caught," Jesus told them.

title: John 21:11
text: So Simon Peter went and dragged the net to shore, full of large fish, a hundred and fifty-three of them; but for all this number the net was not torn.

title: John 21:12
text: "Come and have breakfast," said Jesus to them. Not one of the disciples dared ask him, "Who are you?" Knowing that it was the Lord.

title: John 21:13
text: Jesus went and took bread and gave it to them, and the fish also.

title: John 21:14
text: This was the third time that Jesus showed himself to the disciples after he had risen from among the dead.

title: John 21:15
text: When they were through breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, "Simon, son of John, do you love me more than these others do?" "Yes, Lord, you know that you are dear to me." he answered. Jesus said to him, "Feed my lambs."

title: John 21:16
text: He said to him a second time, "Simon, son of John, do you love me?" He answered, "Yes, Lord, you know that you are dear to me." "Be a shepherd to my sheep," said Jesus.

title: John 21:17
text: The third time Jesus asked him, "Am I really dear to you?" Peter was grieved because the third time he asked, "Am I really dear to you?" and he answered, "Master, you know all things, you know that you are dear to me."

title: John 21:18
text: "Feed my sheep," said Jesus. "In solemn truth I tell you that when you were young, you used to put on your own girdle, and walk wherever you wished; but when you grow old you will stretch out your hands for some one to gird you, and carry you where you do not wish to go."

title: John 21:19
text: This he said to show by what kind of death Peter was to glorify God. After speaking thus, he said to him, "Follow me."

title: John 21:20
text: Peter turned around and saw that the disciple whom Jesus loved was following--he who at the supper leaned back upon his breast and said, "Lord, who is to betray you?"

title: John 21:21
text: On catching sight of him, Peter said to Jesus, "Lord, what about him?"

title: John 21:22
text: "If I choose that he remain until I come," said Jesus, "what is that to you? Do you follow me."

title: John 21:23
text: Accordingly the report spread among the brothers that this disciple should not die; but Jesus did not say that he was not to die, but said, "If I choose that he remain until I come, what is that to you?"

title: John 21:24
text: It is this disciple who bears testimony to these facts and who recorded them; and we know that his testimony is true.

title: John 21:25
text: But there are also many other things which Jesus did; if every one of them were to be recorded in detail I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that would have to be written.

title: Acts 1:1
text: My first account, O Theophilus, dealt with all that Jesus began doing and teaching from the beginning down to the day when,

title: Acts 1:2
text: after giving instructions through the Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen, he was taken up to heaven.

title: Acts 1:3
text: After his sufferings he had also shown himself alive to them in many convincing manifestations, revealing himself to them during forty days, and speaking of the kingdom of God.

title: Acts 1:4
text: And once when he was eating with them he charged them not to depart from Jerusalem, but to wait for the promise of the Father. "Of this," he said, "you have heard from me.

title: Acts 1:5
text: "For John indeed baptized in water, but you shall be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days hence."

title: Acts 1:6
text: So, when they came together, they began to ask him, "Master, are you at this time about to restore the kingdom of Israel?"

title: Acts 1:7
text: He answered: "It is not for you to know times and occasions which the Father has fixed in his own authority;

title: Acts 1:8
text: "yet you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you are to be my witnesses both in Jerusalem and in all Judea, and in Samaria, and to the very ends of the earth."

title: Acts 1:9
text: When he had said this, and while they were looking at him, he was lifted up, and a cloud received him up out of their sight.

title: Acts 1:10
text: While they were gazing into the sky as he was going up, suddenly there were two men in white garments standing by them,

title: Acts 1:11
text: and they said: "Men of Galilee, why do you stand gazing into the sky? This same Jesus who has been taken up from you into the sky will come back in just the same way as you have seen him going into the sky."

title: Acts 1:12
text: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, about a Sabbath Day's journey distant.

title: Acts 1:13
text: On entering the city they went to the upper room where they were accustomed to meet. They were Peter and John and James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James, son of Alphaeus, and Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.

title: Acts 1:14
text: These all with one mind gave their constant attention to prayer, together with some women, and with Mary the mother of Jesus, and his brothers.

title: Acts 1:15
text: It was during these days that Peter stood up among the brothers--the whole number of persons present was about one hundred and twenty--and said:

title: Acts 1:16
text: "Men and brothers, it was necessary for the Scripture to be fulfilled which the Holy Spirit uttered beforehand by the lips of David in regard to Judas who acted as guide to those who arrested Jesus.

title: Acts 1:17
text: "For he was numbered among us, and he did get his allotted share of this ministry.

title: Acts 1:18
text: "Now this man bought a plot of ground with the price of his treachery, and falling there headlong he burst asunder and all his bowels gushed out.

title: Acts 1:19
text: "This fact became known to the people of Jerusalem so that the place was called in their language, Acheldamach, The Field of Blood.

title: Acts 1:20
text: "For it is written in the Book of Psalms, Let his dwelling-place be desolate; Let no man dwell there, also, Let another take his work.

title: Acts 1:21
text: "It is necessary then that, of the men who have been associated with us during the whole time in which the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

title: Acts 1:22
text: from his baptism by John down to the day on which he was taken up from us, one should join us a witness to his resurrection."

title: Acts 1:23
text: So they placed two in nomination, Joseph called Bar-Sabbas (surnamed Justas) and Matthias;

title: Acts 1:24
text: and they prayed, saying: "Thou, O Lord, who knowest the hearts of all men, show clearly which of these two men thou hast chosen to fill the place

title: Acts 1:25
text: "in this ministry of this apostles from which Judas went out to go to his own place."

title: Acts 1:26
text: Then they cast lots for them, and the lot fell upon Matthias, and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.

title: Acts 2:1
text: When the day of Pentecost was fully come, and they were all together in the same place,

title: Acts 2:2
text: there came suddenly from the sky a sound like the onrush of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

title: Acts 2:3
text: There appeared to them tongues, like flame, distributing themselves, one resting upon the head of each one,

title: Acts 2:4
text: and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak with other tongues as the Spirit was giving them utterance.

title: Acts 2:5
text: Now there were, staying in Jerusalem. devout Jews from many and distant lands.

title: Acts 2:6
text: So when this noise was heard, the crowd gathered in bewilderment because each man heard them speaking in his own language.

title: Acts 2:7
text: The were beside themselves with wonder. "Are not these Galileans who are speaking?" they exclaimed.

title: Acts 2:8
text: "Then how is it that each one of us hears them speak his own mother tongue?

title: Acts 2:9
text: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, dwellers in Mesopotamia, in Judea, in Cappadocia, in Pontus and Asia,

title: Acts 2:10
text: in Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, and the district of Lybia around Cretans and Arabians,

title: Acts 2:11
text: we all hear these men telling in our own tongue what great things God has done."

title: Acts 2:12
text: All were astonished and bewildered and kept saying to one another, "What can this mean?"

title: Acts 2:13
text: But others were saying with jeer, "These men are full of sweet wine."

title: Acts 2:14
text: Then Peter, with the Eleven, stood up and addresses them in a loud voice: "Men of Judea and dwellers in Jerusalem, have no doubt about this matter, but listen to what I say.

title: Acts 2:15
text: "These men are not drunk, as you suppose, since it is only nine o'clock in the morning.

title: Acts 2:16
text: "No, this is what the prophet Joel predicted:

title: Acts 2:17
text: "In the last days, God says, it shall come to pass that I will pour out my Spirit upon all mankind; "Your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your young men shall see visions, your old men shall dream dreams;

title: Acts 2:18
text: upon my slaves, both men and women, in those days, will I pour out my Spirit, and they shall prophesy.

title: Acts 2:19
text: In the sky above I will show marvels, And signs in the earth beneath; Blood and fire, and vapor of smoke.

title: Acts 2:20
text: Into darkness shall the sun be turned, And into blood the moon, Ere the day of the Lord come, that great and terrible day.

title: Acts 2:21
text: And every one who calls upon the name of the Lord will be saved.

title: Acts 2:22
text: "Men of Israel, listen to these words. Jesus the Nazarene, a man accredited to you by God, through mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, as you yourselves know;

title: Acts 2:23
text: him, delivered up by the settled purpose and fore-knowledge of God, you crucified and killed at the hands of lawless men;

title: Acts 2:24
text: but God has raised him to life, having loosed the pangs of death, because it was not possible for death to hold him.

title: Acts 2:25
text: For David says of him: "I beheld the Lord always before my face; For he is at my right hand lest I be shaken.

title: Acts 2:26
text: "Therefore my heart is glad, my tongue exults, my very body also shall pitch its tent in hope:

title: Acts 2:27
text: "For thou wilt not leave my soul in Hades, Nor give up thy Holy One to see corruption.

title: Acts 2:28
text: "Thou hast made known to me the paths of life, Thou wilt fill me with gladness in thy presence.

title: Acts 2:29
text: "Men and brothers, I can speak plainly to you concerning the patriarch David, because he not only died and was buried, but his tomb is among us even to this very day.

title: Acts 2:30
text: "Because he was a prophet and knew that God had sworn to him with an oath that of the fruit of his loins he would set one on his throne,

title: Acts 2:31
text: "he, foreseeing this, spoke of the resurrection of Christ that neither was he left in Hades, nor did his flesh see corruption.

title: Acts 2:32
text: This Jesus God has raised up, of this we are all witnesses.

title: Acts 2:33
text: Since he is by the mighty hand of God exalted, and has received from his Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured forth this which you now see and hear.

title: Acts 2:34
text: For David did not ascend into heaven; but he himself said, "The Lord said to my Lord Sit thou on my right hand

title: Acts 2:35
text: "Until I make thine enemies A footstool under thy feet.

title: Acts 2:36
text: "Therefore let the whole House of Israel know assuredly that Gods has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you have crucified."

title: Acts 2:37
text: When they heard these words they were stung to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles: "Men and brothers, what shall we do?"

title: Acts 2:38
text: "Repent," answered Peter, "and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ, for the remission of your sins, and you shall receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

title: Acts 2:39
text: "For the promise belongs to you and to your children and to all who are afar off, whomever the Lord may call."

title: Acts 2:40
text: With many other words he continued to bear testimony, and kept entreating them, saying, "Save yourselves from this perverse generation."

title: Acts 2:41
text: Then those who welcomed his message were baptized, and in that day about three thousand souls were added to them;

title: Acts 2:42
text: and they stedfastly continued in the teaching of the apostles, and in the fellowship, in the breaking of the bread, and in the prayers.

title: Acts 2:43
text: And awe came upon every soul, and many wonders and signs were wrought by the apostles.

title: Acts 2:44
text: And all the believers were together, and had all things in common.

title: Acts 2:45
text: They would sell their lands and other property, and distribute the proceeds among all, just as any one from time had need.

title: Acts 2:46
text: Day after day they continued stedfastly with one accord in the Temple; and breaking bread together in their own homes, they continued to eat their food with gladness and an undivided heart,

title: Acts 2:47
text: praising God, and looked on with favor by all the people. Meanwhile the Lord kept adding to them daily those that were being saved.

title: Acts 3:1
text: One day Peter and John were going up together for the hour of prayer, at three in the afternoon,

title: Acts 3:2
text: when a man lame from his birth was carried along, who was wont to be laid each day near the gate of the Temple called the Beautiful Gate, to ask alms of those who were going into the Temple.

title: Acts 3:3
text: When he saw Peter and John about to go into the Temple, he kept asking them for alms;

title: Acts 3:4
text: Peter fixed his eyes upon him, as did John, and said, "Look at us."

title: Acts 3:5
text: So he waited, expecting to get something from them. Then Peter said:

title: Acts 3:6
text: "I have neither silver nor gold, but what I do have, this I am going to give to you; in the name of Jesus Christ, the Nazarene, walk!"

title: Acts 3:7
text: Then taking his right hand he lifted him up. Instantly his feet and ankle-bones were strengthened;

title: Acts 3:8
text: and leaping forth he stood on his feet, and began to walk, and went with them into the Temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

title: Acts 3:9
text: When all the people saw him walking and praising God,

title: Acts 3:10
text: and recognized that this was the man who used to sit and beg at the Beautiful Gate of the Temple, they were filled with awe and amazement at what had happened to him.

title: Acts 3:11
text: While he was clinging to Peter and John, all the people crowded awe-struck around them, in what was known as Solomon's Portico.

title: Acts 3:12
text: When he saw this, Peter said to the people: "Men of Israel, why are you wondering at this? Why do you stare at us, as if by our own power or piety we had made this man to walk?

title: Acts 3:13
text: "The God of Abram, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you betrayed and disowned before Pilate, when he had decided to let him go;

title: Acts 3:14
text: "but you disowned the holy and righteous One, and asked as a favor the release of a murderer.

title: Acts 3:15
text: "The Pioneer of Life you put to death. But God has raised him from the dead, and we are witnesses of that fact.

title: Acts 3:16
text: "And his name, on the ground of faith in his name, has made strong this man, whom you now see and know; yes, the faith that is through him has made this man sound and strong again, in the presence of you all.

title: Acts 3:17
text: "And now, brothers, I know that you did it in ignorance, as did also your rulers.

title: Acts 3:18
text: "But God has thus fulfilled what he foretold by the mouth of all the prophets, that his Christ should suffer.

title: Acts 3:19
text: "Repent then! and reform, from the blotting out of your sins, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord;

title: Acts 3:20
text: "and that he may send Jesus, your appointed Messiah,

title: Acts 3:21
text: "whom the heavens must receive until the time of restoration of all things. "God spoke of this ages ago, through the mouth of his holy prophets.

title: Acts 3:22
text: "Moses, for example, said: "The Lord your God will raise up a Prophet for you from among your brothers, as he raised up me; you must listen to whatever he may tell you;

title: Acts 3:23
text: "and it shall be that every soul who will not listen to that Prophet shall be utterly destroyed from among the people.

title: Acts 3:24
text: "Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and his successors, all that have spoken, have also told of those days.

title: Acts 3:25
text: "You are the sons of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with your fathers, saying to Abraham, "And in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

title: Acts 3:26
text: "It was for you first that God raised up his Servant, and sent him to bless you in turning every one of you away from your wicked ways."

title: Acts 4:1
text: While they were addressing the people the priests, the commander of the Temple, and the Sadducees came upon them,

title: Acts 4:2
text: incensed at their teaching the people, and proclaiming, in the case of Jesus, the resurrection from the dead.

title: Acts 4:3
text: They arrested them, and put them in prison till the next day, for it was already evening.

title: Acts 4:4
text: But many of those who had heard the message believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.

title: Acts 4:5
text: There was held in Jerusalem, next morning, a meeting of their rulers, the elders and scribes,

title: Acts 4:6
text: and Annas, the high priest, Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and all the members of the high priests family were present.

title: Acts 4:7
text: Then they made the men stand before them and demanded, "By what power, or in what name, have you fellows done this?"

title: Acts 4:8
text: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, answered them:

title: Acts 4:9
text: "Rulers and elders of the people, if we are being examined today concerning a benefit conferred upon a cripple, as to how has this man been cured,

title: Acts 4:10
text: "be it known to all of you, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ, the Nazarene, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, in him does this man stand before you strong and well.

title: Acts 4:11
text: "For he is the Stone, cast aside by you builders, which has become the head stone of the corner.

title: Acts 4:12
text: "There is no salvation in any other, for there is no other name under heaven given among men, in which we must be saved."

title: Acts 4:13
text: Now when they beheld the glad fearlessness of Peter and John and had perceived that they were amazed; and they began to recognize them, that they were companions of Jesus.

title: Acts 4:14
text: But since they saw the man standing with them who had been healed, they had nothing to answer.

title: Acts 4:15
text: So they bade them withdraw from the Sanhedrin, while they conferred together.

title: Acts 4:16
text: "What," said they, "shall we do with these men? For it is well known throughout Jerusalem that a notable miracle has been performed by them, and we cannot deny it.

title: Acts 4:17
text: "But that the matter may spread no further among the people, let us threaten them not to speak to any one hereafter about this name."

title: Acts 4:18
text: So they summoned them, and ordered them not to speak at all, nor to teach in the name of Jesus.

title: Acts 4:19
text: But Peter and John said in reply: "Do you decide whether in the sight of God it is right to obey you rather than God;

title: Acts 4:20
text: but for our part, we cannot help speaking about what we have seen and heard."

title: Acts 4:21
text: So when they had further threatened them they let the apostles go, being quite unable to find any way of punishing them because of the people, for everybody was glorifying God over what had happened.

title: Acts 4:22
text: For the man on whom this miracle of healing had been wrought was over forty years old.

title: Acts 4:23
text: As soon as the apostles were released, they went to their friends, and told what the high priests and elders had said.

title: Acts 4:24
text: And when they heard it they all lifted up their voices in prayer to God, saying: "O Sovereign Lord, who madest heaven and earth and sea, and all that in them is,

title: Acts 4:25
text: "who saidest through the Holy Spirit, by the lips of thy servant David, our forefather: "Why did the Gentiles rage, And the peoples form futile plans?

title: Acts 4:26
text: "The kings of the earth set themselves in array, And the rulers were gathered together Against the Lord and against his Christ.

title: Acts 4:27
text: "In this very city they did gather together against thy holy Servant, Jesus whom thou hast anointed--Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and also the tribes of Israel--

title: Acts 4:28
text: "to do all that thy power and thy will had predetermined should be done.

title: Acts 4:29
text: "And now Lord, listen to their threats, and grant to thy slaves to proclaim thy message with all boldness,

title: Acts 4:30
text: "whilst thou stretchest forth thy hand to heal; grant too, that signs and wonders may be done through the name of thy holy Servant, Jesus."

title: Acts 4:31
text: When they had prayed, the place where they were gathered was shaken; and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak the message of the Lord with boldness.

title: Acts 4:32
text: Now the multitude of the believers was of one heart and one soul, nor did any one of them say that any of his possessions was his own; but they had all things common.

title: Acts 4:33
text: And the apostles continued with great power to give their witness concerning the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and great grace was upon them all.

title: Acts 4:34
text: Nor was there any one of them in want, for all who owned houses or lands would sell them and bring the price of the things that were sold, and lay it at the apostles' feet;

title: Acts 4:35
text: and distribution would be made to each according to his need.

title: Acts 4:36
text: In this way Joseph, whom the apostles called Barnabas ("Son of Encouragement" is what it means), who was a native Cyprus,

title: Acts 4:37
text: sold a farm which he had, and brought the price, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

title: Acts 5:1
text: But a man named Ananias who, with his wife Sapphira, sold a farm of his,

title: Acts 5:2
text: kept back some of the purchase price, with the connivance of his wife. He brought only a part and laid it at the apostles' feet.

title: Acts 5:3
text: "Ananias," said Peter, "why has Satan so filled your heart that you are lying to the Holy Spirit, and keeping back part of the price of the land?

title: Acts 5:4
text: "While it remained unsold, was it not your own? And after it was sold, was not the price at your own disposal? How could you conceive this act in your heart? You have not lied unto men, but unto God."

title: Acts 5:5
text: As Ananias heard these words he fell down and expired, and all who heard were awe-struck.

title: Acts 5:6
text: But the younger men rose, wrapped the body up, and carried it out to bury it.

title: Acts 5:7
text: About three hours later his wife came in, not knowing what had happened;

title: Acts 5:8
text: and Peter said to her, "Tell me if you got so much for the land." "Yes," she said, "so much."

title: Acts 5:9
text: "Why was it," said Peter, "that you both agreed to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Lo, the feet of those who buried your husband are at the door, and they shall carry you out."

title: Acts 5:10
text: Instantly she fell down at his feet and expired, and when the young men came in they found her dead, and carried her out and buried her husband.

title: Acts 5:11
text: And great fear fell on all the church and upon all who had heard it.

title: Acts 5:12
text: Many signs and wonders continued to be wrought among the people by the hands of the apostles, and by common consent they all would meet in Solomon's Porch,

title: Acts 5:13
text: but none of the rest dared to associate with them.

title: Acts 5:14
text: Yet the people continued to hold them in high honor, and more and more believers in the Lord were joining them, both men and women.

title: Acts 5:15
text: In consequence people would even bring out their sick into the streets, and place them upon beds and pallets as Peter was passing, that at least his shadow might fall upon some of them.

title: Acts 5:16
text: The people of the towns near Jerusalem also continued to come in crowds, bringing their sick and those who were harried by unclean spirits, and all of them were healed.

title: Acts 5:17
text: This aroused bitter indignation among the high priest and his followers who were of the sect of the Sadducees,

title: Acts 5:18
text: and they apprehended the apostles, and threw them into the public prison.

title: Acts 5:19
text: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors during the night, and let them out.

title: Acts 5:20
text: He said to them, "Go take your stand in the Temple, and continue to tell the people all the words of this Life."

title: Acts 5:21
text: When they heard this they went at early dawn to the Temple, and began to teach. Meantime when the high priest and his followers arrived, they summoned the Sanhedrin and all the Council of the Elders of the sons of Israel, and sent to the prison to fetch the apostles.

title: Acts 5:22
text: But the officers who went did not find them in the prison; so they came back and reported,

title: Acts 5:23
text: "The prison we found locked fast, with the guards stationed at the doors, but when they were opened we found no one inside."

title: Acts 5:24
text: When the officer in charge of the Temple and the high priest heard these words, they were perplexed concerning them, wondering what would come of it.

title: Acts 5:25
text: And some one came and told them that the very men whom they had put in prison were standing in the Temple, and teaching to the people.

title: Acts 5:26
text: On this the officer went off with his men and fetched them, not, however, by force, for they were afraid that the people would stone them.

title: Acts 5:27
text: So they brought them, and stood them before the Sanhedrin. Then the high priest questioned them:

title: Acts 5:28
text: "We strictly forbade you, did we not, to teach about this Name, and here you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man's blood upon us."

title: Acts 5:29
text: But Peter and the apostles said in reply:

title: Acts 5:30
text: "We must obey God rather than man. The God of our fathers has raised up Jesus, whom you slew by hanging him on a tree.

title: Acts 5:31
text: "Him God has exalted at his right hand as Prince and Saviour, to give Israel repentance and forgiveness of sins.

title: Acts 5:32
text: "And we are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit whom God has given to those who obey him."

title: Acts 5:33
text: When they heard this they were infuriated, and were minded to kill the apostles;

title: Acts 5:34
text: but Gamaliel, a Pharisee, a teacher of the law, and held in honor by all the people, rose from his seat, and ordered the apostles to be put outside for a little while.

title: Acts 5:35
text: He said: "Men of Israel, take care what you are about to do with these men.

title: Acts 5:36
text: "Years ago Theudas arose, claiming to be somebody, and was joined by about four hundred men. He was killed, and all of his followers dispersed and annihilated.

title: Acts 5:37
text: "After him Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some of the people after him. He also perished, and all his followers were scattered.

title: Acts 5:38
text: "And now, I say to you, hold aloof from these men. Let them alone; for if this scheme or work be of human origin it will come to nothing;

title: Acts 5:39
text: "but if it is from God, you cannot put it down; you may even find yourselves fighting against God."

title: Acts 5:40
text: They gave in to him; and called the apostles in, and after flogging them, released them, with instructions not to speak about the name of Jesus.

title: Acts 5:41
text: So they left Sanhedrin, rejoicing that they had been deemed worthy to suffer disgrace for the sake of the Name;

title: Acts 5:42
text: but not for a single day did they desist from teaching and preaching in the Temple, and in private houses, the Gospel of Jesus, the Messiah.

title: Acts 6:1
text: Now in these days while the number of the disciples was multiplying, the Grecian Jews began to murmur against the Hebrews, because their widows were habitually overlooked in the distribution of alms.

title: Acts 6:2
text: Then the Twelve called the general body of the disciples together, and said to them: "It is not fitting for us to leave off preaching the Word of God, and minister at tables.

title: Acts 6:3
text: "So, brothers, find from among your own number seven men of good reputation who are full of the Spirit and of wisdom, and we will appoint them over this business.

title: Acts 6:4
text: "But we will give ourselves to prayer and to the ministry of the Word."

title: Acts 6:5
text: This plan commended itself to the whole body, and they selected Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, and Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas, a proselyte of Antioch.

title: Acts 6:6
text: These men they presented to the apostles who, when they had prayed, laid their hands upon them.

title: Acts 6:7
text: And the word of the Lord continued to spread; and the number of the disciples in Jerusalem was increasing exceedingly, and a large number of priests became obedient to the faith.

title: Acts 6:8
text: Meanwhile Stephen, full of grace and power, wrought great wonders and signs among the people.

title: Acts 6:9
text: But certain men from the so-called "Synagogue of the Freedmen" and certain Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, Cilicians, and men from Roman Asia, started to dispute with Stephen,

title: Acts 6:10
text: but were unable to withstand the wisdom and spirit with which he used to speak.

title: Acts 6:11
text: Then they instigated some to say, "We have heard him speaking blasphemy against Moses and against God;" and in this way they excited the people.

title: Acts 6:12
text: The elders and the scribes rushed upon him, and seized him, and brought him into the Sanhedrin.

title: Acts 6:13
text: They also set up false witnesses who testified: "This fellow is continually talking against the Holy Place and against the law.

title: Acts 6:14
text: "For we have heard him say that Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which were handed down to us by Moses."

title: Acts 6:15
text: Then all who were sitting in the council at once fixed their eyes upon him, and saw his face like the face of an angel.

title: Acts 7:1
text: And the high priest said, "Are these things so?"

title: Acts 7:2
text: Stephen answered: "Listen, brothers and fathers. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Haran,

title: Acts 7:3
text: and said to him, "Leave your country and your kindred, and come to whatever land I will show you.

title: Acts 7:4
text: "So he left Chaldea and settled in Haran, and from there, after his father's death, God moved him to this land which you inhabit.

title: Acts 7:5
text: "But he gave him no inheritance in it, no, not a single square yard of ground; yet he promised to bestow the land as a permanent possession on him and his posterity--he at that time being childless.

title: Acts 7:6
text: "What God said was this: "`His offspring will sojourn in a foreign land where they will be enslaved and oppressed for four hundred years.

title: Acts 7:7
text: "`And the nation, whichever it is, that enslaves them I will judge, said God, `and after ward they shall come out, and they shall worship me in this place.

title: Acts 7:8
text: "Then he gave him a covenant of circumcision, and under this covenant he became the father of Isaac, whom he circumcised on the eighth day, and Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve Patriarchs.

title: Acts 7:9
text: "The patriarchs out of jealousy sold Joseph into Egypt.

title: Acts 7:10
text: "But God was with him, and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him grace and wisdom, when he stood before Pharaoh, king of Egypt, who appointed him Governor over Egypt, and over all the royal household.

title: Acts 7:11
text: "Then there came a famine over the whole of Egypt and Canaan, and great distress, so that our ancestors could not find food.

title: Acts 7:12
text: "But Jacob heard that there was food in Egypt, and sent our ancestors there on their first visit.

title: Acts 7:13
text: "On their second visit Joseph made himself known to his brothers, and Pharaoh was informed of Joseph's parentage.

title: Acts 7:14
text: "Then Joseph sent and invited Jacob his father and all his family, numbering seventy-five souls, to come to him;

title: Acts 7:15
text: "and Jacob went down into Egypt.

title: Acts 7:16
text: "There he died, and our ancestors also, and they were carried across to Shechem, and laid in the tomb which Abraham had purchased for a sum of money from the sons of Hamor in Shechem.

title: Acts 7:17
text: "but as the time drew near for the fulfilment of the promise which God made to Abraham, the people multiplied and increased in Egypt;

title: Acts 7:18
text: "until there arose a king who knew not Joseph.

title: Acts 7:19
text: "He dealt craftily with our race, and oppressed our forefathers, by making them expose their infants so that they should not live.
